def install_private_model_containment(
    *,
    runtime_root: Path,
    source_root: Path | None = None,
    systemd_dir: Path = Path("/etc/systemd/system"),
    runtime_user: str = "",
    ollama_binary: Path | None = None,
    python_executable: Path | None = None,
    models: Sequence[str] = REQUIRED_MODELS,
    start_services: bool = True,
) -> dict[str, object]:
    runtime_root = runtime_root.expanduser().resolve()
    model_source = source_root.expanduser().resolve() if source_root is not None else discover_local_ollama_store(models)
    take_over_private_models(source_root=model_source, runtime_root=runtime_root, models=models)

    user = str(runtime_user or _runtime_user()).strip()
    if not user or user == "root":
        raise RuntimeError("private_model_runtime_user_must_be_non_root")
    ollama_path = (ollama_binary or Path(shutil.which("ollama") or "")).expanduser()
    if not str(ollama_path) or not ollama_path.is_file():
        raise RuntimeError("private_model_ollama_binary_missing")
    python_path = (python_executable or Path(sys.executable)).expanduser().resolve()
    if not python_path.is_file():
        raise RuntimeError("private_model_python_missing")

    model_root = runtime_root / "var" / "models" / "ollama"
    private_home = runtime_root / "var" / "model-home"
    run_root = runtime_root / "var" / "run"
    private_home.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    run_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    os.chmod(private_home, 0o700)
    os.chmod(run_root, 0o700)

    units = private_model_unit_texts(
        runtime_root=runtime_root,
        runtime_user=user,
        ollama_binary=ollama_path.resolve(),
        python_executable=python_path,
    )
    systemd_dir = systemd_dir.expanduser().resolve()
    unit_hashes: dict[str, str] = {}
    for name, text in units.items():
        path = systemd_dir / name
        _write_unit(path, text)
        unit_hashes[name] = _sha256(path)

    legacy_service_disabled = False
    active_verified = False
    socket_path = runtime_root / "var" / "run" / "ollama.sock"
    if start_services:
        _run(["systemctl", "daemon-reload"])
        legacy_state = _run(["systemctl", "is-active", _LEGACY_OLLAMA_SERVICE], check=False)
        legacy_enabled = _run(["systemctl", "is-enabled", _LEGACY_OLLAMA_SERVICE], check=False)
        if legacy_state.returncode == 0 or legacy_enabled.returncode == 0:
            _run(["systemctl", "disable", "--now", _LEGACY_OLLAMA_SERVICE], check=False)
        _run(["systemctl", "enable", "--now", _OLLAMA_SERVICE, _PROXY_SERVICE])
        for service in (_OLLAMA_SERVICE, _PROXY_SERVICE):
            state = _run(["systemctl", "is-active", service])
            if state.stdout.strip() != "active":
                raise RuntimeError("private_model_service_not_active:" + service)
            private_network = _run(["systemctl", "show", service, "-p", "PrivateNetwork", "--value"])
            if private_network.stdout.strip().casefold() != "yes":
                raise RuntimeError("private_model_service_not_private_network:" + service)
        legacy_state = _run(["systemctl", "is-active", _LEGACY_OLLAMA_SERVICE], check=False)
        legacy_enabled = _run(["systemctl", "is-enabled", _LEGACY_OLLAMA_SERVICE], check=False)
        legacy_service_disabled = legacy_state.returncode != 0 and legacy_enabled.returncode != 0
        if not legacy_service_disabled:
            raise RuntimeError("legacy_ollama_service_still_active_or_enabled")
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 15.0
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            try:
                mode = socket_path.stat().st_mode
            except OSError:
                time.sleep(0.1)
                continue
            if stat.S_ISSOCK(mode):
                break
            time.sleep(0.1)
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("private_model_unix_socket_not_ready")
        active_verified = True

    verification = verify_model_store(model_root, models)
    receipt: dict[str, object] = {
        "schema": _CONTAINMENT_SCHEMA,
        "ok": bool(start_services and active_verified and legacy_service_disabled),
        "private_model_containment_complete": bool(start_services and active_verified and legacy_service_disabled),
        "runtime_root": str(runtime_root),
        "model_store": str(model_root),
        "model_store_under_eira2": True,
        "required_models": list(models),
        "model_roles": {model: MODEL_ROLES.get(model, "private_candidate") for model in models},
        "required_models_complete": verification["required_models_complete"],
        "all_manifest_referenced_blobs_hash_verified": True,
        "model_transport": "unix_domain_socket",
        "unix_socket": str(socket_path),
        "ollama_private_network": True,
        "proxy_private_network": True,
        "outbound_network_allowed": False,
        "internet_model_pull_allowed_at_runtime": False,
        "legacy_ollama_service_active": False if start_services else None,
        "legacy_ollama_service_enabled": False if start_services else None,
        "legacy_ollama_service_disabled": legacy_service_disabled,
        "eira1_runtime_delegation": False,
        "direct_model_to_delivery_path": False,
        "direct_model_to_tools_path": False,
        "direct_model_to_identity_authority": False,
        "direct_model_to_memory_acceptance": False,
        "candidate_only": True,
        "runtime_user": user,
        "unit_files": {name: str(systemd_dir / name) for name in units},
        "unit_sha256": unit_hashes,
        "services_active_verified": active_verified,
    }
    _atomic_json(runtime_root / "var" / "eira2-private-model-containment.json", receipt)
    return receipt


def verify_private_model_containment(
    *,
    runtime_root: Path,
    systemd_dir: Path = Path("/etc/systemd/system"),
    models: Sequence[str] = REQUIRED_MODELS,
) -> dict[str, object]:
    runtime_root = runtime_root.expanduser().resolve()
    receipt_path = runtime_root / "var" / "eira2-private-model-containment.json"
    try:
        receipt = json.loads(receipt_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

class RegistryAwareNeuralSurface(LiveNeuralSurface):
    """Live atlas that overlays canonical runtime nodes and proven bridges."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        root: Path,
        *,
        inventory: Path | None = None,
        trace: bool = True,
        sync_interval_seconds: float = 2.0,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(
            root,
            inventory=inventory,
            trace=trace,
            sync_interval_seconds=sync_interval_seconds,
        )
        self._runtime_bridges: dict[tuple[str, str, str], dict[str, Any]] = {}

    def _inject_runtime_nodes(self, atlas: NeuralAtlas) -> None:
        super()._inject_runtime_nodes(atlas)
        for row in self._runtime_bridges.values():
            source_id = stable_neuron_id(f"@runtime/{row['source']}")
            target_id = stable_neuron_id(f"@runtime/{row['target']}")
            if source_id not in atlas.neurons or target_id not in atlas.neurons:
                continue
            atlas._add_fiber(
                source_id,
                target_id,
                str(row.get("kind") or "runtime_call"),
                bool(row.get("conductive", True)),
                str(row.get("evidence") or "runtime_registry_bridge"),
            )

    def seed_registry(self, snapshot: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        for node in snapshot.get("nodes", []):
            if not isinstance(node, dict):
                continue
            name = str(node.get("name") or "").strip()
            if not name:
                continue
            self._runtime_nodes[name] = {
                "kind": str(node.get("kind") or "service")[:80],
                "cluster": f"eira2:{name.split('.', 1)[0]}",
            }
        for bridge in snapshot.get("bridges", []):
            if not isinstance(bridge, dict):
                continue
            source = str(bridge.get("source") or "").strip()
            target = str(bridge.get("target") or "").strip()
            kind = str(bridge.get("kind") or "runtime_call")[:80]
            if not source or not target:
                continue
            self._runtime_bridges[(source, target, kind)] = {
                "source": source,
                "target": target,
                "kind": kind,
                "conductive": bool(bridge.get("conductive", True)),
                "evidence": str(bridge.get("evidence") or "registry_snapshot")[:160],
            }
        return self.refresh_topology("registry_seed")

    def register_runtime_bridge(
        self,
        source: str,
        target: str,
        *,
        kind: str = "runtime_call",
        conductive: bool = True,
        evidence: str = "registry_event",
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        source = str(source or "").strip()
        target = str(target or "").strip()
        kind = str(kind or "runtime_call")[:80]
        if not source or not target:
            return {"changed": False, "error": "runtime_bridge_identity_required"}
        self._runtime_bridges[(source, target, kind)] = {
            "source": source,
            "target": target,
            "kind": kind,
            "conductive": bool(conductive),
            "evidence": str(evidence or "registry_event")[:160],
        }
        return self.refresh_topology(f"runtime_bridge_registered:{source}:{target}:{kind}")

class AtomicAtlasProxy:

            "removed": 0,

        row["automatic_topology_sync"] = True

    return str(value or "").replace("\\", "/").strip()


def stable_neuron_id(path: str) -> str:
    """Stable opaque neuron id; paths remain metadata, not identifiers."""
    clean = _normalize(path)
    digest = hashlib.blake2b(clean.encode("utf-8", errors="replace"), digest_size=12).hexdigest()
    return f"neuron:{digest}"


def _logical_path(raw: str, root: Path) -> str:
    value = _normalize(raw)
    if not value:
        return ""
    root_text = _normalize(root.resolve())
    if value == root_text:
        return "."
    if value.startswith(root_text.rstrip("/") + "/"):
        return value[len(root_text.rstrip("/")) + 1 :]
    marker = "/EIRA/LIVE/"
    pos = value.casefold().find(marker.casefold())
    if pos >= 0:
        return value[pos + len(marker) :]
    if value.startswith("pi:/"):
        return "external/pi/" + value[3:].lstrip("/")
    if value.startswith("/"):
        return "external/fs/" + value.lstrip("/")
    return value.lstrip("./")


def _entry_path(row: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    for key in ("source_path", "path", "absolute_path", "relative_path"):
        if row.get(key):
            return _normalize(row[key])
    return ""


def _entry_kind(row: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    raw = str(row.get("entry_type") or row.get("type") or row.get("kind") or "file").casefold()
    return "directory" if raw in {"dir", "directory", "folder"} else "file"


def _disposition(row: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    return str(row.get("disposition") or row.get("classification") or "unclassified")


def _iter_json_payload(value: Any) -> Iterator[dict[str, Any]]:
    if isinstance(value, list):
        for row in value:
            if isinstance(row, dict):
                yield row
        return
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        for key in ("entries", "files", "manifest", "inventory"):
            rows = value.get(key)
            if isinstance(rows, list):
                for row in rows:
                    if isinstance(row, dict):
                        yield row
                return
        if _entry_path(value):
            yield value
            return
    raise ValueError("neural_inventory_json_shape_unsupported")


def inventory_rows(path: Path) -> Iterator[dict[str, Any]]:
    suffix = path.suffix.casefold()
    if suffix == ".csv":
        with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", newline="") as handle:
            yield from csv.DictReader(handle)
        return
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    if not text.strip():
        return
    try:
        payload = json.loads(text)
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        for number, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
            if not line.strip():
                continue
            try:
                row = json.loads(line)
            except json.JSONDecodeError as error:
                raise ValueError(f"neural_inventory_jsonl_invalid:{number}:{error.msg}") from error
            if not isinstance(row, dict):
                raise ValueError(f"neural_inventory_row_not_object:{number}")
            yield row
        return
    yield from _iter_json_payload(payload)


def inventory_candidates(root: Path) -> tuple[Path, ...]:
    env = os.getenv(_INVENTORY_ENV, "").strip()
    values = []
    if env:
        values.append(Path(env).expanduser())
    values.extend(
        [
            root / "migration_ledger.csv",
            root / "eira2" / "migration_ledger.csv",
            root / "var" / "migration_ledger.csv",
            root / "eira2" / "var" / "migration_ledger.csv",
            root / "eira2_organization.json",
            root / "eira2" / "eira2_organization.json",
            root / "var" / "eira2_organization.json",
        ]
    )
    out: list[Path] = []
    for value in values:
        resolved = value.resolve() if value.is_absolute() else (root / value).resolve()
        if resolved not in out:
            out.append(resolved)
    return tuple(out)


def _filesystem_rows(root: Path) -> Iterator[dict[str, Any]]:
    for path in root.rglob("*"):
        try:
            rel = path.relative_to(root)
        except ValueError:
            continue
        if any(part in _EXCLUDED_SCAN_PARTS for part in rel.parts):
            continue
        try:
            is_dir = path.is_dir()
            size = 0 if is_dir else path.stat().st_size
        except OSError:
            continue
        yield {
            "path": str(path),
            "type": "directory" if is_dir else "file",
            "size": size,
            "disposition": "runtime_scan_fallback",
        }


def _cluster_for(logical: str) -> str:
    parts = PurePosixPath(logical).parts
    if len(parts) >= 2 and parts[0] == "extensions":
        return f"extension:{parts[1]}"
    if len(parts) >= 3 and parts[:2] == ("eira2", "eira2"):
        return f"eira2:{parts[2]}"
    if parts:
        return f"root:{parts[0]}"
    return "root:."


def _anatomy_for(cluster: str) -> tuple[str, bool]:
    low = cluster.casefold()
    spine = any(token in low for token in ("conversation", "kernel", "state", "memory", "delivery", "evidence"))
    if spine:
        return "midline", True
    bit = int(hashlib.blake2b(cluster.encode(), digest_size=1).hexdigest(), 16) & 1
    return ("left" if bit == 0 else "right"), False


def _activity_class(disposition: str, logical: str) -> str:
    low = disposition.casefold()
    if low == "migrate_runtime" or logical.startswith(("eira2/", "extensions/")):
        return "runtime"
    if low == "migrate_state":
        return "state"
    if low == "migrate_artifact":
        return "artifact"
    if low in {"retain_evidence", "regenerate", "external_dependency", "secret_reference"}:
        return low
    return "other"

                path=raw,

                hemisphere=hemisphere,
                spine=spine,
                disposition=disposition,

                size=max(0, size),
                suffix=suffix,
                conductive_capable=kind == "file" and suffix in _CODE_SUFFIXES,

                if not callable(submitter):
                    raise RuntimeError("ambient_submitter_unavailable")
                result = self._submit(submitter(raw, sample_rate, channels, sample_width))
                return self._json(200, dict(result))

            if parsed.path == "/v1/location":
                raw = self._read_body(self._LOCATION_LIMIT)
                payload = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))
                if not isinstance(payload, dict):
                    raise ValueError("location_request_must_be_object")
                latitude = float(payload.get("latitude"))
                longitude = float(payload.get("longitude"))
                accuracy_m = float(payload.get("accuracy_m") or 0.0)
                submitter = getattr(self.server, "location_submitter", None)
                if not callable(submitter):
                    raise RuntimeError("location_submitter_unavailable")
                result = self._submit(
                    submitter(latitude, longitude, accuracy_m, str(peer.get("transport") or "")),
                    timeout_seconds=30.0,
                )
                safe = dict(result)
                safe.pop("latitude", None)
                safe.pop("longitude", None)
                return self._json(200, {"ok": True, **safe})
        except (UnicodeError, json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError, ValueError) as error:
            return self._json(400, {"ok": False, "error": f"{type(error).__name__}:{error}"[:500]})
        except TimeoutError:
            return self._json(504, {"ok": False, "error": "canonical_turn_timeout"})
        except BaseException as error:
            return self._json(503, {"ok": False, "error": f"{type(error).__name__}:{error}"[:500]})
        self._json(404, {"ok": False, "error": "not_found"})

class CommunicationLiveNeuralHTTPService(LiveNeuralHTTPService):
    """One HTTP server for neural UI, Apple AR surface and canonical iPhone ingress."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        *args: Any,
        text_submitter: TextSubmitter | None = None,
        pcm_submitter: PCMSubmitter | None = None,
        ambient_submitter: AmbientSubmitter | None = None,
        location_submitter: LocationSubmitter | None = None,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        self._text_submitter = text_submitter
        self._pcm_submitter = pcm_submitter
        self._ambient_submitter = ambient_submitter
        self._location_submitter = location_submitter

    @staticmethod
    def _canonical_submitters(
        context: RuntimeContext,
    ) -> tuple[TextSubmitter, PCMSubmitter, AmbientSubmitter, LocationSubmitter]:
        ingress = context.get_service("interfaces.ingress")
        native = context.get_service("interfaces.native")
        presence = context.get_service("delivery.reactive_presence")
        conversation = context.get_service("conversation.spine")
        delivery = context.get_service("delivery.gate")
        if not isinstance(ingress, IngressService):
            raise RuntimeError("canonical_ingress_missing")
        if not isinstance(native, NativeInputEvidenceService):
            raise RuntimeError("canonical_native_input_missing")
        if not isinstance(presence, ReactivePresenceService):
            raise RuntimeError("canonical_reactive_presence_missing")
        if not isinstance(conversation, ConversationSpine):
            raise RuntimeError("canonical_conversation_spine_missing")
        if not isinstance(delivery, DeliveryGate):
            raise RuntimeError("canonical_delivery_gate_missing")

        async def submit_turn(text: str, kind: InputKind) -> Any:
            clean_text = str(text or "").strip()
            if not clean_text:
                raise ValueError("empty_turn")
            envelope = ingress.accept(clean_text, kind)
            await presence.begin(envelope.correlation_id, mode="thinking")
            try:
                result = await conversation.respond(envelope.text, envelope.correlation_id)
                await delivery.deliver(result.correlation_id, result.response)
                return result
            finally:
                await presence.end(envelope.correlation_id)

        async def text_submitter(text: str) -> Any:
            return await submit_turn(text, InputKind.IPHONE_TEXT)

        async def pcm_submitter(raw: bytes, sample_rate: int, channels: int, sample_width: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
            transcript = await native.transcribe_pcm(raw, sample_rate=sample_rate, channels=channels, sample_width=sample_width)
            wake = native.wake_word(str(transcript["text"]))
            utterance = str(wake.get("utterance") or "").strip()
            if not utterance:
                raise ValueError("voice_utterance_empty")
            result = await submit_turn(utterance, InputKind.IPHONE_VOICE)
            return {"result": result, "utterance": utterance}

        async def ambient_submitter(raw: bytes, sample_rate: int, channels: int, sample_width: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
            transcript = await native.transcribe_pcm(raw, sample_rate=sample_rate, channels=channels, sample_width=sample_width)
            wake = native.wake_word(str(transcript["text"]))
            if not bool(wake.get("invoked")):
                return {"ok": True, "invoked": False, "raw_audio_retained": False, "transcript_retained": False}
            utterance = str(wake.get("utterance") or "").strip()
            if not utterance:
                return {"ok": True, "invoked": True, "awaiting_utterance": True, "raw_audio_retained": False, "transcript_retained": False}
            result = await submit_turn(utterance, InputKind.IPHONE_VOICE)
            return {
                "ok": bool(getattr(result, "verified", False)),
                "invoked": True,
                "verified": bool(getattr(result, "verified", False)),
                "correlation_id": str(getattr(result, "correlation_id", "")),
                "response": str(getattr(result, "response", "")),
                "utterance": utterance,
                "raw_audio_retained": False,
                "transcript_retained": False,
            }

        async def location_submitter(latitude: float, longitude: float, accuracy_m: float, transport: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
            local_context = context.get_service("extension.local_context")
            updater = getattr(local_context, "update_location", None)
            if not callable(updater):
                raise RuntimeError("canonical_local_context_location_update_unavailable")
            return await updater(latitude=latitude, longitude=longitude, accuracy_m=accuracy_m, source_transport=transport)

        return text_submitter, pcm_submitter, ambient_submitter, location_submitter

    async def start(self, context: RuntimeContext) -> None:
        if not self._subscriptions_installed:
            events = context.get_service("kernel.events")
            if isinstance(events, EventService):
                for topic in (
                    "runtime.node_registered", "runtime.node_unregistered", "registry.node_registered", "registry.node_unregistered",
                    "runtime.extension_registered", "runtime.extension_unregistered", "registry.extension_registered", "registry.extension_unregistered",
                    "runtime.file_added", "runtime.file_removed", "runtime.file_changed",
                ):
                    events.subscribe(topic, self._topology_event)
                self._subscriptions_installed = True

        text_submitter = self._text_submitter
        pcm_submitter = self._pcm_submitter
        ambient_submitter = self._ambient_submitter
        location_submitter = self._location_submitter
        if text_submitter is None or pcm_submitter is None or ambient_submitter is None or location_submitter is None:
            text_submitter, pcm_submitter, ambient_submitter, location_submitter = self._canonical_submitters(context)

        self.surface.start()
        loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()

            (self.host, self.port), self.surface, loop=loop, text_submitter=text_submitter,
            pcm_submitter=pcm_submitter, ambient_submitter=ambient_submitter, location_submitter=location_submitter,

    return added

# EIRA 2.0 whole-system audit scope

This audit treats EIRA 2.0 as one organism, not a collection of individually green files.

The mandatory path is:

input -> canonical ingress -> conversation analysis -> relevant accepted history -> cognitive constellation -> expression/reaction -> evidence/identity/validated experience -> zero-or-one heavy candidate generation when needed -> response verification -> identity review -> acceptance-only history commit -> delivery gate -> configured mouth/voice sink.

Authoritative deterministic capability results may satisfy a turn without invoking the heavy generator. When generation is needed, exactly one heavy candidate may be requested through `reasoning.provider`; no model/provider may create a second conversational or outward authority.

The whole-tree audit also requires:

- one lifecycle authority (Supervisor)
- one durable state authority
- one node/bridge registry authority
- one conversation authority
- one outward delivery authority
- manifest/runtime dependency parity
- no orphan required service
- no superseded executable extension authority in the active package namespace
- every dynamic extension import-safe and manifest-backed
- every runtime service represented in the registry and every service dependency represented by an evidence-backed conductive bridge
- reverse-order shutdown
- preservation/cutover states remain evidence-based; source presence alone never upgrades a capability to native/parity-verified
- hardware/device claims remain unverified until exercised on the real Pi/iPhone/audio/sensor environment

Passing this source audit does not authorize cutover. The frozen requirements in `REPLACEMENT_CONTRACT.md` and the implemented final-cutover/full-replacement graders are the completion authority. Historical draft criteria that the frozen replacement contract explicitly supersedes are not additional goalposts. Real Pi/Easystore migration, retirement, reboot, hardware, model, rollback, and exact-source qualification evidence remain mandatory wherever the frozen implementation requires them.

# EIRA 2.0 canonical structure and execution order

This document is normative. A runtime path that violates these ownership and dependency rules is not a valid EIRA 2.0 path.

## Active source structure

```text
eira2/
  eira2/
    contracts.py          # shared runtime contracts only; no boot side effects
    config/               # schema and isolation/cutover validation
    kernel/               # supervisor, event bus, lifecycle, process lock
    state/                # sole durable state-store authority and checkpoints
    registry/             # static manifests, runtime topology, dynamic extension manager
    capabilities/         # canonical discovery/execution boundary for tools and extension handlers
    learning/             # verified experiential-learning service
    evidence/             # response evidence, web evidence, identity grounding
    memory/               # memory API backed only by state.store
    security/             # attestation and canonical Jellyfish immune hierarchy
    reasoning/            # subordinate candidate generation only; model backend lives here
    commands/             # command helper/library; never a second execution or conversation authority
    conversation/         # one accepted-input-to-verified-response spine
    delivery/             # one outward-delivery authority plus voice sink
    interfaces/           # normalized ingress and interface-facing support
    neural/               # implementation of interfaces.neural_ui; file/node/bridge/tool AR surface
    operations/           # FullDoctor, health, status, maintenance and takeover qualification
    repair/               # activation, repair authorization, staged self-evolution, cutover
    extensions/           # dynamically attachable EIRA2 extensions; boot only through registry
    adapters/             # EIRA2-native provider adapters only; never lifecycle authorities
    migration/            # migration-ledger/planning helpers; not a runtime authority
    parity/               # parity evaluation helpers; not a runtime authority
    preservation.py       # cutover preservation enforcement
    preservation_catalog.py
    runtime.py            # composition root only; Supervisor remains lifecycle authority
    live.py               # authorized live-runtime composition/serve path
    __main__.py           # explicit shadow-smoke or authorized live entrypoint
  manifests/              # canonical static service manifests
  tests/                  # contract, integration, privacy, recovery, parity tests
  tools/                  # read/build/staging tooling; not resident services
  preservation_contract.json
  fraternal_twin_contract.json
  *.md                    # normative/supporting architecture documents
```

EIRA1 source may exist outside this directory before retirement for forensic comparison, migration, and rollback proof. It is never EIRA2 runtime authority and no importable EIRA1 compatibility package is permitted inside active EIRA2. Useful EIRA1 behavior, science, state, artifacts, and evidence must be absorbed into a deliberate EIRA2-owned implementation or inert EIRA2-owned data/evidence location before the corresponding EIRA1 installation material is retired. The Invention Lab is EIRA2-native; it is not an EIRA1 compatibility boundary.

## Canonical dependency layers

| Layer | Authority/component | May depend on |
|---|---|---|
| 00 | contracts | standard library only |
| 10 | config | 00 |
| 20 | kernel | 00–10 |
| 30 | state | 00–20 |
| 40 | registry | 00–30 |
| 45 | learning | 00–40 |
| 50 | evidence and memory | 00–45 |
| 55 | security | 00–50 |
| 58 | capabilities.executor | registry/events plus explicitly bridged implementation services |
| 60 | reasoning provider and command helpers | 00–58 |
| 70 | conversation spine | 00–60 |
| 80 | delivery | 00–70 |
| 90 | interfaces | 00–80 |
| 100 | operations | 00–90 |

Dependencies between canonical services must be explicit in `ServiceSpec` and the matching manifest. Static service cycles are forbidden. Cross-component observation and callbacks should use the event bus rather than inventing a second authority.

`neural/` implements the optional `interfaces.neural_ui` service and therefore does not create a separate authority layer. `extensions/` are attached only after the canonical static graph is healthy; each extension declares dependencies and is started/stopped only by Supervisor. `adapters/` may contain EIRA2-native provider boundaries, while `migration/`, `parity/`, and preservation helpers are bounded libraries/tooling unless a manifest explicitly makes a service out of them. No adapter may delegate EIRA2 runtime authority back to EIRA1.

## Canonical boot sequence

1. Validate configuration, package identity, and isolation/cutover authorization appropriate to the requested mode.
2. Construct the service graph without starting extensions.
3. Verify every configured static service has a matching manifest and exact dependency declaration.
4. Acquire the single process lock through Supervisor.
5. Start the event service, durable state, checkpoints, registry, canonical capability executor, and extension manager in topological order.
6. Start memory, accepted-history, verified learning, security attestation, and Jellyfish immune services in dependency order.
7. Start evidence, identity, cognition, subordinate reasoning, and the single conversation spine.
8. Start voice/delivery and canonical ingress.
9. Start configured interfaces such as the persistent neural/WebXR surface.
10. Start health, status, FullDoctor, maintenance coordination, activation, repair, and self-evolution services.
11. Register built-in executable capability bindings only after their implementation services are alive. Every binding creates a findable `tool.*` node plus evidence-backed dispatcher and implementation bridges.
12. Require post-boot FullDoctor success.
13. Discover, import-safety-check, and attach every eligible dynamic extension through Supervisor; extension attach errors fail startup.
14. Reconcile any extension-provided `capability_bindings()` through `capabilities.executor`; advertised manifest capability strings alone never grant execution authority.
15. Require a final FullDoctor pass over the post-extension/post-tool graph.
16. Mark the runtime usable only after required services are healthy.

Shutdown is the exact reverse of actual Supervisor start order. Repair and self-modification are permitted only at validated safe boundaries with rollback evidence.

## Normal conversation path

```text
external/local input
  -> interfaces.ingress (normalize + correlation identity)
  -> conversation.spine
       -> accepted-history retrieval
       -> deterministic cognitive analysis
       -> capabilities.executor
            -> discover only registered executable bindings
            -> run permitted tools before candidate generation
            -> sanitize tool results
            -> record tool nodes + evidence-backed bridges
       -> constellation/perspective planning
       -> expression/reaction guidance
       -> verified experience + identity + optional web evidence
       -> zero-or-one heavy candidate generation through reasoning.provider when needed
       -> evidence verification + live semantic guard
       -> identity review
       -> accepted-history commit
  -> delivery.gate
       -> configured sinks / delivery.voice
```

Authoritative deterministic capability results may satisfy a turn without invoking the heavy candidate generator. When generation is needed, exactly one candidate may be requested through `reasoning.provider`. Every turn remains inside the same conversation transaction and must pass the canonical evidence/identity/history/delivery authorities. No model/provider, extension, voice sink, command helper, capability handler, UI, or fast path may create a competing outward response path.

The evidence/semantic gate may reject or trim surrounding whitespace but must not silently collapse the internal structure of an accepted candidate. Code indentation, JSON layout, paragraph breaks, lists, tables, poetry, and other intentional formatting remain part of the response payload.

## Model-backend placement

The local model backend, including Ollama when Ollama is configured, sits behind `reasoning.provider` and nowhere else.

- `reasoning.provider` alone owns the raw generation callback/backend connection.
- Normal conversation may consume only `reasoning.provider.candidate` after history, cognition, capabilities/tools, identity context, learning, and external evidence have already been assembled.
- `repair.self_evolution` may consume `reasoning.provider.candidate` only to propose staged changes. Proposal text has no write, promotion, restart, or delivery authority.
- Models never own tools, registry topology, identity, provenance, runtime truth, security state, memory acceptance, or delivery.
- Runtime/tool/evidence truth outranks candidate text.
- A candidate cannot claim that a tool ran unless `capabilities.executor` supplied a corresponding execution result.
- A candidate cannot reach the mouth without response verification, identity review, and `delivery.gate`.

This placement is mandatory regardless of which model backend is used.

## Single-owner rules

- `kernel.supervisor` alone starts and stops runtime services, including dynamic extensions.
- `state.store` alone owns durable storage mechanics; higher services may write only through that authority.
- `registry.graph` alone owns canonical runtime node/bridge topology and service/tool discoverability.
- `capabilities.executor` alone converts registered executable capability bindings into tool execution. It never invents a handler from a model response.
- `security.jellyfish_immune` alone owns Jellyfish containment/recovery policy; `security.attestation` owns defense receipt verification.
- `conversation.spine` alone converts a normal accepted input into one verified response transaction.
- `reasoning.provider` is candidate-only and never a tool, outward identity, provenance, truth, or delivery authority.
- `delivery.gate` alone authorizes outward text/voice emission and prevents a streamed response from being spoken again as a duplicate final response.
- `operations.coordinator` alone schedules maintenance observation; FullDoctor diagnoses but does not repair.
- `repair.coordinator` alone authorizes validated repair application.
- `repair.self_evolution` may propose/stage/promote only within its protected validation/rollback contract and receives model proposals only through `reasoning.provider`.
- Manifests declare services/extensions; importing a module never boots it.
- Historical, compatibility, evidence, and user-artifact files are never executable merely because they exist in the repository.
- EIRA1 history retained after takeover must be inert evidence/data, not an importable compatibility runtime or alternative authority.

## Node, bridge, and tool discoverability rules

- Every supervised static service is seeded as exactly one canonical registry node.
- Every attached dynamic extension is registered as exactly one extension node.
- Every executable capability binding is registered as a `tool.<capability-id>` node.
- Every service dependency is a conductive `service_dependency` bridge backed by its `ServiceSpec`/manifest.
- Every executable tool has a conductive `capability_dispatch` bridge from `capabilities.executor` and a conductive `capability_implementation` bridge to its implementing service.
- Every conductive bridge must carry a non-empty evidence label.
- `registry.graph.find()` must be able to return every runtime service/extension/tool node by exact identity.
- File-level neurons are owned by the neural atlas rather than the service registry; every canonical inventory/file entry receives a stable neuron identity and is searchable through the neural surface.
- Synthetic anatomical membership fibers never become conductive merely because two nodes are visually adjacent.

## Dynamic extension rules

- Dynamic extension names begin with `extension.` and modules live below `eira2.extensions`.
- Dynamic extensions are optional; no dynamic extension may become an undeclared boot-critical authority.
- Import-time side effects are rejected.
- Factory/spec/dependency/capability contracts are validated before attach.
- Shadow-unsafe extensions are not attached in shadow mode.
- Supervisor starts/stops the extension; Registry records its node and conductive dependency bridges.

async def shadow_smoke(root: Path) -> dict:
    delivered: list[str] = []

    async def candidate(text: str) -> str:
        return "shadow candidate for " + text

    async def sink(text: str) -> None:
        delivered.append(text)

    runtime = Eira2Runtime(default_config(root), generate=candidate, verify=verify_response, sinks=[sink])
    await runtime.start()
    result = await runtime.process("EIRA 2.0 isolated verification")
    health = await runtime.health.snapshot()
    await runtime.stop()
    return {
        "schema": "eira2_shadow_smoke_v1",
        "ok": result.verified and not health["required_failures"],
        "shadow_mode": True,
        "outward_deliveries": len(delivered),
        "required_failures": health["required_failures"],
        "service_count": len(health["services"]),
        "response_characters": len(result.response),
        "privacy": {"conversation_text": False, "source_code": False, "audio": False, "secrets": False},
    }


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--root", type=Path, default=Path.cwd())
    modes = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
    modes.add_argument("--shadow-smoke", action="store_true")
    modes.add_argument("--live", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--package-manifest", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--model", default="")
    parser.add_argument("--host", default="0.0.0.0")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=8782)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    root = args.root.expanduser().resolve()

        else root / "eira2-package-manifest.json"
    )
    asyncio.run(run_live(root, manifest, model=args.model, host=args.host, port=args.port))
    return 0

import subprocess
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from .executor import CapabilityBinding
from ..contracts import Health, RuntimeContext, ServiceSpec, ServiceState


_RISK_PATTERNS = (
    ("dynamic_eval", re.compile(r"\b(?:eval|exec)\s*\(")),
    ("shell_true", re.compile(r"shell\s*=\s*True")),
    ("pickle_load", re.compile(r"\bpickle\.loads?\s*\(")),
    ("unsafe_yaml", re.compile(r"\byaml\.load\s*\(")),
    ("recursive_delete", re.compile(r"\b(?:rm\s+-rf|shutil\.rmtree)\b")),
    ("credential_literal", re.compile(r"(?i)\b(?:password|api[_-]?key|secret|token)\s*=\s*['\"][^'\"]{8,}")),
)


class VerifiedEngineeringService:
    """EIRA2-native deterministic engineering/code verification authority.

    It validates candidates but never generates them and never promotes code. This
    keeps local/model generation subordinate to evidence and repair authorities.
    """

    spec = ServiceSpec(
        "capabilities.engineering",
        required=True,
        dependencies=("kernel.events", "operations.doctor"),
        start_timeout_seconds=20.0,
    )

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._state = ServiceState.DECLARED
        self._validated = 0
        self._rejected = 0

    async def start(self, context: RuntimeContext) -> None:
        self._state = ServiceState.READY

    async def stop(self) -> None:
        self._state = ServiceState.STOPPED

    async def health(self) -> Health:
        return Health(self._state, f"validated={self._validated} rejected={self._rejected}")

    @staticmethod
    def _risk_findings(source: str) -> list[str]:
        return [name for name, pattern in _RISK_PATTERNS if pattern.search(source)]

    @staticmethod
    def _syntax(language: str, source: str) -> tuple[bool, str]:
        lang = str(language or "").casefold().strip()
        if lang in {"python", "py"}:
            try:
                ast.parse(source)
                compile(source, "<eira2-engineering>", "exec")
                return True, "python_ast_compile_ok"
            except (SyntaxError, ValueError) as error:
                return False, f"{type(error).__name__}:{error}"
        if lang in {"json"}:
            try:
                json.loads(source)
                return True, "json_parse_ok"
            except json.JSONDecodeError as error:
                return False, f"JSONDecodeError:{error}"
        executable = None
        suffix = ".txt"
        if lang in {"bash", "sh", "shell"}:
            executable = shutil.which("bash")
            suffix = ".sh"
            argv_builder = lambda path: [executable, "-n", str(path)]  # noqa: E731
        elif lang in {"javascript", "js"}:
            executable = shutil.which("node")
            suffix = ".js"
            argv_builder = lambda path: [executable, "--check", str(path)]  # noqa: E731
        else:
            return False, f"unsupported_language:{lang}"
        if not executable:
            return False, f"validator_unavailable:{lang}"
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eira2-engineering-") as temp:
            path = Path(temp) / f"candidate{suffix}"
            path.write_text(source, encoding="utf-8")
            completed = subprocess.run(argv_builder(path), check=False, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
        if completed.returncode == 0:
            return True, f"{lang}_syntax_ok"
        return False, (completed.stderr or completed.stdout or f"{lang}_syntax_failed")[-1000:]

    def validate_source(self, language: str, source: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        text = str(source or "")
        if not text.strip():
            raise ValueError("engineering_source_required")
        if len(text.encode("utf-8")) > 2_000_000:
            raise ValueError("engineering_source_too_large")
        syntax_ok, syntax_detail = self._syntax(language, text)
        risks = self._risk_findings(text)
        accepted = bool(syntax_ok and not risks)
        if accepted:
            self._validated += 1
        else:
            self._rejected += 1
        return {
            "schema": "eira2_verified_engineering_receipt_v1",
            "accepted": accepted,
            "language": str(language).casefold().strip(),
            "sha256": hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(),
            "bytes": len(text.encode("utf-8")),
            "syntax_ok": syntax_ok,
            "syntax_detail": syntax_detail,
            "security_findings": risks,
            "candidate_executed": False,
            "promotion_authority": False,
        }

    @staticmethod
    def extract_fenced_blocks(text: str) -> tuple[tuple[str, str], ...]:
        pattern = re.compile(r"```([A-Za-z0-9_+.-]*)\s*\n(.*?)```", re.S)
        rows: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
        for match in pattern.finditer(str(text or "")):
            lang = match.group(1).strip().casefold() or "text"
            rows.append((lang, match.group(2)))
        return tuple(rows)

    def validate_response_code(self, response: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        blocks = self.extract_fenced_blocks(response)
        receipts: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        supported = {"python", "py", "json", "bash", "sh", "shell", "javascript", "js"}
        for language, source in blocks:
            if language not in supported:
                continue
            receipts.append(self.validate_source(language, source))
        return {
            "ok": all(row["accepted"] for row in receipts),
            "checked_blocks": len(receipts),
            "receipts": receipts,
        }

    def capability_bindings(self) -> tuple[CapabilityBinding, ...]:
        async def status(_: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
            return {
                "owner": self.spec.name,
                "validated": self._validated,
                "rejected": self._rejected,
                "candidate_generation_authority": False,
                "promotion_authority": False,
                "languages": ["python", "json", "bash", "javascript"],
            }

        return (
            CapabilityBinding(
                id="engineering.status",
                implementation_node=self.spec.name,
                aliases=("verified engineering status", "engineering validator status"),
                tags=("runtime_introspection", "technical_reasoning"),
                handler=status,
                description="Inspect the native deterministic verified-engineering validation authority.",
                read_only=True,
                auto_safe=False,
                shadow_safe=True,
            ),
        )

class WorldSimulationService:
    """Native persistent EIRA2 world/universe construction and deterministic simulation.

    This consolidates the old world-family extension surface into one authority. State
    changes are explicit and durable; the language model cannot mutate simulation
    state except through registered non-auto-safe capability calls.
    """

    spec = ServiceSpec(
        "capabilities.worlds",
        required=True,
        dependencies=("kernel.events", "state.store"),
        start_timeout_seconds=20.0,
    )

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._context: RuntimeContext | None = None
        self._store: StateStore | None = None
        self._state = ServiceState.DECLARED

    async def start(self, context: RuntimeContext) -> None:
        store = context.get_service("state.store")
        if not isinstance(store, StateStore):
            raise RuntimeError("canonical_state_store_missing")
        self._context = context
        self._store = store
        self._state = ServiceState.READY

    async def stop(self) -> None:
        self._context = None
        self._store = None
        self._state = ServiceState.STOPPED

    async def health(self) -> Health:
        worlds = 0
        if self._store is not None:
            worlds = len(self._store.namespace_snapshot("worlds"))
        return Health(self._state, f"worlds={worlds}")

    def _ready(self) -> tuple[RuntimeContext, StateStore]:
        if self._context is None or self._store is None or self._state != ServiceState.READY:
            raise RuntimeError("world_simulation_not_ready")
        return self._context, self._store

    @staticmethod
    def _slug(value: str) -> str:
        clean = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", str(value or "").casefold()).strip("-")
        return clean[:80] or f"world-{uuid4().hex[:8]}"

    async def create_world(
        self,
        name: str,
        *,
        seed: int | None = None,
        radius_km: float = 500.0,
        gravity_m_s2: float = 9.80665,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        context, store = self._ready()
        clean_name = " ".join(str(name or "").split())[:200]
        if not clean_name:
            raise ValueError("world_name_required")
        world_id = self._slug(clean_name)
        existing = store.get("worlds", world_id)
        if isinstance(existing, dict):
            raise ValueError(f"world_already_exists:{world_id}")
        if seed is None:
            seed = int(hashlib.sha256(clean_name.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:16], 16)
        row = {
            "schema": "eira2_world_v1",
            "id": world_id,
            "name": clean_name,
            "seed": int(seed),
            "radius_km": max(0.001, float(radius_km)),
            "gravity_m_s2": max(0.0, float(gravity_m_s2)),
            "simulation_time_s": 0.0,
            "tick": 0,
            "bodies": {},
            "metadata": dict(metadata or {}),
            "created_at": time.time(),
            "updated_at": time.time(),
        }
        store.put("worlds", world_id, row)
        await context.publish(Event("world.created", {"id": world_id, "seed": int(seed)}))
        return dict(row)

    def get_world(self, world_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        _, store = self._ready()
        value = store.get("worlds", str(world_id))
        if not isinstance(value, dict):
            raise KeyError("world_not_found")
        return dict(value)

    def list_worlds(self) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], ...]:
        _, store = self._ready()
        rows = [dict(value) for value in store.namespace_snapshot("worlds").values() if isinstance(value, dict)]
        rows.sort(key=lambda row: str(row.get("id")))
        return tuple(rows)

    async def add_body(
        self,
        world_id: str,
        name: str,
        *,
        mass_kg: float,
        radius_m: float,
        position_m: tuple[float, float, float] = (0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
        velocity_m_s: tuple[float, float, float] = (0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
        kind: str = "body",
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        context, store = self._ready()
        world = self.get_world(world_id)
        body_id = self._slug(name)
        bodies = dict(world.get("bodies") or {})
        if body_id in bodies:
            raise ValueError("world_body_already_exists")
        body = {
            "id": body_id,
            "name": " ".join(str(name or "").split())[:200],
            "kind": str(kind or "body")[:80],
            "mass_kg": max(0.0, float(mass_kg)),
            "radius_m": max(0.0, float(radius_m)),
            "position_m": [float(x) for x in position_m],
            "velocity_m_s": [float(x) for x in velocity_m_s],
        }
        if not body["name"]:
            raise ValueError("world_body_name_required")
        bodies[body_id] = body
        world["bodies"] = bodies
        world["updated_at"] = time.time()
        store.put("worlds", str(world_id), world)
        await context.publish(Event("world.body_added", {"world_id": str(world_id), "body_id": body_id}))
        return dict(body)

    async def step(self, world_id: str, dt_seconds: float = 1.0) -> dict[str, Any]:
        context, store = self._ready()
        dt = float(dt_seconds)
        if not 0.0 < dt <= 86400.0:
            raise ValueError("simulation_step_out_of_range")
        world = self.get_world(world_id)
        bodies = dict(world.get("bodies") or {})
        # Deterministic kinematic integrator. Higher-order subsystem-specific physics
        # can attach to this authority without creating a second world state owner.
        for body_id, raw in list(bodies.items()):
            if not isinstance(raw, dict):
                continue
            body = dict(raw)
            pos = [float(x) for x in body.get("position_m", (0.0, 0.0, 0.0))]
            vel = [float(x) for x in body.get("velocity_m_s", (0.0, 0.0, 0.0))]
            if len(pos) != 3 or len(vel) != 3 or any(not math.isfinite(x) for x in pos + vel):
                raise ValueError(f"world_body_vector_invalid:{body_id}")
            body["position_m"] = [pos[i] + vel[i] * dt for i in range(3)]
            bodies[body_id] = body
        world["bodies"] = bodies
        world["simulation_time_s"] = float(world.get("simulation_time_s", 0.0)) + dt
        world["tick"] = int(world.get("tick", 0)) + 1
        world["updated_at"] = time.time()
        store.put("worlds", str(world_id), world)
        await context.publish(Event("world.simulation_step", {
            "world_id": str(world_id),
            "tick": world["tick"],
            "dt_seconds": dt,
            "body_count": len(bodies),
        }))
        return {
            "world_id": str(world_id),
            "tick": world["tick"],
            "simulation_time_s": world["simulation_time_s"],
            "body_count": len(bodies),
        }

    def capability_bindings(self) -> tuple[CapabilityBinding, ...]:
        async def status(_: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
            rows = self.list_worlds()
            return {
                "world_count": len(rows),
                "worlds": [
                    {
                        "id": row.get("id"),
                        "name": row.get("name"),
                        "tick": row.get("tick"),
                        "body_count": len(row.get("bodies") or {}),
                    }
                    for row in rows[:100]
                ],
                "state_authority": self.spec.name,
            }

        async def build(text: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
            clean = re.sub(r"^(?:oasis\s+build|build\s+world|create\s+world)\b[:\s-]*", "", str(text), flags=re.I).strip()
            return await self.create_world(clean or "Untitled World")

        return (
            CapabilityBinding(
                id="world.status",
                implementation_node=self.spec.name,
                aliases=("world status", "universe status", "list worlds"),
                tags=("world_simulation", "runtime_introspection"),
                handler=status,
                description="Read persistent EIRA2-native world/universe simulation state.",
                read_only=True,
                auto_safe=False,
                shadow_safe=True,
            ),
            CapabilityBinding(
                id="world.build",
                implementation_node=self.spec.name,
                aliases=("oasis build", "build world", "create world"),
                tags=("world_simulation", "creative_synthesis"),
                handler=build,
                description="Create a new persistent EIRA2 world under the single world-state authority.",
                read_only=False,
                auto_safe=False,
                shadow_safe=False,
            ),
        )

class ServiceState(str, Enum):

    READY = "ready"

class Event:

class ServiceSpec:

    required: bool = False
    dependencies: tuple[str, ...] = ()

    stop_timeout_seconds: float = 10.0

class Health:

_SOCIAL = re.compile(r"^(?:hey|hi|hello|yo|sup|what(?:'s| is) up|how are you|how(?:'s| is) it going|good (?:morning|afternoon|evening))\b", re.I)
_CONTINUITY = re.compile(r"\b(?:continue|continuing|earlier|previous|before|again|still|that|this|it|those|these|what we|what you|we discussed|you said|i said|last time|same thing|pick up|go on)\b", re.I)
_DEEP = re.compile(r"\b(?:analy[sz]e|evaluate|compare|contrast|reason|derive|prove|explain deeply|deep dive|end[- ]to[- ]end|architecture|trade[- ]offs?|implications?|root cause|why exactly|step by step|system-wide)\b", re.I)
_TECHNICAL = re.compile(r"\b(?:code|python|javascript|bash|api|runtime|server|database|sqlite|json|module|function|class|syntax|algorithm|network|kernel|service|node|extension|bridge|compiler|test|debug|deploy|hardware|raspberry pi|physics|chemistry|biology|engineering|mathematics|equation|model|system architecture)\b", re.I)
_SCIENCE = re.compile(r"\b(?:physics|quantum|relativity|gravity|fusion|plasma|chemistry|biology|neuroscience|consciousness|hypothesis|experiment|scientific|theory|evidence|measurement|astronomy|astrophysics|astrobiology|botany|botanist)\b", re.I)
_CREATIVE = re.compile(r"\b(?:invent|design|imagine|brainstorm|creative|story|worldbuild|concept|novel|original|visualize|render|architect)\b", re.I)
_PLANNING = re.compile(r"\b(?:plan|roadmap|priorit|schedule|next steps?|strategy|organize|sequence|workflow|implementation plan)\b", re.I)
_SELF_SYSTEM = re.compile(r"\b(?:(?:eira(?:'s)?|your) (?:brain|runtime|architecture|memory|nodes?|extensions?|services?|files?|doctor|watcher|capabilities|system|status)|(?:system|runtime|eira) status|internal system|hidden route|yourself|self[- ](?:repair|build|modify|evaluate))\b", re.I)
_RISK = re.compile(r"\b(?:medical|medicine|dose|dosage|legal|lawsuit|contract law|financial advice|investment|trade|security exploit|credential|password|self harm|suicide|weapon|dangerous|high voltage|toxic|poison)\b", re.I)
_FRUSTRATION = re.compile(r"\b(?:wrong|broken|failed|failure|garbage|horrible|bullshit|fuck|fucking|shit|damn)\b", re.I)
_EXCITEMENT = re.compile(r"\b(?:awesome|amazing|perfect|excited|love it|beautiful|incredible|yes+|boom)\b|!{2,}", re.I)
_URGENCY = re.compile(r"\b(?:urgent|immediately|right now|asap|today|finish this|don't stop|do it now)\b", re.I)
_SPECULATION = re.compile(r"\b(?:maybe|might|could|possibly|theory|hypothesis|speculat|imagine if|what if|probability|likely|unlikely)\b", re.I)
_AMBIGUOUS_DEICTIC = re.compile(r"^(?:do it|fix it|that|this|it|same|continue|keep going|yes|no|correct)\W*$", re.I)
_FAST_LOCAL = re.compile(
    r"^\s*(?:what(?:'s| is) (?:the )?time|what time is it|current time|time of day|"
    r"what(?:'s| is) (?:the )?date|what day is it|current date|today(?:'s date)?|"
    r"where are you|what(?:'s| is) your location|your location|planetary location|what planet are you on|what state are you in|"
    r"what(?:'s| is) the weather(?: like)?|weather(?: today| now)?|current weather|forecast|temperature outside)\??\s*$",
    re.I,
)

            "depth": self.depth,

        }

            f"depth={self.depth}",

            "domains=" + ",".join(self.domains or ("general",)),

            f"continuity={str(self.continuity).lower()}",
            f"ambiguity={str(self.ambiguity).lower()}",
            f"self_system={str(self.self_system).lower()}",
            f"external_evidence={str(self.external_evidence).lower()}",
            f"uncertainty_required={str(self.uncertainty_required).lower()}",
            f"risk_sensitive={str(self.risk_sensitive).lower()}",

            "</eira_cognitive_analysis>",
        ]
        if self.history_context:
            lines.append(self.history_context)
        return "\n".join(lines)


def _intent_tags(text: str, web: WebDecision) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    tags: set[str] = set()
    lower = text.casefold()
    if _SOCIAL.search(text):
        tags.add("social")
    if "?" in text:
        tags.add("question")
    if re.search(r"\b(?:explain|why|how does|teach me|help me understand)\b", text, re.I):
        tags.add("explanation")
    if re.search(r"\b(?:compare|versus|vs\.?|difference between|better than)\b", text, re.I):
        tags.add("comparison")
    if re.search(r"\b(?:fix|debug|repair|diagnose|inspect|audit|evaluate)\b", text, re.I):
        tags.add("diagnostic")
    if _PLANNING.search(text):
        tags.add("planning")
    if _CREATIVE.search(text):
        tags.add("creative")
    if _SELF_SYSTEM.search(text):
        tags.add("self_system")
    if web.needs_external_evidence:
        tags.add("research")
    if re.search(r"\b(?:think|believe|opinion|philosoph|consciousness|meaning|implication|judg(?:e|ment)|probability)\b", lower):
        tags.add("reflection")
    if re.search(r"\b(?:write|draft|rewrite|compose|make me|build|create|add|change|modify)\b", text, re.I):
        tags.add("instruction")
    if _FAST_LOCAL.match(text):
        tags.add("fast_local_fact")
    return tuple(sorted(tags or {"conversation"}))


def _domain_tags(text: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    tags: set[str] = set()
    if _TECHNICAL.search(text):
        tags.add("technical")
    if _SCIENCE.search(text):
        tags.add("science")
    if _CREATIVE.search(text):
        tags.add("creative")
    if re.search(r"\b(?:engineer|engineering|mechanical|electrical|structural|systems architecture|thermodynamic|fluid dynamics)\b", text, re.I):
        tags.add("engineering")
    if re.search(r"\b(?:math|mathematics|equation|calculus|algebra|geometry|statistics|probability|numerical)\b", text, re.I):
        tags.add("mathematics")
    if re.search(r"\b(?:physics|quantum|relativity|gravity|fusion|plasma|mechanics|electromagnet)\b", text, re.I):
        tags.add("physics")
    if re.search(r"\b(?:astronomy|astrophysics|cosmology|star|planet|galaxy|universe|orbital)\b", text, re.I):
        tags.add("astronomy")
    if re.search(r"\b(?:astrobiology|biosignature|habitable|extraterrestrial life|exoplanet life)\b", text, re.I):
        tags.add("astrobiology")
    if re.search(r"\b(?:botany|botanist|plants?|photosynthesis|horticulture|crops?|root systems?|soil)\b", text, re.I):
        tags.add("botany")
    if re.search(r"\b(?:medicine|medical|clinical|anatomy|physiology|diagnosis|symptom|disease)\b", text, re.I):
        tags.add("medical_science")
    if re.search(r"\b(?:business|company|grant|sbir|budget|market|revenue|customer)\b", text, re.I):
        tags.add("business")
    if re.search(r"\b(?:work|shift|operations|inbound|pallet|training|manager|team)\b", text, re.I):
        tags.add("operations")
    if re.search(r"\b(?:feel|friend|family|dog|relationship|personal|my life|i'm|i am)\b", text, re.I):
        tags.add("personal")
    return tuple(sorted(tags or {"general"}))


def _tone_tags(text: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    tags: set[str] = set()
    if _FRUSTRATION.search(text):
        tags.add("frustration_signal")
    if _EXCITEMENT.search(text):
        tags.add("excitement_signal")
    if _URGENCY.search(text):
        tags.add("urgency_signal")
    if re.search(r"\b(?:worried|concerned|afraid|nervous|scared|anxious)\b", text, re.I):
        tags.add("concern_signal")
    if re.search(r"\b(?:curious|wonder|interesting|intrigued)\b|\?$", text, re.I):
        tags.add("curiosity_signal")
    return tuple(sorted(tags or {"neutral"}))


def build_cognitive_profile(
    text: str,
    *,
    web_decision: WebDecision,
    history_context: str = "",
    available_nodes: tuple[str, ...] = (),
) -> CognitiveProfile:
    clean = " ".join(str(text or "").split())
    if not clean:
        raise ValueError("empty_cognitive_input")
    intents = _intent_tags(clean, web_decision)
    domains = _domain_tags(clean)
    tones = _tone_tags(clean)
    continuity = bool(history_context) or bool(_CONTINUITY.search(clean))
    token_count = len(re.findall(r"\w+", clean))
    ambiguity = bool(_AMBIGUOUS_DEICTIC.match(clean)) and not bool(history_context)
    self_system = "self_system" in intents
    risk_sensitive = bool(_RISK.search(clean))
    uncertainty = bool(web_decision.needs_external_evidence or ambiguity or risk_sensitive or _SPECULATION.search(clean))

    score = 0.16 + min(0.18, token_count / 420.0) + min(0.12, clean.count("?") * 0.04)
    if _DEEP.search(clean):
        score += 0.28
    if "technical" in domains or "science" in domains:
        score += 0.15
    if "comparison" in intents or "diagnostic" in intents or "planning" in intents:
        score += 0.12
    if web_decision.needs_external_evidence:
        score += 0.12
    if continuity:
        score += 0.06
    if self_system:
        score += 0.10
    if risk_sensitive:
        score += 0.12
    if ambiguity:
        score += 0.05
    if "social" in intents and token_count <= 12 and set(intents).issubset({"social", "question", "conversation"}):
        score = min(score, 0.24)
    if "fast_local_fact" in intents:
        score = min(score, 0.12)
    score = max(0.0, min(score, 1.0))
    depth = "light" if score < 0.30 else "standard" if score < 0.62 else "deep"

    if "fast_local_fact" in intents:
        style = "fast_local_fact"
    elif "social" in intents and depth == "light":
        style = "natural_social"
    elif "planning" in intents:
        style = "structured_planning"
    elif "creative" in intents and "technical" not in domains:
        style = "creative_synthesis"
    elif "technical" in domains or "diagnostic" in intents:
        style = "technical_analytical"
    elif "reflection" in intents:
        style = "reflective_analytical"
    else:
        style = "direct_analytical"

    requested = {"reasoning", "response_verification"}
    if continuity:
        requested.add("accepted_history")
    if web_decision.needs_external_evidence:
        requested.add("external_evidence")
    if self_system:
        requested.update({"runtime_introspection", "identity_grounding"})
    if "technical" in domains:
        requested.add("technical_reasoning")
    if "science" in domains:
        requested.add("scientific_reasoning")
    if "planning" in intents:
        requested.add("planning")
    if "creative" in intents:
        requested.add("creative_synthesis")
    if "fast_local_fact" in intents:
        requested.add("fast_local_fact")
    if uncertainty:
        requested.add("uncertainty_review")
    if risk_sensitive:
        requested.add("risk_sensitive_review")

    available = set(available_nodes)
    candidates = {
        "conversation.analysis",
        "conversation.history",
        "learning.experience",
        "evidence.gate",
        "reasoning.provider",
    }
    if web_decision.needs_external_evidence:
        candidates.add("evidence.web")
    if self_system:
        candidates.update({"registry.graph", "operations.status", "operations.doctor"})
    return CognitiveProfile(
        depth,
        round(score, 3),
        intents,
        domains,
        tones,
        continuity,
        ambiguity,
        self_system,
        web_decision.needs_external_evidence,
        uncertainty,
        risk_sensitive,
        style,
        tuple(sorted(candidates & available)),
        tuple(sorted(requested)),
        history_context,
        web_decision,
    )


class CognitiveAnalysisService:
    spec = ServiceSpec(
        "conversation.analysis",
        required=True,
        dependencies=("conversation.history", "evidence.web", "registry.graph", "kernel.events"),
    )

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._history = None
        self._web = None
        self._registry = None
        self._context = None
        self._state = ServiceState.DECLARED

    async def start(self, context: RuntimeContext) -> None:
        history = context.get_service("conversation.history")
        web = context.get_service("evidence.web")
        registry = context.get_service("registry.graph")
        if not isinstance(history, ConversationHistoryService):
            raise RuntimeError("conversation_history_authority_missing")
        if not isinstance(web, WebEvidenceService):
            raise RuntimeError("web_evidence_authority_missing")
        if not isinstance(registry, NodeRegistryService):
            raise RuntimeError("node_registry_authority_missing")
        self._history = history
        self._web = web
        self._registry = registry
        self._context = context
        self._state = ServiceState.READY

    async def stop(self) -> None:
        self._history = None
        self._web = None
        self._registry = None
        self._context = None
        self._state = ServiceState.STOPPED

    async def health(self) -> Health:
        return Health(self._state)

    async def analyze(self, text: str, correlation_id: str) -> CognitiveProfile:
        if self._state != ServiceState.READY or self._history is None or self._web is None or self._registry is None:
            raise RuntimeError("cognitive_analysis_not_ready")
        profile = build_cognitive_profile(
            text,
            web_decision=self._web.analyze(text),
            history_context=self._history.cognition_context(text, limit=4),
            available_nodes=tuple(str(row["name"]) for row in self._registry.snapshot()["nodes"]),
        )
        if self._context is not None:
            await self._context.publish(Event("conversation.analysis.completed", profile.as_dict(), correlation_id))
        return profile

from typing import Any

class ConversationCommitService:
    """Single post-verification accepted-state authority.

    Accepted history, last-turn memory, and agency metadata are persisted in one
    StateStore transaction through MemoryService.remember_many(). Candidate text can
    never write accepted state through this service before verification/identity pass.
    """

    spec = ServiceSpec(
        "conversation.commit",
        required=True,
        dependencies=("kernel.events", "memory.service", "conversation.history"),
    )

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._context: RuntimeContext | None = None
        self._memory: MemoryService | None = None
        self._history: ConversationHistoryService | None = None
        self._state = ServiceState.DECLARED
        self._accepted = 0

    async def start(self, context: RuntimeContext) -> None:
        memory = context.get_service("memory.service")
        history = context.get_service("conversation.history")
        if not isinstance(memory, MemoryService):
            raise RuntimeError("canonical_memory_service_missing")
        if not isinstance(history, ConversationHistoryService):
            raise RuntimeError("canonical_conversation_history_missing")
        self._context = context
        self._memory = memory
        self._history = history
        self._state = ServiceState.READY

    async def stop(self) -> None:
        self._context = None
        self._memory = None
        self._history = None
        self._state = ServiceState.STOPPED

    async def health(self) -> Health:
        return Health(self._state, f"accepted_commits={self._accepted}")

    async def commit(
        self,
        user_text: str,
        response: str,
        correlation_id: str,
        *,
        active_nodes: tuple[str, ...] = (),
        capability_ids: tuple[str, ...] = (),
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if (
            self._state != ServiceState.READY
            or self._context is None
            or self._memory is None
            or self._history is None
        ):
            raise RuntimeError("conversation_commit_not_ready")
        clean_user = str(user_text or "").strip()
        clean_response = str(response or "").strip()
        if not clean_user or not clean_response:
            raise ValueError("accepted_turn_text_required")

        history_row, serialized_history = self._history.prepare_commit(
            clean_user, clean_response, correlation_id
        )
        accepted_at = history_row.accepted_at
        receipt = {
            "schema": "eira2_accepted_commit_v2",
            "correlation_id": str(correlation_id),
            "accepted_at": accepted_at,
            "user_characters": len(clean_user),
            "response_characters": len(clean_response),
            "active_nodes": list(sorted(set(active_nodes))),
            "capability_ids": list(sorted(set(capability_ids))),
            "atomic_persistence": True,
        }
        last_turn = {
            **receipt,
            "user": clean_user[:12000],
            "response": clean_response[:24000],
        }
        agency = {
            "correlation_id": str(correlation_id),
            "active_nodes": receipt["active_nodes"],
            "capability_ids": receipt["capability_ids"],
            "accepted_at": accepted_at,
        }

        # One call -> one StateStore.put_many() -> one SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE.
        # Nothing is installed into in-memory history until this transaction commits.
        self._memory.remember_many((
            (self._history.storage_key, serialized_history),
            ("accepted.last_turn", last_turn),
            ("agency.last_commit", agency),
        ))
        await self._history.install_committed(history_row)
        self._accepted += 1

        await self._context.publish(Event("conversation.memory.committed", {
            "accepted": True,
            "user_characters": len(clean_user),
            "response_characters": len(clean_response),
            "atomic_persistence": True,
        }, correlation_id))
        await self._context.publish(Event("conversation.agency.committed", {
            "active_nodes": receipt["active_nodes"],
            "capability_ids": receipt["capability_ids"],
            "atomic_persistence": True,
        }, correlation_id))
        await self._context.publish(Event("conversation.response.telemetry", {
            "accepted": True,
            "characters": len(clean_response),
            "capability_count": len(receipt["capability_ids"]),
            "contains_text": False,
        }, correlation_id))
        return receipt

    def last_commit(self) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        if self._memory is None:
            raise RuntimeError("conversation_commit_not_ready")
        value = self._memory.recall("agency.last_commit")
        return dict(value) if isinstance(value, dict) else None

    def capability_bindings(self) -> tuple[CapabilityBinding, ...]:
        async def status(_: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
            return {
                "accepted_commit_count": self._accepted,
                "last_commit": self.last_commit(),
                "candidate_can_commit": False,
                "response_text_in_telemetry": False,
                "accepted_state_atomic": True,
            }

        return (
            CapabilityBinding(
                id="conversation.commit.status",
                implementation_node=self.spec.name,
                aliases=("commit status", "accepted memory status", "agency commit status"),
                tags=("runtime_introspection", "accepted_history"),
                handler=status,
                description="Inspect post-verification atomic memory/agency commit state.",
                read_only=True,
                auto_safe=False,
                shadow_safe=True,
            ),
        )
