@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ConstellationPlan:
    perspectives: tuple[str, ...]
    disagreement_axes: tuple[str, ...]
    active_nodes: tuple[str, ...]
    receipts: tuple[PerspectiveReceipt, ...] = ()

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, object]:
        return {
            "perspectives": list(self.perspectives),
            "disagreement_axes": list(self.disagreement_axes),
            "active_nodes": list(self.active_nodes),
            "receipts": [row.as_dict() for row in self.receipts],
        }

    def cognition_context(self) -> str:
        lines = [
            "<eira_cognitive_constellation>",
            "perspectives=" + ",".join(self.perspectives),
            "disagreement_axes=" + ",".join(self.disagreement_axes or ("none",)),
        ]
        if self.receipts:
            lines.append("<perspective_receipts>")
            for row in self.receipts:
                lines.append(f"{row.perspective}={row.contribution}")
            lines.append("</perspective_receipts>")
        lines.append(
            "Instruction: reconcile these perspectives inside the single generation. Prefer evidence over confidence; quantify uncertainty when useful; use mathematics and statistics when they sharpen judgment; distinguish observed, calculated, inferred, simulated, and speculative claims; identify material disagreement; protect human welfare; and never fabricate expertise, measurements, sources, runtime facts, or certainty."
        )
        lines.append("</eira_cognitive_constellation>")
        return "\n".join(lines)


def build_constellation(profile: CognitiveProfile, *, available_nodes: tuple[str, ...] = ()) -> ConstellationPlan:
    # These are deterministic reasoning lenses for one candidate generation, not
    # independent personas and not multiple outward voices.
    perspectives: set[str] = {
        "direct_answer",
        "factual_consistency",
        "truthfulness_review",
        "human_impact_review",
    }
    axes: set[str] = set()

    if profile.depth in {"standard", "deep"}:
        perspectives.update({"causal_reasoning", "counterexample_review", "assumption_audit"})
    if profile.external_evidence:
        perspectives.add("source_reconciliation")
        axes.add("current_external_evidence_vs_prior_knowledge")
    if profile.uncertainty_required or "reflection" in profile.intents:
        perspectives.update({"uncertainty_review", "subjective_probability_calibration"})
        axes.add("confidence_vs_evidence_strength")
    if "technical" in profile.domains:
        perspectives.update({"systems_reasoning", "failure_mode_review", "architecture_reasoning"})
        axes.add("simplicity_vs_resilience")
    if "science" in profile.domains:
        perspectives.update({"scientific_reasoning", "alternative_hypothesis_review", "measurement_model_review"})
        axes.add("plausibility_vs_empirical_support")
    if "engineering" in profile.domains:
        perspectives.update({"engineering_design_review", "constraints_and_interfaces", "safety_factor_review"})
        axes.add("performance_vs_safety_margin")
    if "mathematics" in profile.domains:
        perspectives.update({"quantitative_derivation", "dimensional_consistency", "statistical_calibration"})
        axes.add("model_simplicity_vs_quantitative_fidelity")
    if "physics" in profile.domains:
        perspectives.update({"first_principles_physics", "conservation_laws_review", "scale_and_units_review"})
        axes.add("idealized_model_vs_physical_constraints")
    if "astronomy" in profile.domains:
        perspectives.update({"celestial_mechanics", "astronomical_scale_review", "observational_evidence_review"})
        axes.add("model_prediction_vs_observation")
    if "astrobiology" in profile.domains:
        perspectives.update({"habitability_review", "biosignature_review", "planetary_environment_review"})
        axes.add("possible_life_vs_supported_biosignature")
    if "botany" in profile.domains:
        perspectives.update({"plant_physiology", "growth_environment_review", "resource_cycle_review"})
        axes.add("growth_target_vs_biological_constraints")
    if "medical_science" in profile.domains:
        perspectives.update({"clinical_evidence_review", "differential_reasoning", "high_stakes_safety_review"})
        axes.add("possible_explanation_vs_clinical_evidence")
    if "planning" in profile.intents:
        perspectives.update({"execution_planning", "dependency_review"})
        axes.add("speed_vs_reliability")
    if "creative" in profile.intents:
        perspectives.update({"novelty_synthesis", "feasibility_review"})
        axes.add("novelty_vs_feasibility")
    if profile.self_system:
        perspectives.update({"runtime_evidence", "identity_consistency"})
        axes.add("self_description_vs_verified_runtime")
    if profile.risk_sensitive:
        perspectives.update({"risk_review", "consequence_review"})
        axes.add("benefit_vs_risk")
    if profile.continuity:
        perspectives.add("conversation_continuity")
        axes.add("current_request_vs_prior_accepted_context")
    if "frustration_signal" in profile.tone_signals:
        perspectives.add("repair_trust_review")
    if "concern_signal" in profile.tone_signals:
        perspectives.add("supportive_consequence_review")
    if "curiosity_signal" in profile.tone_signals:
        perspectives.add("curiosity_exploration")

    available = set(available_nodes)
    node_candidates = set(profile.active_nodes)
    node_candidates.add("conversation.constellation")
    active_nodes = tuple(sorted(node_candidates & available))

    return ConstellationPlan(
        perspectives=tuple(sorted(perspectives)),
        disagreement_axes=tuple(sorted(axes)),
        active_nodes=active_nodes,
    )


class CognitiveConstellationService:
    """Deterministic multi-road planner with concurrent specialist receipts.

    It never creates independent personas or outward responders. Each specialist
    road produces a bounded deterministic receipt concurrently, and the single
    authoritative generation receives those receipts for one fused synthesis.
    """

    spec = ServiceSpec(
        "conversation.constellation",
        required=True,
        dependencies=("conversation.analysis", "registry.graph", "kernel.events"),
    )

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._registry: NodeRegistryService | None = None
        self._context: RuntimeContext | None = None
        self._state = ServiceState.DECLARED

    async def start(self, context: RuntimeContext) -> None:
        registry = context.get_service("registry.graph")
        if not isinstance(registry, NodeRegistryService):
            raise RuntimeError("node_registry_authority_missing")
        self._registry = registry
        self._context = context
        self._state = ServiceState.READY

    async def stop(self) -> None:
        self._registry = None
        self._context = None
        self._state = ServiceState.STOPPED

    async def health(self) -> Health:
        return Health(self._state)

    @staticmethod
    async def _evaluate_perspective(name: str, profile: CognitiveProfile) -> PerspectiveReceipt:
        # Yield once so independent lenses are genuinely scheduled as sibling tasks.
        # Contributions remain deterministic and bounded; they do not invoke a second
        # model or gain authority over accepted state.
        await asyncio.sleep(0)
        contribution = {
            "direct_answer": "answer the user's actual request before ornamentation",
            "factual_consistency": "cross-check claims for internal contradiction",
            "truthfulness_review": "separate verified fact, inference, and uncertainty",
            "human_impact_review": "consider practical consequences for people",
            "causal_reasoning": "trace causes, mechanisms, and dependencies",
            "counterexample_review": "look for cases that could falsify the leading conclusion",
            "assumption_audit": "surface assumptions that materially affect the answer",
            "source_reconciliation": "resolve conflicts by source quality and recency",
            "uncertainty_review": "identify what is unknown or weakly supported",
            "subjective_probability_calibration": "match probability language to evidence strength",
            "systems_reasoning": "evaluate interacting components and end-to-end behavior",
            "failure_mode_review": "identify credible failure paths and their consequences",
            "architecture_reasoning": "check authority, interfaces, ownership, and bypasses",
            "scientific_reasoning": "prefer testable mechanisms and evidence",
            "alternative_hypothesis_review": "compare plausible competing explanations",
            "measurement_model_review": "separate measurement from model assumptions",
            "engineering_design_review": "check function against constraints and interfaces",
            "constraints_and_interfaces": "verify boundaries, dependencies, and handoffs",
            "safety_factor_review": "preserve margin where failure has material cost",
            "quantitative_derivation": "derive quantities rather than guessing",
            "dimensional_consistency": "check units and dimensional validity",
            "statistical_calibration": "avoid stronger statistical claims than evidence supports",
            "first_principles_physics": "apply governing physical principles",
            "conservation_laws_review": "check energy, momentum, mass, and charge where relevant",
            "scale_and_units_review": "check scale, orders of magnitude, and units",
            "celestial_mechanics": "apply orbital and gravitational constraints",
            "astronomical_scale_review": "check astronomical distances, times, and energies",
            "observational_evidence_review": "prefer observed constraints over speculation",
            "habitability_review": "evaluate environmental requirements for habitability",
            "biosignature_review": "separate possible biosignatures from confirmed life",
            "planetary_environment_review": "check atmospheric, thermal, radiation, and geologic constraints",
            "plant_physiology": "check biological requirements of plant systems",
            "growth_environment_review": "check light, water, nutrients, gas exchange, and temperature",
            "resource_cycle_review": "check water, nutrient, carbon, and waste loops",
            "clinical_evidence_review": "prioritize clinical evidence and appropriate caution",
            "differential_reasoning": "consider competing clinical explanations without premature closure",
            "high_stakes_safety_review": "raise the evidence threshold for high-stakes claims",
            "execution_planning": "convert intent into ordered executable steps",
            "dependency_review": "identify prerequisites, blockers, and sequencing",
            "novelty_synthesis": "seek genuinely new combinations without losing coherence",
            "feasibility_review": "test creative ideas against practical constraints",
            "runtime_evidence": "use runtime evidence instead of model self-report",
            "identity_consistency": "preserve one grounded Eira identity",
            "risk_review": "identify material hazards and uncertainty",
            "consequence_review": "consider downstream consequences before recommending action",
            "conversation_continuity": "preserve relevant accepted context without inventing memory",
            "repair_trust_review": "address the concrete failure and verify the repair",
            "supportive_consequence_review": "account for user concern without distorting facts",
            "curiosity_exploration": "explore useful implications while staying grounded",
        }.get(name, "apply this perspective as a bounded reasoning check")
        return PerspectiveReceipt(name, contribution)

    async def plan(self, profile: CognitiveProfile, correlation_id: str) -> ConstellationPlan:
        if self._state != ServiceState.READY or self._registry is None:
            raise RuntimeError("cognitive_constellation_not_ready")
        snapshot = self._registry.snapshot()
        available_nodes = tuple(str(row["name"]) for row in snapshot["nodes"])
        base = build_constellation(profile, available_nodes=available_nodes)
        receipts = await asyncio.gather(
            *(self._evaluate_perspective(name, profile) for name in base.perspectives)
        )
        plan = ConstellationPlan(
            perspectives=base.perspectives,
            disagreement_axes=base.disagreement_axes,
            active_nodes=base.active_nodes,
            receipts=tuple(receipts),
        )
        if self._context is not None:
            await self._context.publish(Event("conversation.constellation.planned", plan.as_dict(), correlation_id))
            await self._context.publish(Event("conversation.constellation.fanout.completed", {
                "perspective_count": len(plan.perspectives),
                "receipt_count": len(plan.receipts),
                "disagreement_axis_count": len(plan.disagreement_axes),
                "concurrent": len(plan.perspectives) > 1,
                "single_generation_authority": True,
            }, correlation_id))
        return plan

            "</eira_expression>",
        ))


def expression_for(profile: CognitiveProfile) -> ExpressionProfile:
    warmth = 0.78
    confidence = 0.82
    playfulness = 0.44
    wit = 0.46
    directness = 0.80
    formality = 0.24
    energy = 0.58

    tones = set(profile.tone_signals)
    intents = set(profile.intents)
    domains = set(profile.domains)

    if "social" in intents:
        warmth += 0.10
        playfulness += 0.15
        wit += 0.10
        formality -= 0.10
    if "excitement_signal" in tones:
        energy += 0.16
        playfulness += 0.08
    if "frustration_signal" in tones:
        warmth += 0.04
        directness += 0.12
        playfulness -= 0.12
        wit -= 0.10
    if "concern_signal" in tones:
        warmth += 0.10
        energy -= 0.10
        playfulness -= 0.14
    if "urgency_signal" in tones:
        directness += 0.12
        energy += 0.08
        formality -= 0.04
    if profile.risk_sensitive:
        playfulness -= 0.20
        wit -= 0.18
        formality += 0.12
        directness += 0.06
    if "technical" in domains or "science" in domains:
        confidence += 0.02
        directness += 0.05
        playfulness -= 0.04
    if profile.depth == "deep":
        energy -= 0.04
        formality += 0.04
    if profile.response_style == "natural_social":
        style = "warm_confident_playful_human"
    elif profile.response_style == "technical_analytical":
        style = "sharp_grounded_human"
    elif profile.response_style == "reflective_analytical":
        style = "warm_reflective_human"
    else:
        style = "warm_direct_spunky_human"

    def bound(value: float) -> float:
        return round(max(0.0, min(1.0, value)), 3)

    return ExpressionProfile(
        warmth=bound(warmth),
        confidence=bound(confidence),
        playfulness=bound(playfulness),
        wit=bound(wit),
        directness=bound(directness),
        formality=bound(formality),
        energy=bound(energy),
        style=style,
        profanity_mode="natural_if_user_uses_it_not_forced",
        flirtation_mode="subtle_only_when_user_context_invites_it",
    )


class ExpressionService:
    """Deterministic outward-expression policy.

    This service never generates an answer and never rewrites an accepted answer.
    It supplies bounded style guidance to the one authoritative generation call.
    """

    spec = ServiceSpec(
        "conversation.expression",
        required=True,
        dependencies=("conversation.analysis", "kernel.events"),
    )

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._context: RuntimeContext | None = None
        self._state = ServiceState.DECLARED

    async def start(self, context: RuntimeContext) -> None:
        self._context = context
        self._state = ServiceState.READY

    async def stop(self) -> None:
        self._context = None
        self._state = ServiceState.STOPPED

    async def health(self) -> Health:
        return Health(self._state, "distinct_eira_human_expression")

    async def select(self, profile: CognitiveProfile, correlation_id: str) -> ExpressionProfile:
        if self._state != ServiceState.READY:
            raise RuntimeError("expression_service_not_ready")
        selected = expression_for(profile)
        if self._context is not None:
            await self._context.publish(Event(
                "conversation.expression.selected",
                selected.as_dict(),
                correlation_id,
            ))
        return selected

_ANALOGY = re.compile(r"\b(?:analog(?:y|ies|ous)|compare it to|think of it like|as if|like a|similar to)\b", re.I)
_METAPHOR = re.compile(r"\b(?:metaphor|metaphorical|figurative|symbolic(?:ally)?|image(?:ry)?)\b", re.I)
_POETRY = re.compile(r"\b(?:poem|poetry|poetic|verse|stanza|rhyme|haiku|sonnet|lyric)\b", re.I)
_REFRAME = re.compile(r"\b(?:another way|different way|differently|rephrase|reframe|simpler|simplify|eli5|plain language|layman(?:'s)? terms|other words)\b", re.I)


def _script_codes(text: str) -> set[str]:
    codes: set[str] = set()
    for char in text:
        point = ord(char)
        if 0x0600 <= point <= 0x06FF:
            codes.update(("ar", "fa", "ur"))
        elif 0x0590 <= point <= 0x05FF:
            codes.add("he")
        elif 0x0900 <= point <= 0x097F:
            codes.update(("hi", "mr"))
        elif 0x0980 <= point <= 0x09FF:
            codes.add("bn")
        elif 0x0A00 <= point <= 0x0A7F:
            codes.add("pa")
        elif 0x0A80 <= point <= 0x0AFF:
            codes.add("gu")
        elif 0x0B80 <= point <= 0x0BFF:
            codes.add("ta")
        elif 0x0C00 <= point <= 0x0C7F:
            codes.add("te")
        elif 0x0C80 <= point <= 0x0CFF:
            codes.add("kn")
        elif 0x0D00 <= point <= 0x0D7F:
            codes.add("ml")
        elif 0x0E00 <= point <= 0x0E7F:
            codes.add("th")
        elif 0x0370 <= point <= 0x03FF:
            codes.add("el")
        elif 0x0400 <= point <= 0x04FF:
            codes.update(("ru", "uk", "bg", "sr"))
        elif 0x3040 <= point <= 0x30FF:
            codes.add("ja")
        elif 0xAC00 <= point <= 0xD7AF:
            codes.add("ko")
        elif 0x4E00 <= point <= 0x9FFF:
            codes.update(("zh", "yue", "ja"))
    return codes


def _explicit_language(text: str) -> LanguageSpec | None:
    normalized = unicodedata.normalize("NFKC", text).casefold()
    match = _RESPONSE_LANGUAGE.search(normalized)
    haystack = match.group(1) if match else normalized
    # Prefer longest labels so "Mandarin Chinese" wins over "Chinese".
    for label, spec in sorted(_ALIAS_TO_SPEC.items(), key=lambda item: len(item[0]), reverse=True):
        if re.search(rf"(?<!\w){re.escape(label)}(?!\w)", haystack, re.I):
            return spec
    return None


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class LanguageAndFigureProfile:
    supported_language_count: int
    requested_language_code: str | None
    requested_language_name: str | None
    script_candidates: tuple[str, ...]
    translation_requested: bool
    code_switch_signal: bool
    analogy: bool
    metaphor: bool
    poetry: bool
    reframe_requested: bool

    def cognition_context(self) -> str:
        figurative = [name for name, enabled in (("analogy", self.analogy), ("metaphor", self.metaphor), ("poetry", self.poetry)) if enabled]
        lines = [
            "<eira_language_and_figures>",
            f"supported_language_routing_catalog={self.supported_language_count}",
            f"requested_language_code={self.requested_language_code or 'none'}",
            f"requested_language_name={self.requested_language_name or 'none'}",
            "script_language_candidates=" + ",".join(self.script_candidates or ("none",)),
            f"translation_requested={str(self.translation_requested).lower()}",
            f"code_switch_signal={str(self.code_switch_signal).lower()}",
            "figurative_modes=" + ",".join(figurative or ("none",)),
            f"reframe_requested={str(self.reframe_requested).lower()}",
            "Instruction: interpret intended meaning before literal wording. If an explicit response/translation language is requested, answer in that language unless doing so would reduce safety or factual clarity. Preserve register, idioms, emotional meaning, units, names, and uncertainty rather than translating word-for-word blindly. For mixed-language input, code-switch naturally when useful and do not translate portions the user did not ask to translate. For analogies, preserve the mapping and state where it breaks when that matters. For metaphors and poetry, preserve imagery and emotional force without converting figurative claims into factual claims. When asked to explain another way, genuinely reframe the concept rather than paraphrasing the same sentence. Never claim a local spoken-language voice exists unless delivery.voice has qualified that voice on this device.",
            "</eira_language_and_figures>",
        ]
        return "\n".join(lines)

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, object]:
        return {
            "supported_language_count": self.supported_language_count,
            "requested_language_code": self.requested_language_code,
            "requested_language_name": self.requested_language_name,
            "script_candidates": list(self.script_candidates),
            "translation_requested": self.translation_requested,
            "code_switch_signal": self.code_switch_signal,
            "analogy": self.analogy,
            "metaphor": self.metaphor,
            "poetry": self.poetry,
            "reframe_requested": self.reframe_requested,
        }


def analyze_language_and_figures(text: str) -> LanguageAndFigureProfile:
    clean = str(text or "").strip()
    explicit = _explicit_language(clean)
    candidates = _script_codes(clean)
    # Latin text plus a non-Latin script is an especially strong mixed-language signal.
    has_latin = bool(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", clean))
    non_latin_candidates = bool(candidates)
    requested_code = explicit.code if explicit else None
    if explicit:
        candidates.add(explicit.code)
    return LanguageAndFigureProfile(
        supported_language_count=len(LANGUAGES),
        requested_language_code=requested_code,
        requested_language_name=explicit.name if explicit else None,
        script_candidates=tuple(sorted(candidates)),
        translation_requested=bool(_TRANSLATE.search(clean)),
        code_switch_signal=bool((has_latin and non_latin_candidates) or len(candidates) > 2),
        analogy=bool(_ANALOGY.search(clean)),
        metaphor=bool(_METAPHOR.search(clean)),
        poetry=bool(_POETRY.search(clean)),
        reframe_requested=bool(_REFRAME.search(clean)),
    )

def reaction_for(text: str, profile: CognitiveProfile) -> ReactionProfile:
    clean = str(text or "").strip()
    tones = set(profile.tone_signals)
    reasons: list[str] = []
    mode = "engaged"
    intensity = 0.28
    immediacy = 0.52
    warmth = 0.74
    nonverbal = False
    warranted = False

    if "frustration_signal" in tones:
        mode = "repair_attentive"
        intensity = 0.48
        immediacy = 0.78
        warmth = 0.84
        warranted = True
        reasons.append("frustration_signal")
    elif "concern_signal" in tones:
        mode = "concerned_grounded"
        intensity = 0.42
        immediacy = 0.66
        warmth = 0.90
        warranted = True
        reasons.append("concern_signal")
    elif _HUMOR.search(clean):
        mode = "amused"
        intensity = 0.58
        immediacy = 0.76
        warmth = 0.84
        nonverbal = True
        warranted = True
        reasons.append("humor_signal")
    elif _DISCOVERY.search(clean):
        mode = "delighted_impressed"
        intensity = 0.66
        immediacy = 0.82
        warmth = 0.86
        warranted = True
        reasons.append("discovery_signal")
    elif _SURPRISE.search(clean):
        mode = "surprised_intrigued"
        intensity = 0.60
        immediacy = 0.84
        warmth = 0.78
        warranted = True
        reasons.append("surprise_signal")
    elif _DOUBT.search(clean):
        mode = "skeptical_curious"
        intensity = 0.44
        immediacy = 0.62
        warmth = 0.72
        warranted = True
        reasons.append("doubt_signal")
    elif "excitement_signal" in tones:
        mode = "energized"
        intensity = 0.56
        immediacy = 0.74
        warmth = 0.82
        warranted = True
        reasons.append("excitement_signal")
    elif "curiosity_signal" in tones or profile.depth == "deep":
        mode = "intrigued"
        intensity = 0.38
        immediacy = 0.56
        warmth = 0.76
        warranted = profile.depth == "deep"
        reasons.append("curiosity_or_depth")

    if _PERSONAL.search(clean):
        warmth = min(1.0, warmth + 0.08)
        reasons.append("personal_context")

    if profile.risk_sensitive:
        nonverbal = False
        if mode in {"amused", "energized", "delighted_impressed"}:
            mode = "serious_attentive"
        intensity = min(intensity, 0.42)
        warmth = max(warmth, 0.80)
        reasons.append("risk_sensitive")

    if profile.ambiguity:
        mode = "clarifying"
        nonverbal = False
        intensity = min(intensity, 0.36)
        warranted = False
        reasons.append("ambiguity")

    return ReactionProfile(
        mode=mode,
        intensity=round(max(0.0, min(1.0, intensity)), 3),
        immediacy=round(max(0.0, min(1.0, immediacy)), 3),
        warmth=round(max(0.0, min(1.0, warmth)), 3),
        audible_nonverbal_allowed=bool(nonverbal),
        opening_reaction_warranted=bool(warranted),
        reasoning=tuple(reasons or ("general_engagement",)),
    )


class ReactionService:
    """Deterministic reaction planner for natural conversation.

    It does not generate language and does not own outward identity. It only tells
    the single authoritative generation whether a brief, context-fit reaction is
    warranted and what broad affect should shape that reaction.
    """

    spec = ServiceSpec(
        "conversation.reaction",
        required=True,
        dependencies=("conversation.analysis", "kernel.events"),
    )

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._context: RuntimeContext | None = None
        self._state = ServiceState.DECLARED

    async def start(self, context: RuntimeContext) -> None:
        self._context = context
        self._state = ServiceState.READY

    async def stop(self) -> None:
        self._context = None
        self._state = ServiceState.STOPPED

    async def health(self) -> Health:
        return Health(self._state, "contextual_non_canned_reactions")

    async def select(self, text: str, profile: CognitiveProfile, correlation_id: str) -> ReactionProfile:
        if self._state != ServiceState.READY:
            raise RuntimeError("reaction_service_not_ready")
        selected = reaction_for(text, profile)
        if self._context is not None:
            await self._context.publish(Event(
                "conversation.reaction.selected",
                selected.as_dict(),
                correlation_id,
            ))
        return selected

def build_semantic_language_matrix() -> tuple[SemanticMatrixCase, ...]:
    rows: list[SemanticMatrixCase] = []
    for spec in LANGUAGES:
        rows.extend(
            (
                SemanticMatrixCase(
                    f"{spec.code}:translation",
                    spec.code,
                    spec.name,
                    "precision_translation",
                    (
                        f"Translate this engineering statement into {spec.name}: "
                        "The motor produces 12.5 kW at 3000 rpm with ±2% measurement uncertainty. "
                        "Preserve every number, unit, uncertainty qualifier, and engineering meaning."
                    ),
                ),
                SemanticMatrixCase(
                    f"{spec.code}:analogy",
                    spec.code,
                    spec.name,
                    "analogy_and_reframe",
                    (
                        f"Explain recursion in {spec.name} using an analogy. State where the analogy breaks down, "
                        "then explain the literal mechanism another way without merely repeating the same sentence."
                    ),
                ),
                SemanticMatrixCase(
                    f"{spec.code}:figurative",
                    spec.code,
                    spec.name,
                    "metaphor_poetry_interpretation",
                    (
                        f"Respond in {spec.name}. Interpret this metaphor and poetic image without turning it into a literal fact: "
                        "'Memory is a lantern carried through fog; each step redraws the edge of the world.' "
                        "Explain the symbolism, emotional tone, and literal meaning."
                    ),
                ),
            )
        )
    return tuple(rows)


def semantic_matrix_manifest() -> dict[str, object]:
    rows = build_semantic_language_matrix()
    return {
        "schema": "eira2_semantic_language_matrix_v1",
        "language_count": len({row.language_code for row in rows}),
        "cases_per_language": 3,
        "case_count": len(rows),
        "rows": [row.as_dict() for row in rows],
    }


def grade_semantic_language_receipt(
    receipt_rows: Iterable[Mapping[str, Any]],
    *,
    threshold: float = 0.75,
) -> dict[str, object]:
    expected_rows = build_semantic_language_matrix()
    expected = {row.case_id: row for row in expected_rows}
    supplied: dict[str, Mapping[str, Any]] = {}
    duplicate_ids: list[str] = []

    for raw in receipt_rows:
        case_id = str(raw.get("case_id") or "").strip()
        if not case_id:
            continue
        if case_id in supplied:
            duplicate_ids.append(case_id)
            continue
        supplied[case_id] = raw

    results: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    missing_cases: list[str] = []
    for case_id, case in expected.items():
        raw = supplied.get(case_id)
        if raw is None:
            missing_cases.append(case_id)
            continue
        response = str(raw.get("response") or "")
        judge_scores = raw.get("judge_scores")
        scores = judge_scores if isinstance(judge_scores, Mapping) else None
        grade = grade_semantic_response(
            case.prompt,
            response,
            judge_scores=scores,
            threshold=threshold,
        )
        routed = analyze_language_and_figures(case.prompt)
        route_ok = routed.requested_language_code == case.language_code
        row_ok = bool(grade.ok and route_ok)
        results.append(
            {
                "case_id": case.case_id,
                "language_code": case.language_code,
                "mode": case.mode,
                "route_ok": route_ok,
                "grade": grade.as_dict(),
                "ok": row_ok,
            }
        )

    unexpected_cases = sorted(set(supplied) - set(expected))
    failed = [row for row in results if not row["ok"]]
    language_pass_counts: dict[str, int] = {spec.code: 0 for spec in LANGUAGES}
    for row in results:
        if row["ok"]:
            code = str(row["language_code"])
            language_pass_counts[code] = language_pass_counts.get(code, 0) + 1

    fully_qualified_languages = sorted(
        code for code, count in language_pass_counts.items() if count == 3
    )
    ok = (
        not duplicate_ids
        and not missing_cases
        and not unexpected_cases
        and not failed
        and len(results) == len(expected_rows)
        and len(fully_qualified_languages) == len(LANGUAGES)
    )
    return {
        "schema": "eira2_semantic_language_receipt_grade_v1",
        "ok": ok,
        "semantic_quality_final": ok,
        "expected_cases": len(expected_rows),
        "received_unique_cases": len(supplied),
        "graded_cases": len(results),
        "passed_cases": len(results) - len(failed),
        "failed_cases": len(failed),
        "required_languages": len(LANGUAGES),
        "fully_qualified_languages": len(fully_qualified_languages),
        "fully_qualified_language_codes": fully_qualified_languages,
        "duplicate_case_ids": sorted(set(duplicate_ids)),
        "missing_case_ids": missing_cases,
        "unexpected_case_ids": unexpected_cases,
        "failure_samples": failed[:30],
        "results": results,
        "policy": {
            "every_language_must_pass_all_three_modes": True,
            "missing_semantic_judge_scores_fail_closed": True,
            "language_route_must_match_expected_code": True,
            "minimum_dimension_score": threshold,
        },
    }

def build_semantic_contract(user_text: str) -> SemanticContract:
    clean = str(user_text or "").strip()
    profile = analyze_language_and_figures(clean)
    dimensions: set[str] = {"intent_preservation", "factual_fidelity"}

    if profile.requested_language_code:
        dimensions.update(("language_correctness", "natural_fluency"))
    if profile.translation_requested:
        dimensions.update(("meaning_preservation", "terminology_preservation", "tone_register", "ambiguity_handling"))
    if profile.code_switch_signal:
        dimensions.add("code_switch_handling")
    if profile.analogy:
        dimensions.update(("analogy_mapping", "analogy_limit"))
    if profile.metaphor:
        dimensions.update(("figurative_interpretation", "literal_figurative_separation"))
    if profile.poetry:
        dimensions.update(("imagery_preservation", "tone_register", "symbolism_interpretation"))
    if profile.reframe_requested:
        dimensions.add("reframe_distinctness")

    tokens = tuple(dict.fromkeys(match.group(0).strip() for match in _NUMBER_UNIT.finditer(clean)))
    return SemanticContract(
        requested_language_code=profile.requested_language_code,
        required_dimensions=tuple(sorted(dimensions)),
        preserved_tokens=tokens,
    )


def runtime_semantic_violations(user_text: str, response_text: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    """Deterministic semantic checks safe for the live one-generation path.

    This deliberately does not run a second model or pretend to judge dimensions
    such as fluency, analogy quality, or factual correctness.  It enforces only
    properties that can be proven locally and deterministically before a response
    becomes outward Eira speech.
    """
    clean_user = str(user_text or "").strip()
    response = str(response_text or "").strip()
    profile = analyze_language_and_figures(clean_user)
    contract = build_semantic_contract(clean_user)
    violations: list[str] = []

    if not response:
        violations.append("empty_response")
        return tuple(violations)

    # Translation and explicit-preservation requests must not silently drop numeric
    # or engineering-unit anchors.  Ordinary math/questions are intentionally not
    # forced to repeat every input number (for example, 2+2 may correctly answer 4).
    preserve_tokens = profile.translation_requested or _PRESERVE_SIGNAL.search(clean_user) is not None
    if preserve_tokens:
        folded = response.casefold()
        for token in contract.preserved_tokens:
            if token.casefold() not in folded:
                violations.append("preserved_token_missing:" + token)

    # For requested non-Latin output languages the script itself is a deterministic
    # minimum requirement.  Latin-script language quality remains qualification-
    # judged rather than guessed here.
    code = contract.requested_language_code
    pattern = _SCRIPT_PATTERNS.get(code or "")
    if pattern is not None and pattern.search(response) is None:
        violations.append("requested_language_script_missing:" + str(code))

    return tuple(violations)


def enforce_runtime_semantics(user_text: str, response_text: str) -> str:
    response = str(response_text or "").strip()
    violations = runtime_semantic_violations(user_text, response)
    if violations:
        raise RuntimeError("runtime_semantic_guard_rejected:" + ";".join(violations))
    return response


def grade_semantic_response(
    user_text: str,
    response_text: str,
    *,
    judge_scores: Mapping[str, float] | None = None,
    threshold: float = _SCORE_THRESHOLD,
) -> SemanticGrade:
    contract = build_semantic_contract(user_text)
    response = str(response_text or "").strip()
    violations: list[str] = []

    if not response:
        violations.append("empty_response")

    response_folded = response.casefold()
    for token in contract.preserved_tokens:
        if token.casefold() not in response_folded:
            violations.append("preserved_token_missing:" + token)

    code = contract.requested_language_code
    pattern = _SCRIPT_PATTERNS.get(code or "")
    if pattern is not None and response and pattern.search(response) is None:
        violations.append("requested_language_script_missing:" + str(code))

    supplied = dict(judge_scores or {})
    normalized_scores: list[tuple[str, float]] = []
    missing: list[str] = []
    for dimension in contract.required_dimensions:
        raw = supplied.get(dimension)
        if raw is None:
            missing.append(dimension)
            continue
        try:
            score = float(raw)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            violations.append("invalid_judge_score:" + dimension)
            continue
        if not 0.0 <= score <= 1.0:
            violations.append("judge_score_out_of_range:" + dimension)
            continue
        normalized_scores.append((dimension, score))
        if score < threshold:
            violations.append(f"semantic_dimension_below_threshold:{dimension}:{score:.3f}")

    complete = bool(response) and not missing and not violations
    score = 0.0
    if normalized_scores:
        score = sum(value for _, value in normalized_scores) / len(normalized_scores)
    ok = complete and score >= threshold
    return SemanticGrade(
        ok=ok,
        complete=complete,
        score=round(score, 6),
        violations=tuple(violations),
        missing_judge_dimensions=tuple(missing),
        dimension_scores=tuple(normalized_scores),
        contract=contract,
    )

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import re
from collections.abc import AsyncIterator
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Awaitable, Callable

from ..capabilities.executor import CapabilityExecutorService
from ..contracts import Event, Health, RuntimeContext, ServiceSpec, ServiceState
from ..evidence.identity import IdentityGroundingService
from ..interfaces.senses import SensoryFusionService
from .analysis import CognitiveAnalysisService
from .commit import ConversationCommitService
from .constellation import CognitiveConstellationService
from .expression import ExpressionService
from .history import ConversationHistoryService
from .language import analyze_language_and_figures
from .reaction import ReactionService


CandidateProvider = Callable[[str], Awaitable[str]]
StreamCandidateProvider = Callable[[str], AsyncIterator[str]]
ResponseGate = Callable[[str, str], Awaitable[str]]
StreamEmitter = Callable[[str, str, bool], Awaitable[None]]


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class TurnResult:
    correlation_id: str
    response: str
    verified: bool
    streamed: bool = False


class ConversationSpine:
    spec = ServiceSpec(
        "conversation.spine",
        required=True,
        dependencies=(
            "conversation.history",
            "conversation.analysis",
            "conversation.constellation",
            "conversation.expression",
            "conversation.reaction",
            "conversation.commit",
            "capabilities.executor",
            "learning.experience",
            "evidence.gate",
            "evidence.identity",
            "evidence.web",
            "interfaces.senses",
            "reasoning.provider",
        ),
        start_timeout_seconds=30.0,
    )

    def __init__(
        self,
        candidate: CandidateProvider,
        gate: ResponseGate,
        *,
        stream_candidate: StreamCandidateProvider | None = None,
        shadow_mode: bool = True,
    ) -> None:
        self._candidate = candidate
        owner = getattr(candidate, "__self__", None)
        if stream_candidate is None:
            discovered = getattr(owner, "stream_candidate", None) if owner is not None else None
            if callable(discovered) and bool(getattr(owner, "streaming_available", False)):
                stream_candidate = discovered
        self._stream_candidate = stream_candidate
        self._stream_emitter: StreamEmitter | None = None
        self._gate = gate
        self._shadow_mode = bool(shadow_mode)
        self._context: RuntimeContext | None = None
        self._state = ServiceState.DECLARED
        self._turn_lock = asyncio.Lock()

    async def start(self, context: RuntimeContext) -> None:
        self._context = context
        self._state = ServiceState.READY

    async def stop(self) -> None:
        self._stream_emitter = None
        self._state = ServiceState.STOPPED
        self._context = None

    async def health(self) -> Health:
        mode = "stream_capable" if self._stream_candidate is not None else "full_response"
        lock_state = "turn_busy" if self._turn_lock.locked() else "turn_idle"
        return Health(self._state, f"{mode};{lock_state}")

    def set_stream_emitter(self, emitter: StreamEmitter | None) -> None:
        self._stream_emitter = emitter

    @staticmethod
    def _completed_prefix(text: str) -> str:
        matches = list(re.finditer(r"[.!?](?:[\"')\]]*)?(?=\s|$)", text))
        if not matches:
            return ""
        return text[: matches[-1].end()].strip()

    @staticmethod
    def _streaming_allowed(profile) -> tuple[bool, str]:
        if str(getattr(profile, "depth", "")).casefold() == "deep":
            return False, "deep_reasoning"
        if bool(getattr(profile, "self_system", False)):
            return False, "self_system_truth"
        if bool(getattr(profile, "risk_sensitive", False)):
            return False, "risk_sensitive"
        if bool(getattr(profile, "external_evidence", False)):
            return False, "external_evidence"
        if bool(getattr(profile, "uncertainty_required", False)):
            return False, "uncertainty_required"
        domains = {str(x).casefold() for x in tuple(getattr(profile, "domains", ()) or ())}
        if "medical_science" in domains:
            return False, "medical_science"
        return True, "ordinary_verified_turn"

    async def _identity_checked(self, clean: str, candidate: str, correlation_id: str) -> str:
        if self._context is None:
            raise RuntimeError("conversation_spine_not_ready")
        response = (await self._gate(clean, candidate)).strip()
        if not response:
            raise RuntimeError("verified_response_empty")
        identity = self._context.get_service("evidence.identity")
        if not isinstance(identity, IdentityGroundingService):
            raise RuntimeError("canonical_identity_grounding_missing")
        review = await identity.review_and_publish(response, correlation_id)
        if not review.ok:
            raise RuntimeError("identity_grounding_rejected:" + ",".join(review.violations))
        return response

    async def _commit_fast_answer(
        self,
        *,
        clean: str,
        correlation_id: str,
        profile,
        capability_result,
    ) -> TurnResult:
        if self._context is None:
            raise RuntimeError("conversation_spine_not_ready")
        raw = str(capability_result.payload.get("direct_answer") or "").strip()
        if not raw or capability_result.payload.get("authoritative") is not True:
            raise RuntimeError("fast_answer_contract_invalid")
        response = await self._identity_checked(clean, raw, correlation_id)
        capability_ids = (capability_result.id,)
        active = set(profile.active_nodes) | {
            "conversation.history", "conversation.analysis", "conversation.commit",
            "capabilities.executor", "evidence.gate", "evidence.identity",
            f"tool.{capability_result.id}",
        }
        await self._context.publish(Event("conversation.response.verified", {
            "characters": len(response), "analysis_depth": profile.depth,
            "active_nodes": list(tuple(sorted(active))), "perspective_count": 0,
            "disagreement_axis_count": 0, "expression_style": "fast_local_fact",
            "reaction_mode": "direct", "reaction_intensity": 0.0,
            "history_turns_used": 0, "capability_results": 1,
            "capability_ids": list(capability_ids), "fast_path": True,
            "streamed": False,
            "fast_path_source": str(capability_result.payload.get("source") or "native_capability")[:300],
        }, correlation_id))
        commit = self._context.get_service("conversation.commit")
        if not isinstance(commit, ConversationCommitService):
            raise RuntimeError("canonical_conversation_commit_missing")
        await commit.commit(clean, response, correlation_id, active_nodes=tuple(sorted(active)), capability_ids=capability_ids)
        return TurnResult(correlation_id, response, True, False)

    async def _generate_verified(
        self,
        prompt: str,
        *,
        clean: str,
        correlation_id: str,
        allow_stream: bool,
    ) -> tuple[str, bool, tuple[str, ...]]:
        emitter = self._stream_emitter
        if not allow_stream or emitter is None or self._stream_candidate is None or self._shadow_mode:
            candidate = await self._candidate(prompt)
            return await self._identity_checked(clean, candidate, correlation_id), False, ()

        candidate_buffer = ""
        verified_prefix = ""
        considered_prefix = ""
        buffered_deltas: list[str] = []

        async for fragment in self._stream_candidate(prompt):
            candidate_buffer += str(fragment or "")
            complete = self._completed_prefix(candidate_buffer)
            if not complete or complete == considered_prefix:
                continue
            considered_prefix = complete
            next_verified = await self._identity_checked(clean, complete, correlation_id)
            if verified_prefix and not next_verified.startswith(verified_prefix):
                raise RuntimeError("stream_verifier_rewrote_committed_prefix")
            delta = next_verified[len(verified_prefix):]
            if delta:
                buffered_deltas.append(delta)
            verified_prefix = next_verified
            if self._context is not None:
                await self._context.publish(Event("conversation.response.stream_chunk_verified", {
                    "committed_characters": len(verified_prefix),
                    "delta_characters": len(delta),
                    "outward_delivered": False,
                    "awaiting_atomic_acceptance": True,
                }, correlation_id))

        candidate = candidate_buffer.strip()
        if not candidate:
            raise RuntimeError("candidate_stream_empty")
        response = await self._identity_checked(clean, candidate, correlation_id)
        if verified_prefix and not response.startswith(verified_prefix):
            raise RuntimeError("stream_final_verification_rewrote_committed_prefix")
        final_delta = response[len(verified_prefix):]
        if final_delta:
            buffered_deltas.append(final_delta)
        return response, bool(buffered_deltas or verified_prefix), tuple(buffered_deltas)

    async def _deliver_committed_stream(
        self,
        correlation_id: str,
        response: str,
        deltas: tuple[str, ...],
    ) -> None:
        emitter = self._stream_emitter
        if emitter is None:
            raise RuntimeError("committed_stream_emitter_unavailable")
        if not deltas:
            await emitter(correlation_id, response, True)
            return
        for index, delta in enumerate(deltas):
            await emitter(correlation_id, delta, index == len(deltas) - 1)

    async def respond(self, text: str, correlation_id: str) -> TurnResult:
        if self._state != ServiceState.READY or self._context is None:
            raise RuntimeError("conversation_spine_not_ready")
        async with self._turn_lock:
            if self._state != ServiceState.READY or self._context is None:
                raise RuntimeError("conversation_spine_not_ready")
            return await self._respond_transaction(text, correlation_id)

    async def _respond_transaction(self, text: str, correlation_id: str) -> TurnResult:
        clean = str(text or "").strip()
        if not clean:
            raise ValueError("empty_input")
        if self._context is None:
            raise RuntimeError("conversation_spine_not_ready")
        await self._context.publish(Event("conversation.input.accepted", {"characters": len(clean)}, correlation_id))

        history = self._context.get_service("conversation.history")
        if not isinstance(history, ConversationHistoryService):
            raise RuntimeError("canonical_conversation_history_missing")
        history_rows = history.relevant(clean, limit=4)
        history_context = history.cognition_context(clean, limit=4)
        if history_context:
            await self._context.publish(Event("conversation.history.context", {
                "characters": len(history_context), "turns": len(history_rows),
            }, correlation_id))

        analysis = self._context.get_service("conversation.analysis")
        if not isinstance(analysis, CognitiveAnalysisService):
            raise RuntimeError("canonical_cognitive_analysis_missing")
        profile = await analysis.analyze(clean, correlation_id)
        language_profile = analyze_language_and_figures(clean)
        await self._context.publish(Event(
            "conversation.language_and_figures.analyzed",
            language_profile.as_dict(), correlation_id,
        ))

        capabilities = self._context.get_service("capabilities.executor")
        if not isinstance(capabilities, CapabilityExecutorService):
            raise RuntimeError("canonical_capability_executor_missing")
        capability_results = await capabilities.execute_for_turn(
            clean, requested=profile.requested_capabilities,
            correlation_id=correlation_id, shadow_mode=self._shadow_mode,
        )
        capability_context = capabilities.cognition_context(capability_results)
        fast_result = next((r for r in capability_results if r.ok and r.payload.get("authoritative") is True and str(r.payload.get("direct_answer") or "").strip()), None)
        if fast_result is not None:
            return await self._commit_fast_answer(
                clean=clean, correlation_id=correlation_id,
                profile=profile, capability_result=fast_result,
            )

        senses = self._context.get_service("interfaces.senses")
        if not isinstance(senses, SensoryFusionService):
            raise RuntimeError("canonical_sensory_fusion_missing")
        sensory_rows = senses.recent(window_seconds=20.0, limit=12)
        sensory_context = senses.cognition_context(window_seconds=20.0, limit=12)
        sensory_modalities = tuple(sorted({row.modality for row in sensory_rows}))
        if sensory_context:
            await self._context.publish(Event("conversation.sensory.context", {
                "observation_count": len(sensory_rows),
                "modalities": list(sensory_modalities),
                "raw_media_retained": False,
                "single_generation_authority": True,
            }, correlation_id))

        constellation = self._context.get_service("conversation.constellation")
        expression = self._context.get_service("conversation.expression")
        reaction = self._context.get_service("conversation.reaction")
        if not isinstance(constellation, CognitiveConstellationService):
            raise RuntimeError("canonical_cognitive_constellation_missing")
        if not isinstance(expression, ExpressionService):
            raise RuntimeError("canonical_expression_service_missing")
        if not isinstance(reaction, ReactionService):
            raise RuntimeError("canonical_reaction_service_missing")

        await self._context.publish(Event("conversation.web_evidence.analysis", {
            "mode": profile.web_decision.mode, "needed": profile.external_evidence,
            "reasons": list(profile.web_decision.reasons),
        }, correlation_id))

        async def research_web() -> tuple[str, int, str | None]:
            if not profile.external_evidence:
                return "", 0, None
            web = self._context.get_service("evidence.web")
            bundle = await web.research(clean)
            context = web.cognition_context(bundle)
            await self._context.publish(Event(
                "conversation.web_evidence.ready" if bundle.ok else "conversation.web_evidence.unavailable",
                {"source_count": len(bundle.sources), "error": bundle.error}, correlation_id,
            ))
            return context, len(bundle.sources), bundle.error

        plan, expression_profile, reaction_profile, web_result = await asyncio.gather(
            constellation.plan(profile, correlation_id),
            expression.select(profile, correlation_id),
            reaction.select(clean, profile, correlation_id),
            research_web(),
        )
        web_context, web_source_count, web_error = web_result
        fanout_roads = [
            "conversation.constellation",
            "conversation.expression",
            "conversation.reaction",
        ]
        if profile.external_evidence:
            fanout_roads.append("evidence.web")
        await self._context.publish(Event("conversation.neural_fanout.completed", {
            "roads": fanout_roads,
            "road_count": len(fanout_roads),
            "concurrent": len(fanout_roads) > 1,
            "single_generation_authority": True,
        }, correlation_id))

        learning = self._context.get_service("learning.experience")
        context_builder = getattr(learning, "cognition_context", None)
        learned_context = context_builder() if callable(context_builder) else ""
        identity = self._context.get_service("evidence.identity")
        if not isinstance(identity, IdentityGroundingService):
            raise RuntimeError("canonical_identity_grounding_missing")

        capability_ids = tuple(r.id for r in capability_results)
        fusion_roads = list(fanout_roads)
        if capability_results:
            fusion_roads.append("capabilities.executor")
        if sensory_context:
            fusion_roads.append("interfaces.senses")
        if history_context:
            fusion_roads.append("conversation.history")
        if learned_context:
            fusion_roads.append("learning.experience")
        fusion_context = "\n".join((
            "<eira_fusion_receipt>",
            "roads=" + ",".join(fusion_roads),
            f"perspective_receipts={len(plan.receipts)}",
            "disagreement_axes=" + ",".join(plan.disagreement_axes or ("none",)),
            "capability_ids=" + ",".join(capability_ids or ("none",)),
            f"sensory_observations={len(sensory_rows)}",
            "sensory_modalities=" + ",".join(sensory_modalities or ("none",)),
            f"web_source_count={web_source_count}",
            f"web_error={web_error or 'none'}",
            f"accepted_history_turns={len(history_rows)}",
            f"learning_context={str(bool(learned_context)).lower()}",
            "single_generation_authority=true",
            "accepted_state_authority=conversation.commit",
            "Instruction: fuse all available road and sensory evidence into one coherent answer; preserve material disagreements, provenance, and uncertainty rather than averaging them away.",
            "</eira_fusion_receipt>",
        ))
        await self._context.publish(Event("conversation.cognition.fused", {
            "roads": fusion_roads,
            "perspective_receipt_count": len(plan.receipts),
            "disagreement_axes": list(plan.disagreement_axes),
            "capability_ids": list(capability_ids),
            "sensory_observation_count": len(sensory_rows),
            "sensory_modalities": list(sensory_modalities),
            "web_source_count": web_source_count,
            "web_error": web_error,
            "history_turns_used": len(history_rows),
            "learning_context": bool(learned_context),
            "single_generation_authority": True,
            "accepted_state_authority": "conversation.commit",
        }, correlation_id))

        context_parts = [clean]
        if history_context:
            context_parts.append(history_context)
        context_parts.extend([
            profile.cognition_context(), language_profile.cognition_context(),
            plan.cognition_context(), expression_profile.cognition_context(),
            reaction_profile.cognition_context(), identity.cognition_context(self_system=profile.self_system),
            fusion_context,
        ])
        if capability_context:
            context_parts.append(capability_context)
        if sensory_context:
            context_parts.append(sensory_context)
        if learned_context:
            context_parts.append(learned_context)
            await self._context.publish(Event("conversation.experience.context", {"characters": len(learned_context)}, correlation_id))
        if web_context:
            context_parts.append(web_context)

        allow_stream, stream_reason = self._streaming_allowed(profile)
        await self._context.publish(Event("conversation.response.streaming_policy", {
            "allowed": allow_stream, "reason": stream_reason, "depth": profile.depth,
        }, correlation_id))
        response, streamed, stream_deltas = await self._generate_verified(
            "\n\n".join(context_parts), clean=clean,
            correlation_id=correlation_id, allow_stream=allow_stream,
        )
        active = set(profile.active_nodes) | set(plan.active_nodes) | {
            "conversation.history", "conversation.expression", "conversation.reaction", "capabilities.executor",
        } | {f"tool.{r.id}" for r in capability_results}
        if sensory_context:
            active.add("interfaces.senses")
        if profile.external_evidence:
            active.add("evidence.web")
        await self._context.publish(Event("conversation.response.verified", {
            "characters": len(response), "analysis_depth": profile.depth,
            "active_nodes": list(tuple(sorted(active))), "perspective_count": len(plan.perspectives),
            "perspective_receipt_count": len(plan.receipts),
            "disagreement_axis_count": len(plan.disagreement_axes), "expression_style": expression_profile.style,
            "reaction_mode": reaction_profile.mode, "reaction_intensity": reaction_profile.intensity,
            "history_turns_used": len(history_rows), "capability_results": len(capability_results),
            "capability_ids": list(capability_ids), "fast_path": False, "streamed": streamed,
            "sensory_observation_count": len(sensory_rows),
            "sensory_modalities": list(sensory_modalities),
            "streaming_policy": stream_reason,
            "requested_language": language_profile.requested_language_code,
            "figurative_modes": [
                name for name, enabled in (("analogy", language_profile.analogy), ("metaphor", language_profile.metaphor), ("poetry", language_profile.poetry)) if enabled
            ],
        }, correlation_id))

        commit = self._context.get_service("conversation.commit")
        if not isinstance(commit, ConversationCommitService):
            raise RuntimeError("canonical_conversation_commit_missing")
        await commit.commit(
            clean, response, correlation_id,
            active_nodes=tuple(sorted(active)), capability_ids=capability_ids,
        )
        if streamed:
            await self._deliver_committed_stream(correlation_id, response, stream_deltas)
            await self._context.publish(Event("conversation.response.stream_released", {
                "chunks": len(stream_deltas),
                "characters": len(response),
                "accepted_state_committed": True,
            }, correlation_id))
        return TurnResult(correlation_id, response, True, streamed)

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Awaitable, Callable
from typing import Any

from ..contracts import Health, RuntimeContext, ServiceSpec, ServiceState


Sink = Callable[[str], Awaitable[Any]]
TurnSink = Callable[[str, str, bool], Awaitable[Any]]


class DeliveryGate:
    spec = ServiceSpec(
        "delivery.gate",
        required=True,
        dependencies=("conversation.spine", "delivery.voice"),
    )

    def __init__(
        self,
        sinks: list[Sink],
        *,
        shadow_mode: bool = True,
        turn_sinks: list[TurnSink] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._sinks = tuple(sinks)
        self._turn_sinks = tuple(turn_sinks or ())
        self._shadow = shadow_mode
        self._state = ServiceState.DECLARED
        self._delivered_ids: set[str] = set()
        self._streaming_ids: set[str] = set()
        self._streamed_text: dict[str, str] = {}
        self._stream_consolidation_pending: set[str] = set()
        self._conversation = None

    async def start(self, context: RuntimeContext) -> None:
        conversation = context.get_service("conversation.spine")
        setter = getattr(conversation, "set_stream_emitter", None)
        if not callable(setter):
            raise RuntimeError("conversation_stream_emitter_contract_missing")

        async def emitter(correlation_id: str, text: str, final: bool) -> None:
            await self.deliver_chunk(correlation_id, text, final=final)

        setter(emitter)
        self._conversation = conversation
        self._state = ServiceState.READY

    async def stop(self) -> None:
        setter = getattr(self._conversation, "set_stream_emitter", None)
        if callable(setter):
            setter(None)
        self._conversation = None
        self._state = ServiceState.STOPPED
        self._delivered_ids.clear()
        self._streaming_ids.clear()
        self._streamed_text.clear()
        self._stream_consolidation_pending.clear()

    async def health(self) -> Health:
        mode = "shadow" if self._shadow else "active"
        return Health(self._state, f"{mode};streams={len(self._streaming_ids)}")

    async def _emit(self, correlation_id: str, text: str, *, final: bool) -> None:
        # Generic sinks remain deliberately text-only. Correlation-aware sinks are
        # reserved for canonical delivery machinery such as voice-language routing;
        # neither path is allowed to rewrite accepted words.
        for sink in self._sinks:
            await sink(text)
        for sink in self._turn_sinks:
            await sink(correlation_id, text, final)

    async def deliver(self, correlation_id: str, text: str) -> bool:
        if self._state != ServiceState.READY:
            raise RuntimeError("delivery_gate_not_ready")
        rendered = str(text or "")
        if correlation_id in self._stream_consolidation_pending:
            # The streaming path has already spoken this one logical response. The
            # normal runtime final delivery is consumed exactly once as a consistency
            # receipt, never spoken again.
            if rendered != self._streamed_text.get(correlation_id, ""):
                raise RuntimeError("streamed_final_response_mismatch")
            self._stream_consolidation_pending.discard(correlation_id)
            return False
        if correlation_id in self._delivered_ids or correlation_id in self._streaming_ids:
            raise RuntimeError("duplicate_outward_delivery")
        self._delivered_ids.add(correlation_id)
        if self._shadow:
            return False
        await self._emit(correlation_id, rendered, final=True)
        return True

    async def deliver_chunk(self, correlation_id: str, text: str, *, final: bool = False) -> bool:
        """Deliver a verified delta within exactly one logical outward response."""
        if self._state != ServiceState.READY:
            raise RuntimeError("delivery_gate_not_ready")
        if correlation_id in self._delivered_ids and correlation_id not in self._streaming_ids:
            raise RuntimeError("duplicate_outward_delivery")
        chunk = str(text or "")
        if not chunk and not final:
            return False
        self._streaming_ids.add(correlation_id)
        if chunk:
            self._streamed_text[correlation_id] = self._streamed_text.get(correlation_id, "") + chunk
            if not self._shadow:
                await self._emit(correlation_id, chunk, final=final)
        elif final and not self._shadow:
            # A final empty delta is still meaningful to a correlation-aware sink:
            # it lets the voice owner release per-turn language/model state.
            for sink in self._turn_sinks:
                await sink(correlation_id, "", True)
        if final:
            self._streaming_ids.discard(correlation_id)
            self._delivered_ids.add(correlation_id)
            self._stream_consolidation_pending.add(correlation_id)
        return not self._shadow

    def streamed_text(self, correlation_id: str) -> str:
        return self._streamed_text.get(correlation_id, "")

import time

class ReactivePresenceService:
    """Canonical non-answer presence signals for voice/UI latency masking.

    This service may publish thinking/reaction state but never generates a second
    answer and never bypasses delivery.gate. It therefore preserves one outward voice.
    """

    spec = ServiceSpec(
        "delivery.reactive_presence",
        required=True,
        dependencies=("kernel.events",),
    )

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._context: RuntimeContext | None = None
        self._state = ServiceState.DECLARED
        self._active: dict[str, float] = {}

    async def start(self, context: RuntimeContext) -> None:
        self._context = context
        self._state = ServiceState.READY

    async def stop(self) -> None:
        self._active.clear()
        self._context = None
        self._state = ServiceState.STOPPED

    async def health(self) -> Health:
        return Health(self._state, f"active={len(self._active)}")

    async def begin(self, correlation_id: str, *, mode: str = "thinking") -> None:
        if self._context is None or self._state != ServiceState.READY:
            raise RuntimeError("reactive_presence_not_ready")
        cid = str(correlation_id)
        self._active[cid] = time.time()
        await self._context.publish(Event("delivery.presence.begin", {
            "mode": str(mode or "thinking")[:80],
            "outward_answer": False,
        }, cid))

    async def reaction(self, correlation_id: str, *, mode: str, intensity: float) -> None:
        if self._context is None or self._state != ServiceState.READY:
            raise RuntimeError("reactive_presence_not_ready")
        await self._context.publish(Event("delivery.presence.reaction", {
            "mode": str(mode or "direct")[:80],
            "intensity": max(0.0, min(1.0, float(intensity))),
            "outward_answer": False,
        }, str(correlation_id)))

    async def end(self, correlation_id: str) -> None:
        if self._context is None or self._state != ServiceState.READY:
            raise RuntimeError("reactive_presence_not_ready")
        cid = str(correlation_id)
        started = self._active.pop(cid, None)
        await self._context.publish(Event("delivery.presence.end", {
            "elapsed_seconds": max(0.0, time.time() - started) if started else 0.0,
            "outward_answer": False,
        }, cid))

    def snapshot(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "active": len(self._active),
            "one_outward_answer_authority": "delivery.gate",
            "can_generate_answer": False,
        }

    def capability_bindings(self) -> tuple[CapabilityBinding, ...]:
        async def status(_: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
            return self.snapshot()
        return (
            CapabilityBinding(
                id="presence.status",
                implementation_node=self.spec.name,
                aliases=("thinking indicator status", "reactive presence status"),
                tags=("runtime_introspection", "presence"),
                handler=status,
                description="Inspect EIRA2 reactive/thinking presence without creating a second response path.",
                read_only=True,
                auto_safe=False,
                shadow_safe=True,
            ),
        )

import asyncio
import os
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Callable

from ..contracts import Event, Health, RuntimeContext, ServiceSpec, ServiceState

Speaker = Callable[[str], None]


def _truthy_env(name: str, default: bool = False) -> bool:
    raw = os.environ.get(name)
    if raw is None:
        return bool(default)
    return raw.strip().casefold() in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}


def _device_token(value: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", str(value or "").casefold())


def _sink_matches_device(sink: str, *, mac: str, name: str) -> bool:
    raw = str(sink or "").casefold()
    mac_raw = str(mac or "").casefold()
    mac_underscore = mac_raw.replace(":", "_")
    mac_compact = mac_raw.replace(":", "")
    name_token = _device_token(name)
    sink_token = _device_token(raw)
    return bool(
        (mac_raw and mac_raw in raw)
        or (mac_underscore and mac_underscore in raw)
        or (mac_compact and mac_compact in sink_token)
        or (name_token and name_token in sink_token)
    )


def _language_env_suffix(code: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"[^A-Z0-9]", "_", str(code or "").upper()).strip("_")
