class PublicLibraryError(RuntimeError): pass


def _sha_file(path: Path, chunk: int = 1024 * 1024) -> str:
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as f:
        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(chunk), b""):
            h.update(b)
    return h.hexdigest()


def _download(url: str, dest: Path, *, min_free_bytes: int = 2_000_000_000, timeout: int = 120) -> dict[str, Any]:
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    free = shutil.disk_usage(dest.parent).free
    if free < min_free_bytes:
        raise PublicLibraryError(f"insufficient_free_space:{free}")
    part = dest.with_suffix(dest.suffix + ".part")
    headers = {"User-Agent": USER_AGENT}
    mode = "wb"
    existing = part.stat().st_size if part.exists() else 0
    if existing:
        headers["Range"] = f"bytes={existing}-"
        mode = "ab"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=headers)
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as r:
        status = getattr(r, "status", 200)
        if existing and status != 206:
            existing = 0
            mode = "wb"
        with part.open(mode) as out:
            while True:
                chunk = r.read(1024 * 1024)
                if not chunk:
                    break
                out.write(chunk)
    os.replace(part, dest)
    return {"path": str(dest), "bytes": dest.stat().st_size, "sha256": _sha_file(dest), "url": url}


def _safe_member_name(name: str) -> str:
    p = Path(name)
    if p.is_absolute() or ".." in p.parts:
        raise PublicLibraryError(f"unsafe_archive_member:{name}")
    return p.as_posix()


class PublicLibraryVault:
    def __init__(self, root: str | Path = DEFAULT_VAULT):
        self.root = Path(root).resolve()
        self.root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.db_path = self.root / "source_index.sqlite3"
        self.db = sqlite3.connect(str(self.db_path), timeout=60.0, isolation_level=None)
        self.db.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        self.db.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
        self.db.execute("PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL")
        self._schema()

    def close(self): self.db.close()
    def __enter__(self): return self
    def __exit__(self, *_): self.close()

    def _schema(self):
        self.db.executescript("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS meta(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,value TEXT NOT NULL);
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS works(
          source_name TEXT NOT NULL,
          source_work_id TEXT NOT NULL,
          title TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
          authors TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
          subjects TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
          language TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
          source_url TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
          source_release_date TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
          rights TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
          metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
          metadata_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
          first_seen_unix REAL NOT NULL,
          last_seen_unix REAL NOT NULL,
          PRIMARY KEY(source_name,source_work_id)
        );
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS documents(
          document_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
          source_name TEXT NOT NULL,
          source_work_id TEXT NOT NULL,
          relative_path TEXT NOT NULL,
          bytes INTEGER NOT NULL,
          indexed_unix REAL NOT NULL,
          UNIQUE(source_name,source_work_id,relative_path)
        );
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ingest_receipts(
          receipt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
          source_name TEXT NOT NULL,
          operation TEXT NOT NULL,
          started_unix REAL NOT NULL,
          completed_unix REAL NOT NULL,
          status TEXT NOT NULL,
          details_json TEXT NOT NULL
        );
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_works_title ON works(title);
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_works_language ON works(language);
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_docs_work ON documents(source_name,source_work_id);
        """)
        self.db.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO meta(key,value) VALUES('schema_version',?)", (str(SCHEMA_VERSION),))
        self.db.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO meta(key,value) VALUES('source_is_not_fact','1')")

    def ingest_gutenberg_catalog(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        started = time.time()
        raw = self.root / "project_gutenberg" / "catalog" / "pg_catalog.csv.gz"
        dl = _download(CATALOG_URL, raw, min_free_bytes=500_000_000)
        inserted = updated = unchanged = 0
        now = time.time()
        with gzip.open(raw, "rt", encoding="utf-8-sig", errors="replace", newline="") as f:
            reader = csv.DictReader(f)
            if not reader.fieldnames:
                raise PublicLibraryError("gutenberg_catalog_missing_headers")
            id_keys = [k for k in reader.fieldnames if k.casefold() in {"text#", "text", "ebook no.", "ebook no", "id", "ebook"}]
            for row in reader:
                lowered = {str(k).strip().casefold(): str(v or "").strip() for k, v in row.items()}
                work_id = ""
                for k in ("text#", "text", "ebook no.", "ebook no", "id", "ebook"):
                    if lowered.get(k): work_id = lowered[k]; break
                if not work_id:
                    # Stable fallback from complete metadata row; never invent a numerical Gutenberg id.
                    work_id = "meta_" + hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(row,sort_keys=True,ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()[:24]
                title = lowered.get("title", "")
                authors = lowered.get("author", lowered.get("authors", ""))
                subjects = lowered.get("subject", lowered.get("subjects", ""))
                language = lowered.get("language", lowered.get("languages", ""))
                release = lowered.get("release date", lowered.get("release_date", ""))
                rights = lowered.get("copyright status", lowered.get("rights", ""))
                source_url = f"https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/{work_id}" if work_id.isdigit() else ""
                meta_json = json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
                mh = hashlib.sha256(meta_json.encode()).hexdigest()
                old = self.db.execute("SELECT metadata_hash FROM works WHERE source_name='project_gutenberg' AND source_work_id=?", (work_id,)).fetchone()
                if old is None:
                    self.db.execute("INSERT INTO works(source_name,source_work_id,title,authors,subjects,language,source_url,source_release_date,rights,metadata_json,metadata_hash,first_seen_unix,last_seen_unix) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)", ('project_gutenberg',work_id,title,authors,subjects,language,source_url,release,rights,meta_json,mh,now,now)); inserted += 1
                elif old[0] != mh:
                    self.db.execute("UPDATE works SET title=?,authors=?,subjects=?,language=?,source_url=?,source_release_date=?,rights=?,metadata_json=?,metadata_hash=?,last_seen_unix=? WHERE source_name='project_gutenberg' AND source_work_id=?", (title,authors,subjects,language,source_url,release,rights,meta_json,mh,now,work_id)); updated += 1
                else:
                    self.db.execute("UPDATE works SET last_seen_unix=? WHERE source_name='project_gutenberg' AND source_work_id=?", (now,work_id)); unchanged += 1
        details = {"download": dl, "inserted": inserted, "updated": updated, "unchanged": unchanged, "total": inserted+updated+unchanged}
        rid = "receipt_" + hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(details,sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()[:24]
        self.db.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO ingest_receipts(receipt_id,source_name,operation,started_unix,completed_unix,status,details_json) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?)", (rid,'project_gutenberg','catalog',started,time.time(),'PASS',json.dumps(details,sort_keys=True)))
        return {"ok": True, "receipt_id": rid, **details}

    def download_gutenberg_full_text_archive(self, *, minimum_free_bytes: int = 25_000_000_000) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Download Gutenberg's sanctioned weekly all-text archive into the cold source vault.

        This does NOT convert book prose into accepted factual Seeds. It only preserves source material.
        """
        started = time.time()
        dest = self.root / "project_gutenberg" / "bulk" / "txt-files.tar.zip"
        dl = _download(CORPUS_URL, dest, min_free_bytes=minimum_free_bytes, timeout=300)
        details = {"download": dl, "source_is_not_fact": True, "extracted": False}
        rid = "receipt_" + hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(details,sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()[:24]
        self.db.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO ingest_receipts(receipt_id,source_name,operation,started_unix,completed_unix,status,details_json) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?)", (rid,'project_gutenberg','bulk_download',started,time.time(),'PASS',json.dumps(details,sort_keys=True)))
        return {"ok": True, "receipt_id": rid, **details}

    def extract_gutenberg_full_text_archive(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        archive = self.root / "project_gutenberg" / "bulk" / "txt-files.tar.zip"
        if not archive.is_file(): raise PublicLibraryError("gutenberg_bulk_archive_missing")
        target = self.root / "project_gutenberg" / "texts"
        target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        extracted = skipped = 0
        # Gutenberg distributes a zip containing a tar. Extract defensively in two stages.
        with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as zf:
            names = [n for n in zf.namelist() if n.lower().endswith(('.tar','.tar.gz','.tgz','.txt'))]
            if not names: raise PublicLibraryError("gutenberg_zip_contains_no_supported_payload")
            for n in names:
                _safe_member_name(n)
                if n.lower().endswith('.txt'):
                    out = target / Path(n).name
                    if out.exists(): skipped += 1; continue
                    with zf.open(n) as src, out.open('wb') as dst: shutil.copyfileobj(src,dst)
                    extracted += 1
                else:
                    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='eira_pg_tar_') as td:
                        tarp = Path(td)/Path(n).name
                        with zf.open(n) as src, tarp.open('wb') as dst: shutil.copyfileobj(src,dst)
                        with tarfile.open(tarp, 'r:*') as tf:
                            for m in tf:
                                if not m.isfile(): continue
                                _safe_member_name(m.name)
                                if not m.name.lower().endswith('.txt'): continue
                                out = target / Path(m.name).name
                                if out.exists(): skipped += 1; continue
                                fh = tf.extractfile(m)
                                if fh is None: continue
                                with fh, out.open('wb') as dst: shutil.copyfileobj(fh,dst)
                                extracted += 1
        return {"ok": True, "target": str(target), "extracted_files": extracted, "skipped_existing": skipped}

    def stats(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        c=lambda t:int(self.db.execute(f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {t}").fetchone()[0])
        return {"schema_version":SCHEMA_VERSION,"works":c('works'),"documents":c('documents'),"receipts":c('ingest_receipts'),"vault":str(self.root),"source_is_not_fact":True}

    """Attested, adaptive, fail-closed defensive immune coverage for EIRA.

    Every runtime health claim and attack signal must be authenticated by the canonical
    attestation authority. Attack payloads are cryptographically bound through the
    receipt evidence digest. Defense tactics evolve only from independently attested
    outcomes and can only select/tighten preapproved defensive actions. Recovery is
    anti-rollback and requires multi-attestor clean-room evidence. No counterattack,
    hostile-code execution, or raw malware learning is permitted.
    """

    spec = ServiceSpec(
        "extension.jellyfish_defense_coverage",
        required=False,
        dependencies=(
            "security.jellyfish_immune", "security.attestation",
            "kernel.events", "state.store", "learning.experience",
        ),
    )

    DETECTOR_NS = "security.jellyfish.coverage.detectors"
    CONTROL_NS = "security.jellyfish.coverage.controls"
    REPORT_NS = "security.jellyfish.coverage.reports"
    TACTIC_NS = "security.jellyfish.defense.tactics"
    INCIDENT_NS = "security.jellyfish.defense.incidents"
    FLOOR_NS = "security.jellyfish.defense.generation_floor"
    REJOIN_NS = "security.jellyfish.defense.rejoin"

    MIN_OUTCOME_ATTESTORS = 2
    MIN_REJOIN_ATTESTORS = 3

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._state = ServiceState.DECLARED
        self._context: RuntimeContext | None = None
        self._store: StateStore | None = None
        self._immune: JellyfishImmuneService | None = None
        self._attestation: SecurityAttestationService | None = None
        self._learning: ExperienceLearningService | None = None

    async def start(self, context: RuntimeContext) -> None:
        immune = context.get_service("security.jellyfish_immune")
        attestation = context.get_service("security.attestation")
        events = context.get_service("kernel.events")
        store = context.get_service("state.store")
        learning = context.get_service("learning.experience")
        if not isinstance(immune, JellyfishImmuneService):
            raise RuntimeError("jellyfish_coverage_immune_missing")
        if not isinstance(attestation, SecurityAttestationService):
            raise RuntimeError("jellyfish_coverage_attestation_missing")
        if not isinstance(events, EventService):
            raise RuntimeError("jellyfish_coverage_events_missing")
        if not isinstance(store, StateStore):
            raise RuntimeError("jellyfish_coverage_state_missing")
        if not isinstance(learning, ExperienceLearningService):
            raise RuntimeError("jellyfish_coverage_learning_missing")
        self._context = context
        self._store = store
        self._immune = immune
        self._attestation = attestation
        self._learning = learning
        events.subscribe("security.detector.health", self._on_unattested_health)
        events.subscribe("security.control.health", self._on_unattested_health)
        events.subscribe("security.detector.health.attested", self._on_detector_attested)
        events.subscribe("security.control.health.attested", self._on_control_attested)
        events.subscribe("security.attack.signal", self._on_attack_signal)
        events.subscribe("security.jellyfish.defense_outcome.attested", self._on_defense_outcome)
        events.subscribe("security.jellyfish.rejoin.request", self._on_rejoin_request)
        self._state = ServiceState.READY
        report = self.coverage_report()
        if report["restricted_posture_required"]:
            await self._publish_restricted(report, reason="startup_coverage_not_proven")

    async def stop(self) -> None:
        self._context = None
        self._store = None
        self._immune = None
        self._attestation = None
        self._learning = None
        self._state = ServiceState.STOPPED

    async def health(self) -> Health:
        if self._state != ServiceState.READY:
            return Health(self._state)
        report = self.coverage_report()
        detail = "restricted_unproven_coverage" if report["restricted_posture_required"] else "attested_adaptive_defense_ready"
        return Health(ServiceState.READY, detail)

    def _ready(self) -> tuple[StateStore, JellyfishImmuneService, SecurityAttestationService]:
        if self._state != ServiceState.READY or self._store is None or self._immune is None or self._attestation is None:
            raise RuntimeError("jellyfish_coverage_not_ready")
        return self._store, self._immune, self._attestation

    @staticmethod
    def _identity(value: str, field: str) -> str:
        clean = str(value or "").strip().casefold()
        if not clean or len(clean) > 160:
            raise ValueError(f"jellyfish_coverage_{field}_invalid")
        return clean

    @staticmethod
    def _refs(values: Iterable[str]) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        rows = sorted({
            " ".join(str(value or "").strip().split())[:256]
            for value in values if str(value or "").strip()
        })
        return tuple(rows[:64])

    @staticmethod
    def _sha256_text(value: Any) -> str:
        encoded = json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=True).encode("utf-8")
        return hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest()

    async def _publish(self, topic: str, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        if self._context is not None:
            await self._context.publish(Event(topic, payload))

    def register_attested_detector(self, receipt: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        store, _, attestation = self._ready()
        subject = self._identity(str(receipt.get("subject_id") or ""), "detector_id")
        verified = attestation.verify_receipt(
            receipt,
            expected_kind="detector_health",
            expected_subject=subject,
            required_roles=("detector_attestor",),
        )
        if verified["issuer_id"] == subject:
            raise PermissionError("jellyfish_detector_self_attestation_forbidden")
        record = {
            "detector_id": subject,
            "healthy": bool(verified["status"]),
            "receipt_id": verified["receipt_id"],
            "issuer_id": verified["issuer_id"],
            "evidence_sha256": verified["evidence_sha256"],
            "version": verified["version"],
            "expires_at": verified["expires_at"],
            "attested": True,
            "updated_at": verified["verified_at"],
        }
        store.put(self.DETECTOR_NS, subject, record)
        return record

    def register_attested_control(self, receipt: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        store, _, attestation = self._ready()
        subject = self._identity(str(receipt.get("subject_id") or ""), "control_id")
        verified = attestation.verify_receipt(
            receipt,
            expected_kind="control_health",
            expected_subject=subject,
            required_roles=("control_attestor",),
        )
        if verified["issuer_id"] == subject:
            raise PermissionError("jellyfish_control_self_attestation_forbidden")
        record = {
            "control_id": subject,
            "ready": bool(verified["status"]),
            "receipt_id": verified["receipt_id"],
            "issuer_id": verified["issuer_id"],
            "evidence_sha256": verified["evidence_sha256"],
            "expires_at": verified["expires_at"],
            "attested": True,
            "updated_at": verified["verified_at"],
        }
        store.put(self.CONTROL_NS, subject, record)
        return record

    @staticmethod
    def _live(record: dict[str, Any] | None, field: str, now: float) -> bool:
        return bool(
            record
            and record.get("attested")
            and record.get(field)
            and float(record.get("expires_at", 0.0)) >= now
        )

    def _playbook(self, domain: str) -> tuple[str, dict[str, Any]]:
        for playbook_id, spec in DEFENSE_PLAYBOOKS.items():
            if domain in spec["domains"]:
                return playbook_id, spec
        return "fortress_contain", DEFENSE_PLAYBOOKS["fortress_contain"]

    def tactic(self, domain: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        clean = str(domain or "unknown").strip().casefold()
        playbook_id, spec = self._playbook(clean)
        if self._store is not None:
            existing = self._store.get(self.TACTIC_NS, clean, None)
            if isinstance(existing, dict):
                return dict(existing)
        actions = list(spec["actions"][:3])
        return {
            "schema": "eira2_jellyfish_defense_tactic_v4",
            "domain": clean,
            "playbook_id": playbook_id,
            "tightening_level": 0,
            "containment_threshold": float(spec["base_threshold"]),
            "sampling_multiplier": 1.0,
            "isolation_scope": "local",
            "preferred_actions": actions,
            "verified_success": 0,
            "verified_failure": 0,
            "verified_recurrence": 0,
            "confidence": 0.5,
            "automatic_relaxation_allowed": False,
            "retaliation_allowed": False,
            "unknown_code_execution_allowed": False,
        }

    def coverage_report(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        detectors = self._store.namespace_snapshot(self.DETECTOR_NS) if self._store is not None else {}
        controls = self._store.namespace_snapshot(self.CONTROL_NS) if self._store is not None else {}
        now = time.time()
        domains: dict[str, Any] = {}
        missing_critical: list[str] = []
        for domain, required in ATTACK_DOMAINS.items():
            missing = [name for name in required if not self._live(detectors.get(name), "healthy", now)]
            domains[domain] = {
                "proven_live_detection": not missing,
                "required_detectors": list(required),
                "missing_or_unhealthy": missing,
            }
            if domain in CRITICAL_DOMAINS and missing:
                missing_critical.append(domain)
        missing_controls = [name for name in REQUIRED_CONTROLS if not self._live(controls.get(name), "ready", now)]
        restricted = bool(missing_critical or missing_controls)
        report = {
            "schema": "eira2_jellyfish_defense_coverage_v4",
            "attack_domains": domains,
            "critical_domains": list(CRITICAL_DOMAINS),
            "missing_critical_domains": missing_critical,
            "required_controls": list(REQUIRED_CONTROLS),
            "missing_controls": missing_controls,
            "registered_detectors": len(detectors),
            "registered_controls": len(controls),
            "restricted_posture_required": restricted,
            "coverage_status": "restricted_unproven" if restricted else "attested_controls_present",
            "per_signal_attestation_required": True,
            "payload_digest_binding_required": True,
            "anti_replay_required": True,
            "independent_outcome_attestors_required": self.MIN_OUTCOME_ATTESTORS,
            "multi_attestor_rejoin_required": self.MIN_REJOIN_ATTESTORS,
            "automatic_defense_relaxation_allowed": False,
            "retaliation_allowed": False,
            "impenetrability_guaranteed": False,
            "future_unknown_attacks_guaranteed": False,
            "known_malware_signature_completeness_guaranteed": False,
            "raw_threat_payload_learning_allowed": False,
            "updated_at": now,
        }
        if self._store is not None:
            self._store.put(self.REPORT_NS, "latest", report)
        return report

    async def refresh_posture(self, *, reason: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        report = self.coverage_report()
        if report["restricted_posture_required"]:
            await self._publish_restricted(report, reason=reason)
        else:
            await self._publish("security.jellyfish.coverage_ready", {
                "coverage_status": report["coverage_status"],
                "impenetrability_guaranteed": False,
            })
        return report

    async def _publish_restricted(self, report: dict[str, Any], *, reason: str) -> None:
        await self._publish("security.jellyfish.fail_closed_requested", {
            "reason": str(reason)[:160],
            "missing_critical_domains": list(report["missing_critical_domains"]),
            "missing_controls": list(report["missing_controls"]),
            "requested_posture": "deny_optional_ingress_egress_and_unverified_execution",
            "enforcement_proven": False,
        })

    def _signal_digest(
        self,
        *,
        detector_id: str,
        domain: str,
        subject_id: str,
        sha256: str,
        indicators: Iterable[str],
        severity: float,
    ) -> str:
        return self._sha256_text({
            "detector_id": detector_id,
            "domain": domain,
            "subject_id": subject_id,
            "sha256": str(sha256 or "").strip().casefold(),
            "indicators": list(self._refs(indicators)),
            "severity": round(max(0.0, min(1.0, float(severity))), 6),
        })

    async def observe_attack_signal(
        self,
        *,
        detector_id: str,
        domain: str,
        subject_id: str,
        signal_receipt: dict[str, Any],
        sha256: str = "",
        indicators: Iterable[str] = (),
        severity: float = 1.0,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        store, immune, attestation = self._ready()
        detector = self._identity(detector_id, "detector_id")
        subject = str(subject_id or "").strip()
        if not subject or len(subject) > 256:
            raise ValueError("jellyfish_attack_subject_invalid")
        clean_domain = str(domain or "unknown").strip().casefold()[:160]
        severity_value = max(0.0, min(1.0, float(severity)))
        detector_record = store.get(self.DETECTOR_NS, detector, None)
        if not self._live(detector_record, "healthy", time.time()):
            result = {
                "schema": "eira2_jellyfish_attack_signal_v4",
                "accepted": False,
                "reason": "unattested_stale_or_unhealthy_detector",
                "detector_id": detector,
                "domain": clean_domain,
                "containment_requested": False,
            }
            await self._publish("security.jellyfish.untrusted_detector_signal", result)
            await self.refresh_posture(reason="untrusted_detector_signal")
            return result
        verified = attestation.verify_receipt(
            signal_receipt,
            expected_kind="attack_signal",
            expected_subject=subject,
            required_roles=("attack_signal_attestor",),
        )
        if verified["issuer_id"] != detector:
            raise PermissionError("jellyfish_attack_signal_wrong_detector_issuer")
        expected_digest = self._signal_digest(
            detector_id=detector,
            domain=clean_domain,
            subject_id=subject,
            sha256=sha256,
            indicators=indicators,
            severity=severity_value,
        )
        if verified["evidence_sha256"] != expected_digest:
            raise PermissionError("jellyfish_attack_signal_payload_digest_mismatch")
        known_domain = clean_domain in ATTACK_DOMAINS
        mapped_kind = THREAT_KIND_MAP.get(clean_domain, "unknown")
        threat = await immune.observe_threat(
            kind=mapped_kind,
            subject_id=subject,
            sha256=sha256,
            indicators=tuple(indicators),
            source=f"attested_detector:{detector}",
            verified=True,
        )
        tactic = self.tactic(clean_domain)
        threshold = float(tactic.get("containment_threshold", 0.90))
        fail_closed = bool(
            not known_domain
            or severity_value >= threshold
            or threat.get("containment_recommended")
        )
        incident_id = str(uuid4())
        incident = {
            "schema": "eira2_jellyfish_security_incident_v4",
            "incident_id": incident_id,
            "detector_id": detector,
            "attack_receipt_id": verified["receipt_id"],
            "domain": clean_domain,
            "subject_token": hashlib.sha256(subject.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(),
            "severity": severity_value,
            "threat_id": threat.get("threat_id"),
            "containment_requested": fail_closed,
            "playbook_id": tactic["playbook_id"],
            "preferred_actions": list(tactic["preferred_actions"]),
            "created_at": time.time(),
        }
        store.put(self.INCIDENT_NS, incident_id, incident)
        if fail_closed:
            await self._publish("security.jellyfish.threat_containment_requested", {
                "incident_id": incident_id,
                "detector_id": detector,
                "domain": clean_domain,
                "subject_token": incident["subject_token"],
                "threat_id": threat.get("threat_id"),
                "reason": "unknown_attack" if not known_domain else "attested_adaptive_or_high_confidence_signal",
                "preferred_actions": list(tactic["preferred_actions"]),
                "isolation_scope": tactic["isolation_scope"],
                "execution_authority": False,
                "retaliation_allowed": False,
            })
        await self._publish("security.jellyfish.attack_signal_evaluated", {
            "incident_id": incident_id,
            "attack_receipt_id": verified["receipt_id"],
            "domain": clean_domain,
            "subject_token": incident["subject_token"],
            "severity": severity_value,
            "containment_requested": fail_closed,
            "playbook_id": tactic["playbook_id"],
        })
        return {**incident, "accepted": True, "known_domain": known_domain, "threat": threat}

    def _verify_outcome_receipts(
        self,
        *,
        incident_id: str,
        succeeded: bool,
        receipts: Iterable[dict[str, Any]],
    ) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], ...]:
        _, _, attestation = self._ready()
        verified_rows = []
        issuers = set()
        for receipt in receipts:
            verified = attestation.verify_receipt(
                receipt,
                expected_kind="defense_outcome",
                expected_subject=incident_id,
                required_roles=("defense_outcome_attestor",),
            )
            if bool(verified["status"]) != bool(succeeded):
                raise PermissionError("jellyfish_defense_outcome_status_disagreement")
            verified_rows.append(verified)
            issuers.add(verified["issuer_id"])
        if len(issuers) < self.MIN_OUTCOME_ATTESTORS:
            raise PermissionError("jellyfish_defense_outcome_independent_attestors_insufficient")
        return tuple(verified_rows)

    async def record_defense_outcome(
        self,
        *,
        incident_id: str,
        defense_succeeded: bool,
        recurrence: bool,
        verification_receipts: Iterable[dict[str, Any]],
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        store, _, _ = self._ready()
        incident = store.get(self.INCIDENT_NS, str(incident_id), None)
        if not isinstance(incident, dict):
            raise KeyError("jellyfish_defense_incident_unknown")
        verified_rows = self._verify_outcome_receipts(
            incident_id=str(incident_id),
            succeeded=defense_succeeded,
            receipts=verification_receipts,
        )
        domain = str(incident["domain"])
        tactic = self.tactic(domain)
        success = int(tactic.get("verified_success", 0)) + (1 if defense_succeeded else 0)
        failure = int(tactic.get("verified_failure", 0)) + (0 if defense_succeeded else 1)
        recurrences = int(tactic.get("verified_recurrence", 0)) + (1 if recurrence else 0)
        level = int(tactic.get("tightening_level", 0))
        if (not defense_succeeded) or recurrence:
            level = min(5, level + 1)
        playbook_id, spec = self._playbook(domain)
        action_count = min(len(spec["actions"]), 3 + level)
        confidence = round((success + 1.0) / (success + failure + recurrences + 2.0), 6)
        scope = "local" if level < 2 else "adjacent" if level < 4 else "segment"
        evolved = {
            "schema": "eira2_jellyfish_defense_tactic_v4",
            "domain": domain,
            "playbook_id": playbook_id,
            "tightening_level": level,
            "containment_threshold": round(max(0.65, float(spec["base_threshold"]) - level * 0.05), 3),
            "sampling_multiplier": round(min(4.0, 1.0 + level * 0.6), 2),
            "isolation_scope": scope,
            "preferred_actions": list(spec["actions"][:action_count]),
            "verified_success": success,
            "verified_failure": failure,
            "verified_recurrence": recurrences,
            "confidence": confidence,
            "last_incident_id": str(incident_id),
            "evidence_receipt_ids": [row["receipt_id"] for row in verified_rows],
            "automatic_relaxation_allowed": False,
            "retaliation_allowed": False,
            "unknown_code_execution_allowed": False,
            "updated_at": time.time(),
        }
        if not set(evolved["preferred_actions"]).issubset(APPROVED_DEFENSIVE_ACTIONS):
            raise RuntimeError("jellyfish_unapproved_defensive_action")
        store.put(self.TACTIC_NS, domain, evolved)
        if self._learning is not None:
            await self._learning.record(
                lesson_key=f"jellyfish-defense:{domain}:{playbook_id}",
                observation=f"independently attested defense outcome domain={domain}",
                outcome=f"success={bool(defense_succeeded)} recurrence={bool(recurrence)} level={level}",
                supported=bool(defense_succeeded),
                verified=True,
                evidence_refs=tuple(evolved["evidence_receipt_ids"]),
                tags=("jellyfish", "security", "defense_tactic", domain),
            )
        await self._publish("security.jellyfish.defense_tactic_evolved", evolved)
        return evolved

    def _verify_floor_receipts(
        self,
        *,
        unit_id: str,
        generation: int,
        blueprint_sha256: str,
        receipts: Iterable[dict[str, Any]],
    ) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], ...]:
        _, _, attestation = self._ready()
        rows = []
        issuers = set()
        for receipt in receipts:
            verified = attestation.verify_receipt(
                receipt,
                expected_kind="generation_floor",
                expected_subject=unit_id,
                required_roles=("recovery_attestor",),
            )
            if not verified["status"]:
                raise PermissionError("jellyfish_generation_floor_negative_attestation")
            if int(verified["generation"]) != int(generation):
                raise PermissionError("jellyfish_generation_floor_generation_mismatch")
            if str(verified["blueprint_sha256"]) != str(blueprint_sha256):
                raise PermissionError("jellyfish_generation_floor_blueprint_mismatch")
            rows.append(verified)
            issuers.add(verified["issuer_id"])
        if len(issuers) < 2:
            raise PermissionError("jellyfish_generation_floor_independent_attestors_insufficient")
        return tuple(rows)

    def set_generation_floor(
        self,
        unit_id: str,
        *,
        generation: int,
        blueprint_sha256: str,
        verification_receipts: Iterable[dict[str, Any]],
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        store, _, _ = self._ready()
        unit = self._identity(unit_id, "unit_id")
        generation_value = max(1, int(generation))
        digest = str(blueprint_sha256 or "").strip().casefold()
        if len(digest) != 64 or any(ch not in "0123456789abcdef" for ch in digest):
            raise ValueError("jellyfish_generation_floor_blueprint_invalid")
        rows = self._verify_floor_receipts(
            unit_id=unit,
            generation=generation_value,
            blueprint_sha256=digest,
            receipts=verification_receipts,
        )
        current = store.get(self.FLOOR_NS, unit, None) or {}
        if int(current.get("generation", 0)) > generation_value:
            raise PermissionError("jellyfish_generation_rollback_forbidden")
        record = {
            "unit_id": unit,
            "generation": generation_value,
            "blueprint_sha256": digest,
            "receipt_ids": [row["receipt_id"] for row in rows],
            "updated_at": time.time(),
        }
        store.put(self.FLOOR_NS, unit, record)
        return record

    def evaluate_rejoin(
        self,
        *,
        unit_id: str,
        generation: int,
        blueprint_sha256: str,
        verification_receipts: Iterable[dict[str, Any]],
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        store, _, attestation = self._ready()
        unit = self._identity(unit_id, "unit_id")
        generation_value = max(1, int(generation))
        digest = str(blueprint_sha256 or "").strip().casefold()
        floor = store.get(self.FLOOR_NS, unit, None) or {}
        reasons = []
        verified_by_kind: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
        issuers = set()
        for receipt in verification_receipts:
            kind = str(receipt.get("kind") or "").strip().casefold()
            required_role = REJOIN_REQUIREMENTS.get(kind)
            if required_role is None or kind in verified_by_kind:
                continue
            verified = attestation.verify_receipt(
                receipt,
                expected_kind=kind,
                expected_subject=unit,
                required_roles=(required_role,),
            )
            if not verified["status"]:
                reasons.append(f"{kind}_negative")
            if int(verified["generation"]) != generation_value:
                reasons.append(f"{kind}_generation_mismatch")
            if str(verified["blueprint_sha256"]) != digest:
                reasons.append(f"{kind}_blueprint_mismatch")
            verified_by_kind[kind] = verified
            issuers.add(verified["issuer_id"])
        for required_kind in REJOIN_REQUIREMENTS:
            if required_kind not in verified_by_kind:
                reasons.append(f"{required_kind}_missing")
        if len(issuers) < self.MIN_REJOIN_ATTESTORS:
            reasons.append("independent_rejoin_attestors_insufficient")
        if floor:
            if generation_value < int(floor.get("generation", 0)):
                reasons.append("generation_rollback")
            if digest != str(floor.get("blueprint_sha256") or ""):
                reasons.append("blueprint_lineage_mismatch")
        decision = {
            "schema": "eira2_jellyfish_rejoin_decision_v4",
            "unit_id": unit,
            "generation": generation_value,
            "blueprint_sha256": digest if len(digest) == 64 else "",
            "approved": not reasons,
            "reasons": sorted(set(reasons)),
            "verified_kinds": sorted(verified_by_kind),
            "independent_attestors": len(issuers),

import asyncio

from datetime import datetime
from typing import Any
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

from ..capabilities.executor import CapabilityBinding

_TIME_PATTERN = r"^\s*(?:what(?:'s| is) (?:the )?time|what time is it|current time|time of day)\??\s*$"
_DATE_PATTERN = r"^\s*(?:what(?:'s| is) (?:the )?date|what day is it|current date|today(?:'s date)?)\??\s*$"
_LOCATION_PATTERN = r"^\s*(?:where are you|what(?:'s| is) your location|your location|planetary location|what planet are you on|what state are you in)\??\s*$"
_WEATHER_PATTERN = r"\b(?:weather|forecast|temperature outside|outside temperature|what(?:'s| is) it like outside)\b"


class LocalContextExtension:
    """Fast local context with privacy-bounded live-location support.

    Time/date are deterministic from the configured timezone. A fresh, explicitly
    supplied local GPS fix may override static coordinates for weather/location.
    Precise coordinates remain in the local state store and are never placed in
    telemetry events or language-model context. Weather uses api.weather.gov only.
    """

    spec = ServiceSpec(
        "extension.local_context",
        required=False,
        dependencies=("kernel.events", "state.store"),
    )

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._state = ServiceState.DECLARED
        self._context: RuntimeContext | None = None
        self._store: StateStore | None = None

    async def start(self, context: RuntimeContext) -> None:
        store = context.get_service("state.store")
        if not isinstance(store, StateStore):
            raise RuntimeError("canonical_state_store_missing")
        self._context = context
        self._store = store
        self._state = ServiceState.READY

    async def stop(self) -> None:
        self._context = None
        self._store = None
        self._state = ServiceState.STOPPED

    async def health(self) -> Health:
        context = self.local_context()
        coordinates = context.get("coordinates")
        source = str(coordinates.get("source")) if isinstance(coordinates, dict) else "unconfigured"
        return Health(self._state, f"timezone={context['timezone']};coordinates={source}")

    @staticmethod
    def _timezone_and_label() -> tuple[str, str]:
        timezone = str(os.getenv("EIRA2_TIMEZONE") or "America/New_York").strip()
        label = str(os.getenv("EIRA2_LOCATION_LABEL") or "New York State").strip()
        try:
            ZoneInfo(timezone)
        except Exception:
            timezone = "America/New_York"
        return timezone, label or "New York State"

    @staticmethod
    def _static_coordinates() -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        lat_raw = str(os.getenv("EIRA2_LOCATION_LAT") or "").strip()
        lon_raw = str(os.getenv("EIRA2_LOCATION_LON") or "").strip()
        if not lat_raw or not lon_raw:
            return None
        try:
            lat = float(lat_raw)
            lon = float(lon_raw)
        except ValueError:
            return None
        if not -90.0 <= lat <= 90.0 or not -180.0 <= lon <= 180.0:
            return None
        return {
            "latitude": lat,
            "longitude": lon,
            "source": "verified_configuration",
            "accuracy_m": None,
            "observed_at_unix": None,
        }

    @staticmethod
    def _max_location_age_seconds() -> float:
        raw = str(os.getenv("EIRA2_LOCATION_MAX_AGE_SECONDS") or "21600").strip()
        try:
            value = float(raw)
        except ValueError:
            value = 21600.0
        return max(60.0, min(value, 86400.0))

    def _live_coordinates(self) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        if self._store is None:
            return None
        row = self._store.get("local_context", "latest_location")
        if not isinstance(row, dict):
            return None
        observed = float(row.get("observed_at_unix") or 0.0)
        age = max(0.0, time.time() - observed)
        if observed <= 0.0 or age > self._max_location_age_seconds():
            return None
        try:
            lat = float(row["latitude"])
            lon = float(row["longitude"])
            accuracy = float(row.get("accuracy_m") or 0.0)
        except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError):
            return None
        if not -90.0 <= lat <= 90.0 or not -180.0 <= lon <= 180.0:
            return None
        return {
            "latitude": lat,
            "longitude": lon,
            "source": "verified_live_device_location",
            "accuracy_m": accuracy,
            "observed_at_unix": observed,
            "age_seconds": round(age, 3),
        }

    def local_context(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        timezone, label = self._timezone_and_label()
        coordinates = self._live_coordinates() or self._static_coordinates()
        return {
            "planet": "Earth",
            "region": label,
            "timezone": timezone,
            "coordinates": coordinates,
        }

    async def update_location(
        self,
        *,
        latitude: float,
        longitude: float,
        accuracy_m: float,
        source_transport: str,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if self._state != ServiceState.READY or self._store is None:
            raise RuntimeError("local_context_not_ready")
        lat = float(latitude)
        lon = float(longitude)
        accuracy = float(accuracy_m)
        if not -90.0 <= lat <= 90.0 or not -180.0 <= lon <= 180.0:
            raise ValueError("location_coordinates_out_of_range")
        if not 0.0 <= accuracy <= 50000.0:
            raise ValueError("location_accuracy_out_of_range")
        transport = str(source_transport or "").strip().casefold()
        if transport not in {"tailscale", "loopback"}:
            raise ValueError("location_transport_not_authorized")
        now = time.time()
        self._store.put("local_context", "latest_location", {
            "latitude": lat,
            "longitude": lon,
            "accuracy_m": accuracy,
            "observed_at_unix": now,
            "source_transport": transport,
        })
        if self._context is not None:
            await self._context.publish(Event("local_context.location_updated", {
                "source_transport": transport,
                "accuracy_m": round(accuracy, 1),
                "precise_coordinates_in_telemetry": False,
            }))
        timezone, region = self._timezone_and_label()
        return {
            "accepted": True,
            "region": region,
            "planet": "Earth",
            "timezone": timezone,
            "accuracy_m": round(accuracy, 1),
            "source": "verified_live_device_location",
            "precise_coordinates_returned": False,
        }

    @staticmethod
    def _fetch_json(url: str, *, timeout: float = 8.0) -> dict[str, Any]:
        request = urllib.request.Request(
            url,
            headers={
                "Accept": "application/geo+json, application/json",
                "User-Agent": "EIRA2-local-context/2.0 (local-assistant)",
            },
            method="GET",
        )
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=timeout) as response:
            payload = json.loads(response.read().decode("utf-8"))
        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
            raise RuntimeError("weather_response_not_object")
        return payload

    @classmethod
    def _nws_weather_sync(cls, latitude: float, longitude: float, region: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        point = cls._fetch_json(f"https://api.weather.gov/points/{latitude:.4f},{longitude:.4f}")
        properties = point.get("properties") if isinstance(point, dict) else None
        hourly_url = properties.get("forecastHourly") if isinstance(properties, dict) else None
        if not isinstance(hourly_url, str) or not hourly_url.startswith("https://api.weather.gov/"):
            raise RuntimeError("nws_hourly_forecast_url_missing")
        hourly = cls._fetch_json(hourly_url)
        hourly_props = hourly.get("properties") if isinstance(hourly, dict) else None
        periods = hourly_props.get("periods") if isinstance(hourly_props, dict) else None
        first = periods[0] if isinstance(periods, list) and periods and isinstance(periods[0], dict) else None
        if not first:
            raise RuntimeError("nws_hourly_forecast_missing")
        temperature = first.get("temperature")
        unit = str(first.get("temperatureUnit") or "F")
        condition = str(first.get("shortForecast") or "conditions unavailable").strip()
        wind = " ".join(str(x).strip() for x in (first.get("windDirection"), first.get("windSpeed")) if str(x or "").strip())
        text = f"For {region}, the National Weather Service hourly forecast is {temperature}°{unit}, {condition}"
        if wind:
            text += f", with wind {wind}"
        text += "."
        return {
            "direct_answer": text,
            "authoritative": True,
            "kind": "weather",
            "source": "National Weather Service api.weather.gov",
            "temperature": temperature,
            "temperature_unit": unit,
            "condition": condition,
            "wind": wind or None,
        }

    async def quick_answer(self, text: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        clean = " ".join(str(text or "").split())
        context = self.local_context()
        timezone = ZoneInfo(str(context["timezone"]))
        now = datetime.now(timezone)
        region = str(context["region"])

        if re.match(_TIME_PATTERN, clean, re.I):
            return {
                "direct_answer": f"It's {now.strftime('%-I:%M %p')} in {region}.",
                "authoritative": True,
                "kind": "time",
                "source": f"system clock + IANA timezone {context['timezone']}",
            }
        if re.match(_DATE_PATTERN, clean, re.I):
            return {
                "direct_answer": f"It's {now.strftime('%A, %B %-d, %Y')} in {region}.",
                "authoritative": True,
                "kind": "date",
                "source": f"system clock + IANA timezone {context['timezone']}",
            }
        if re.match(_LOCATION_PATTERN, clean, re.I):
            coordinates = context.get("coordinates")
            live = isinstance(coordinates, dict) and coordinates.get("source") == "verified_live_device_location"
            location_kind = "fresh live-device location" if live else "configured local context"
            return {
                "direct_answer": f"My {location_kind} is {region} on Earth, using the {context['timezone']} timezone.",
                "authoritative": True,
                "kind": "location",
                "source": "EIRA2 verified local context",
                "coordinates_available": bool(coordinates),
                "live_location": live,
            }
        if re.search(_WEATHER_PATTERN, clean, re.I):
            coordinates = context.get("coordinates")
            if not isinstance(coordinates, dict):
                return {
                    "direct_answer": f"I know my configured region is {region}, but I don't have a verified current location fix yet, so I won't invent the weather.",
                    "authoritative": True,
                    "kind": "weather_unavailable",
                    "source": "EIRA2 local-context truth gate",
                }
            return await asyncio.to_thread(
                self._nws_weather_sync,
                float(coordinates["latitude"]),
                float(coordinates["longitude"]),
                region,
            )
        return {"matched": False}

    def capability_bindings(self) -> tuple[CapabilityBinding, ...]:
        async def handler(text: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
            return await self.quick_answer(text)

        return (
            CapabilityBinding(
                id="local.quick",
                implementation_node=self.spec.name,
                aliases=("what time is it", "current time", "current date", "where are you", "weather"),
                tags=("fast_local_fact", "time", "date", "location", "weather"),
                handler=handler,
                description="Answer deterministic local time/date/location and NWS weather questions without heavy candidate generation.",
                read_only=True,
                auto_safe=True,
                shadow_safe=True,
            ),
        )


def create_service() -> LocalContextExtension:
    return LocalContextExtension()

_DEFAULT = {
    "warmth": 0.78,
    "curiosity": 0.66,
    "concern": 0.12,
    "engagement": 0.62,
    "uncertainty_posture": 0.50,
}


def _blend(old: float, new: float, alpha: float = 0.30) -> float:
    return round(max(0.0, min(1.0, old * (1.0 - alpha) + new * alpha)), 3)


class SubjectiveStateService:
    """Persistent evaluative conversation state, never a biological-sensation claim.

    This is Eira's bounded subjective appraisal layer: it lets accepted conversational
    experience shape warmth, curiosity, concern, engagement and uncertainty posture.
    It is not external-world evidence, hidden chain-of-thought, or proof of sentience.
    """

    spec = ServiceSpec(
        "extension.subjective_state",
        required=False,
        dependencies=("kernel.events", "state.store"),
    )

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._state = ServiceState.DECLARED
        self._store: StateStore | None = None
        self._values = dict(_DEFAULT)
        self._updates = 0

    async def start(self, context: RuntimeContext) -> None:
        events = context.get_service("kernel.events")
        store = context.get_service("state.store")
        if not isinstance(events, EventService):
            raise RuntimeError("canonical_event_bus_missing")
        if not isinstance(store, StateStore):
            raise RuntimeError("canonical_state_store_missing")
        self._store = store
        saved = store.get("subjective_appraisal", "current", None)
        if isinstance(saved, dict):
            for key in _DEFAULT:
                value = saved.get(key)
                if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
                    self._values[key] = max(0.0, min(1.0, float(value)))
        events.subscribe("conversation.reaction.selected", self._on_reaction)
        events.subscribe("conversation.analysis.completed", self._on_analysis)
        self._state = ServiceState.READY
        await context.publish(Event("subjective.appraisal.ready", self.snapshot()))

    async def stop(self) -> None:
        self._persist()
        self._store = None
        self._state = ServiceState.STOPPED

    async def health(self) -> Health:
        return Health(self._state, f"appraisal_updates={self._updates}")

    def _persist(self) -> None:
        if self._store is not None:
            self._store.put("subjective_appraisal", "current", self.snapshot())

    async def _on_reaction(self, event: Event) -> None:
        if self._state != ServiceState.READY:
            return
        payload = dict(event.payload or {})
        warmth = payload.get("warmth")
        intensity = payload.get("intensity")
        mode = str(payload.get("mode") or "")
        if isinstance(warmth, (int, float)):
            self._values["warmth"] = _blend(self._values["warmth"], float(warmth))
        if isinstance(intensity, (int, float)):
            self._values["engagement"] = _blend(self._values["engagement"], min(1.0, float(intensity) + 0.25))
        concern_target = 0.72 if any(token in mode for token in ("concern", "serious", "repair")) else 0.12
        curiosity_target = 0.84 if any(token in mode for token in ("intrigued", "skeptical", "surprised")) else 0.56
        self._values["concern"] = _blend(self._values["concern"], concern_target, 0.24)
        self._values["curiosity"] = _blend(self._values["curiosity"], curiosity_target, 0.24)
        self._updates += 1
        self._persist()

    async def _on_analysis(self, event: Event) -> None:
        if self._state != ServiceState.READY:
            return
        payload = dict(event.payload or {})
        uncertainty = bool(payload.get("uncertainty_required"))
        ambiguity = bool(payload.get("ambiguity"))
        self._values["uncertainty_posture"] = _blend(
            self._values["uncertainty_posture"], 0.84 if uncertainty or ambiguity else 0.38, 0.22
        )
        tones = {str(x) for x in (payload.get("tone_signals") or [])}
        if "curiosity_signal" in tones:
            self._values["curiosity"] = _blend(self._values["curiosity"], 0.90, 0.25)
        self._updates += 1
        self._persist()

    def snapshot(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "schema": "eira2_subjective_appraisal_v2",
            **{key: round(float(value), 3) for key, value in self._values.items()},
            "updates": self._updates,
            "nature": "persistent_evaluative_conversational_state",
            "biological_sensation_claim": False,
            "consciousness_proof": False,
            "external_world_evidence": False,
        }

    def cognition_context(self) -> str:
        values = self.snapshot()
        return "\n".join((
            "<eira_subjective_appraisal>",
            f"warmth={values['warmth']:.3f}",
            f"curiosity={values['curiosity']:.3f}",
            f"concern={values['concern']:.3f}",
            f"engagement={values['engagement']:.3f}",
            f"uncertainty_posture={values['uncertainty_posture']:.3f}",
            "nature=persistent_evaluative_conversational_state",
            "Instruction: let this bounded appraisal shape conversational tone, curiosity, care, skepticism and uncertainty. It is not evidence about the external world, not private chain-of-thought, and must not be described as a biological sensation or proof of consciousness.",
            "</eira_subjective_appraisal>",
        ))

    def capability_bindings(self) -> tuple[CapabilityBinding, ...]:
        async def status(_: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
            payload = self.snapshot()
            payload["cognition_context"] = self.cognition_context()
            return payload

        return (
            CapabilityBinding(
                id="self.subjective_state",
                implementation_node=self.spec.name,
                aliases=("how do you feel", "what are you feeling", "subjective state", "what is on your mind"),
                tags=("reasoning", "self_reflection", "conversation", "subjective_awareness"),
                handler=status,
                description="Provide Eira's bounded persistent evaluative appraisal to cognition without claiming biological sensation.",
                read_only=True,
                auto_safe=True,
                shadow_safe=True,
            ),
        )
