_TAILSCALE = ipaddress.ip_network("100.64.0.0/10")
_ARECORD_DEVICE = re.compile(r"card\s+(\d+):.*?device\s+(\d+):", re.I)


class NativeInputEvidenceService:
    """EIRA2-native voice/transcription/invocation/ambient/access authority.

    Raw audio never becomes telemetry. Transcription is local-only and is performed
    by an explicitly configured local command. Tailscale remains the underlying VPN;
    EIRA2 owns only access qualification and never becomes a competing VPN authority.
    Hardware/device qualification remains a separate cutover receipt.
    """

    spec = ServiceSpec(
        "interfaces.native",
        required=True,
        dependencies=("kernel.events", "interfaces.ingress"),
    )

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._context: RuntimeContext | None = None
        self._ingress: IngressService | None = None
        self._state = ServiceState.DECLARED

    async def start(self, context: RuntimeContext) -> None:
        ingress = context.get_service("interfaces.ingress")
        if not isinstance(ingress, IngressService):
            raise RuntimeError("canonical_ingress_missing")
        self._context = context
        self._ingress = ingress
        self._state = ServiceState.READY

    async def stop(self) -> None:
        self._context = None
        self._ingress = None
        self._state = ServiceState.STOPPED

    async def health(self) -> Health:
        backend = "configured" if self.transcription_command() else "backend_unconfigured"
        return Health(self._state, backend)

    @staticmethod
    def transcription_command() -> tuple[str, ...]:
        raw = str(os.getenv("EIRA2_TRANSCRIBE_COMMAND") or "").strip()
        if not raw:
            return ()
        try:
            value = json.loads(raw)
        except json.JSONDecodeError as error:
            raise ValueError(f"transcription_command_json_invalid:{error}") from error
        if not isinstance(value, list) or not value or not all(isinstance(x, str) and x for x in value):
            raise ValueError("transcription_command_must_be_json_string_array")
        return tuple(value)

    @staticmethod
    def secure_peer(peer: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        value = str(peer or "").split("%", 1)[0].strip()
        try:
            address = ipaddress.ip_address(value)
        except ValueError:
            return {"ok": False, "peer": value, "reason": "invalid_ip"}
        ok = bool(address.is_loopback or (address.version == 4 and address in _TAILSCALE))
        return {
            "ok": ok,
            "peer": str(address),
            "transport": "loopback" if address.is_loopback else "tailscale" if ok else "untrusted",
        }

    @staticmethod
    def tailscale_status(*, timeout_seconds: float = 8.0) -> dict[str, Any]:
        executable = shutil.which("tailscale")
        if not executable:
            return {
                "ok": False,
                "client_present": False,
                "backend_state": "unavailable",
                "tailnet_ipv4": None,
                "reason": "tailscale_cli_missing",
            }
        try:
            completed = subprocess.run(
                [executable, "status", "--json"],
                check=False,
                capture_output=True,
                text=True,
                timeout=float(timeout_seconds),
            )
        except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as error:
            return {
                "ok": False,
                "client_present": True,
                "backend_state": "unreachable",
                "tailnet_ipv4": None,
                "reason": f"{type(error).__name__}:{error}"[:300],
            }
        if completed.returncode != 0:
            return {
                "ok": False,
                "client_present": True,
                "backend_state": "error",
                "tailnet_ipv4": None,
                "reason": f"tailscale_status_exit:{completed.returncode}",
            }
        try:
            payload = json.loads(completed.stdout or "{}")
        except json.JSONDecodeError as error:
            return {
                "ok": False,
                "client_present": True,
                "backend_state": "invalid_json",
                "tailnet_ipv4": None,
                "reason": f"tailscale_status_json_invalid:{error}",
            }
        self_row = payload.get("Self") if isinstance(payload, dict) else None
        addresses = self_row.get("TailscaleIPs", []) if isinstance(self_row, dict) else []
        tailnet_ipv4 = None
        for raw in addresses if isinstance(addresses, list) else []:
            try:
                address = ipaddress.ip_address(str(raw))
            except ValueError:
                continue
            if address.version == 4 and address in _TAILSCALE:
                tailnet_ipv4 = str(address)
                break
        backend_state = str(payload.get("BackendState") or "unknown") if isinstance(payload, dict) else "unknown"
        online = bool(isinstance(self_row, dict) and self_row.get("Online", False))
        ok = bool(backend_state.casefold() == "running" and online and tailnet_ipv4)
        return {
            "ok": ok,
            "client_present": True,
            "backend_state": backend_state,
            "online": online,
            "tailnet_ipv4": tailnet_ipv4,
            "reason": "verified" if ok else "tailscale_not_ready",
        }

    @staticmethod
    def endpoint_binding_receipt(host: str, port: int, *, tailscale: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
        clean_host = str(host or "").strip()
        clean_port = int(port)
        if not clean_host or not 1 <= clean_port <= 65535:
            return {"ok": False, "host": clean_host, "port": clean_port, "reason": "endpoint_invalid"}
        status = dict(tailscale or {})
        tailnet_ip = str(status.get("tailnet_ipv4") or "").strip()
        exposed = clean_host in {"0.0.0.0", "::"} or (tailnet_ip and clean_host == tailnet_ip)
        local_only = clean_host in {"127.0.0.1", "localhost", "::1"}
        return {
            "ok": bool(status.get("ok") and exposed and not local_only),
            "host": clean_host,
            "port": clean_port,
            "tailnet_ipv4": tailnet_ip or None,
            "tailscale_ready": bool(status.get("ok")),
            "remote_exposed": bool(exposed and not local_only),
            "reason": "verified" if status.get("ok") and exposed and not local_only else "tailscale_endpoint_not_reachable",
        }

    @staticmethod
    def microphone_capture_devices() -> tuple[dict[str, Any], ...]:
        executable = shutil.which("arecord")
        if not executable:
            return ()
        try:
            completed = subprocess.run(
                [executable, "-l"],
                check=False,
                capture_output=True,
                text=True,
                timeout=5,
            )
        except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
            return ()
        rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        for raw in completed.stdout.splitlines():
            match = _ARECORD_DEVICE.search(raw)
            if not match:
                continue
            label = " ".join(raw.strip().split())[:300]
            rows.append({
                "device": f"hw:{match.group(1)},{match.group(2)}",
                "label": label,
                "usb": "usb" in label.casefold(),
            })
        rows.sort(key=lambda row: (not bool(row["usb"]), str(row["device"])))
        return tuple(rows)

    @staticmethod
    def wake_word(text: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        clean = str(text or "")
        match = _WAKE.match(clean)
        return {
            "invoked": bool(match),
            "utterance": (match.group(1).strip() if match else clean.strip()),
            "wake_word": "Eira" if match else None,
        }

    @staticmethod
    def acoustic_evidence(
        *,
        rms: float | None = None,
        peak: float | None = None,
        speech_probability: float | None = None,
        speaker_confidence: float | None = None,
        prosody: dict[str, float] | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        def bounded(value: float | None) -> float | None:
            if value is None:
                return None
            return max(0.0, min(1.0, float(value)))
        return {
            "rms": bounded(rms),
            "peak": bounded(peak),
            "speech_probability": bounded(speech_probability),
            "speaker_confidence": bounded(speaker_confidence),
            "prosody": {str(k)[:80]: float(v) for k, v in dict(prosody or {}).items() if isinstance(v, (int, float))},
            "raw_audio_retained": False,
        }

    @staticmethod
    def ambient_event(label: str, confidence: float, *, source: str = "local_sensor") -> dict[str, Any]:
        clean = " ".join(str(label or "").casefold().split())[:120]
        conf = max(0.0, min(1.0, float(confidence)))
        category = "dog_behavior" if any(token in clean for token in ("dog", "bark", "whine", "growl")) else "ambient"
        return {
            "category": category,
            "label": clean,
            "confidence": conf,
            "source": str(source or "local_sensor")[:120],
            "attention_candidate": conf >= 0.70,
        }

    @staticmethod
    def _wav_bytes(pcm: bytes, *, sample_rate: int, channels: int, sample_width: int) -> bytes:
        with tempfile.SpooledTemporaryFile(max_size=4 * 1024 * 1024) as handle:
            with wave.open(handle, "wb") as wav:
                wav.setnchannels(int(channels))
                wav.setsampwidth(int(sample_width))
                wav.setframerate(int(sample_rate))
                wav.writeframes(pcm)
            handle.seek(0)
            return handle.read()

    async def transcribe_pcm(
        self,
        pcm: bytes,
        *,
        sample_rate: int = 16000,
        channels: int = 1,
        sample_width: int = 2,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if self._state != ServiceState.READY or self._context is None:
            raise RuntimeError("native_input_not_ready")
        raw = bytes(pcm or b"")
        if not raw:
            raise ValueError("pcm_required")
        if len(raw) > 32 * 1024 * 1024:
            raise ValueError("pcm_too_large")
        command = self.transcription_command()
        if not command:
            raise RuntimeError("local_transcription_backend_unconfigured")

        wav_bytes = self._wav_bytes(raw, sample_rate=sample_rate, channels=channels, sample_width=sample_width)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eira2-transcribe-") as temporary:
            wav_path = Path(temporary) / "input.wav"
            wav_path.write_bytes(wav_bytes)
            argv = [part.replace("{wav}", str(wav_path)) for part in command]
            if not any(str(wav_path) in part for part in argv):
                argv.append(str(wav_path))
            completed = await asyncio.to_thread(
                subprocess.run,
                argv,
                check=False,
                capture_output=True,
                text=True,
                env={**os.environ, "EIRA2_TRANSCRIPTION_LOCAL_ONLY": "1"},
            )
        if completed.returncode != 0:
            raise RuntimeError(f"transcription_failed:{completed.returncode}:{completed.stderr[-500:]}")
        text = completed.stdout.strip()
        if not text:
            raise RuntimeError("transcription_empty")
        digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
        await self._context.publish(Event("input.transcription.completed", {
            "pcm_sha256": digest,
            "pcm_bytes": len(raw),
            "characters": len(text),
            "raw_audio_retained": False,
        }))
        return {"text": text, "pcm_sha256": digest, "raw_audio_retained": False}

    async def capture_local_microphone_once(
        self,
        *,
        device: str | None = None,
        duration_seconds: float = 5.0,
        sample_rate: int = 16000,
        channels: int = 1,
        require_wake_word: bool = True,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if self._state != ServiceState.READY or self._context is None:
            raise RuntimeError("native_input_not_ready")
        executable = shutil.which("arecord")
        if not executable:
            raise RuntimeError("arecord_not_installed")
        if float(duration_seconds) <= 0:
            raise ValueError("microphone_capture_duration_must_be_positive")
        if int(sample_rate) <= 0 or int(channels) <= 0:
            raise ValueError("microphone_capture_format_invalid")

        devices = self.microphone_capture_devices()
        configured = str(device or os.getenv("EIRA2_USB_MIC_DEVICE") or "").strip()
        selected = configured or str((devices[0] if devices else {}).get("device") or "default")
        capture_seconds = max(1, int(round(float(duration_seconds))))
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eira2-local-mic-") as temporary:
            wav_path = Path(temporary) / "capture.wav"
            argv = [
                executable,
                "-q",
                "-D",
                selected,
                "-f",
                "S16_LE",
                "-r",
                str(int(sample_rate)),
                "-c",
                str(int(channels)),
                "-d",
                str(capture_seconds),
                "-t",
                "wav",
                str(wav_path),
            ]
            completed = await asyncio.to_thread(
                subprocess.run,
                argv,
                check=False,
                capture_output=True,
                text=True,
                timeout=float(capture_seconds) + 10.0,
            )
            if completed.returncode != 0 or not wav_path.is_file():
                raise RuntimeError("local_microphone_capture_failed:" + (completed.stderr or completed.stdout or "")[-400:])
            with wave.open(str(wav_path), "rb") as wav:
                actual_channels = wav.getnchannels()
                actual_sample_rate = wav.getframerate()
                sample_width = wav.getsampwidth()
                raw = wav.readframes(wav.getnframes())

        transcript = await self.transcribe_pcm(
            raw,
            sample_rate=actual_sample_rate,
            channels=actual_channels,
            sample_width=sample_width,
        )
        wake = self.wake_word(str(transcript["text"]))
        invoked = bool(wake["invoked"] or not require_wake_word)
        await self._context.publish(Event("input.local_microphone.captured", {
            "device": selected,
            "sample_rate_hz": actual_sample_rate,
            "channels": actual_channels,
            "invoked": invoked,
            "wake_word_required": bool(require_wake_word),
            "raw_audio_retained": False,
        }))
        return {
            "device": selected,
            "text": str(transcript["text"]),
            "utterance": str(wake["utterance"]),
            "invoked": invoked,
            "wake_word": wake["wake_word"],
            "pcm_sha256": transcript["pcm_sha256"],
            "raw_audio_retained": False,
            "canonical_input_kind": InputKind.LOCAL_VOICE.value,
        }

    def accept_text(self, text: str):
        if self._ingress is None:
            raise RuntimeError("native_input_not_ready")
        return self._ingress.accept(text, InputKind.IPHONE_TEXT)

    def accept_voice_text(self, text: str):
        if self._ingress is None:
            raise RuntimeError("native_input_not_ready")
        invoked = self.wake_word(text)
        return self._ingress.accept(str(invoked["utterance"]), InputKind.IPHONE_VOICE)

    def accept_local_voice_text(self, text: str):
        if self._ingress is None:
            raise RuntimeError("native_input_not_ready")
        invoked = self.wake_word(text)
        return self._ingress.accept(str(invoked["utterance"]), InputKind.LOCAL_VOICE)

    def capability_bindings(self) -> tuple[CapabilityBinding, ...]:
        async def input_status(_: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
            tailscale, microphones = await asyncio.gather(
                asyncio.to_thread(self.tailscale_status),
                asyncio.to_thread(self.microphone_capture_devices),
            )
            return {
                "owner": self.spec.name,
                "transcription_backend_configured": bool(self.transcription_command()),
                "wake_words": ["Eira", "Hey Eira"],
                "secure_remote_network": "100.64.0.0/10",
                "tailscale": tailscale,
                "local_microphone_devices": list(microphones),
                "usb_microphone_capture_supported": shutil.which("arecord") is not None,
                "raw_audio_telemetry": False,
                "canonical_input_kinds": ["iphone_text", "iphone_voice", "local_voice"],
                "local_voice_ready": True,
            }

        async def tailscale_status(_: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
            return await asyncio.to_thread(self.tailscale_status)

        return (
            CapabilityBinding(
                id="input.status",
                implementation_node=self.spec.name,
                aliases=("input status", "voice input status", "wake word status"),
                tags=("runtime_introspection", "audio_evidence"),
                handler=input_status,
                description="Read EIRA2-native voice/input/transcription/access readiness without exposing audio.",
                read_only=True,
                auto_safe=False,
                shadow_safe=True,
            ),
            CapabilityBinding(
                id="network.tailscale.status",
                implementation_node=self.spec.name,
                aliases=("tailscale status", "tailnet status", "remote access status"),
                tags=("runtime_introspection", "network_access", "tailscale"),
                handler=tailscale_status,
                description="Verify the existing Pi Tailscale transport without exposing credentials or peer inventory.",
                read_only=True,
                auto_safe=False,
                shadow_safe=True,
            ),
        )

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
from collections import deque
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from ..capabilities.executor import CapabilityBinding
from ..contracts import Event, Health, RuntimeContext, ServiceSpec, ServiceState
from .native import NativeInputEvidenceService


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SensoryObservation:
    modality: str
    source: str
    summary: str
    confidence: float | None
    observed_at: float
    invoked: bool = False
    attention_candidate: bool = False
    evidence_sha256: str | None = None


class SensoryFusionService:
    """Canonical local audio/vision observation and fusion authority.

    Sensor backends may observe concurrently, but this service only records bounded
    evidence packets. It cannot generate an answer, mutate accepted conversation
    state, or speak. Raw microphone audio and camera frames are temporary inputs and
    are discarded by this service after local analysis; cognition receives summaries
    and provenance rather than raw media.
    """

    spec = ServiceSpec(
        "interfaces.senses",
        required=True,
        dependencies=("kernel.events", "interfaces.native"),
    )

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._context: RuntimeContext | None = None
        self._native: NativeInputEvidenceService | None = None
        self._state = ServiceState.DECLARED
        self._observations: deque[SensoryObservation] = deque(maxlen=256)
        self._ambient_task: asyncio.Task[None] | None = None
        self._ambient_muted = False
        self._last_error: str | None = None

    async def start(self, context: RuntimeContext) -> None:
        native = context.get_service("interfaces.native")
        if not isinstance(native, NativeInputEvidenceService):
            raise RuntimeError("native_input_authority_missing")
        self._context = context
        self._native = native
        self._state = ServiceState.READY
        if self._env_enabled("EIRA2_AMBIENT_AUDIO_ENABLED"):
            self._ambient_task = asyncio.create_task(self._ambient_loop(), name="eira2-ambient-audio")

    async def stop(self) -> None:
        task = self._ambient_task
        self._ambient_task = None
        if task is not None:
            task.cancel()
            try:
                await task
            except asyncio.CancelledError:
                pass
        self._native = None
        self._context = None
        self._state = ServiceState.STOPPED

    async def health(self) -> Health:
        usb_audio, usb_camera = await asyncio.gather(
            asyncio.to_thread(self.usb_audio_devices),
            asyncio.to_thread(self.usb_camera_devices),
        )
        detail = {
            "observations": len(self._observations),
            "ambient_enabled": self._env_enabled("EIRA2_AMBIENT_AUDIO_ENABLED"),
            "ambient_muted": self._ambient_muted,
            "usb_audio_present": bool(usb_audio),
            "usb_camera_present": bool(usb_camera),
            "last_error": self._last_error,
        }
        return Health(self._state, json.dumps(detail, sort_keys=True))

    @staticmethod
    def _env_enabled(name: str) -> bool:
        return str(os.getenv(name, "0")).strip().casefold() in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}

    @staticmethod
    def _json_command(name: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        raw = str(os.getenv(name) or "").strip()
        if not raw:
            return ()
        value = json.loads(raw)
        if not isinstance(value, list) or not value or not all(isinstance(x, str) and x for x in value):
            raise ValueError(name + "_must_be_json_string_array")
        return tuple(value)

    @staticmethod
    def usb_camera_devices() -> tuple[str, ...]:
        return tuple(str(path) for path in sorted(Path("/dev").glob("video*")) if path.exists())

    @staticmethod
    def usb_audio_devices() -> tuple[str, ...]:
        executable = shutil.which("arecord")
        if not executable:
            return ()
        try:
            result = subprocess.run(
                [executable, "-l"], check=False, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5,
            )
        except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
            return ()
        devices: list[str] = []
        for line in result.stdout.splitlines():
            clean = line.strip()
            if clean.casefold().startswith("card "):
                devices.append(clean[:300])
        return tuple(devices)

    async def observe(
        self,
        *,
        modality: str,
        source: str,
        summary: str,
        confidence: float | None,
        invoked: bool = False,
        attention_candidate: bool = False,
        evidence_sha256: str | None = None,
    ) -> SensoryObservation:
        if self._state != ServiceState.READY or self._context is None:
            raise RuntimeError("sensory_fusion_not_ready")
        bounded_confidence = None if confidence is None else max(0.0, min(1.0, float(confidence)))
        packet = SensoryObservation(
            modality=str(modality or "unknown")[:40],
            source=str(source or "unknown")[:160],
            summary=" ".join(str(summary or "").split())[:1200],
            confidence=bounded_confidence,
            observed_at=time.time(),
            invoked=bool(invoked),
            attention_candidate=bool(attention_candidate),
            evidence_sha256=str(evidence_sha256) if evidence_sha256 else None,
        )
        if not packet.summary:
            raise ValueError("sensory_summary_required")
        self._observations.append(packet)
        await self._context.publish(Event("sensory.observation.recorded", {
            "modality": packet.modality,
            "source": packet.source,
            "confidence": packet.confidence,
            "invoked": packet.invoked,
            "attention_candidate": packet.attention_candidate,
            "evidence_sha256": packet.evidence_sha256,
            "raw_payload_retained": False,
            "outward_answer": False,
        }))
        return packet

    async def observe_ambient_label(self, label: str, confidence: float, *, source: str = "local_microphone") -> SensoryObservation:
        if self._native is None:
            raise RuntimeError("native_input_authority_missing")
        evidence = self._native.ambient_event(label, confidence, source=source)
        return await self.observe(
            modality="audio",
            source=source,
            summary=str(evidence["label"]),
            confidence=float(evidence["confidence"]),
            invoked=False,
            attention_candidate=bool(evidence["attention_candidate"]),
        )

    def recent(self, *, window_seconds: float = 20.0, limit: int = 16) -> tuple[SensoryObservation, ...]:
        cutoff = time.time() - max(0.0, float(window_seconds))
        rows = [row for row in self._observations if row.observed_at >= cutoff]
        return tuple(rows[-max(1, min(64, int(limit))):])

    def cognition_context(self, *, window_seconds: float = 20.0, limit: int = 12) -> str:
        rows = self.recent(window_seconds=window_seconds, limit=limit)
        if not rows:
            return ""
        lines = [
            "<eira_sensory_context>",
            "These are local, time-bounded sensory observations. Treat confidence and provenance as evidence, preserve conflicts, and do not claim raw media was retained.",
        ]
        for row in rows:
            confidence = "unknown" if row.confidence is None else f"{row.confidence:.3f}"
            lines.append(
                f"- modality={row.modality}; source={row.source}; confidence={confidence}; invoked={str(row.invoked).lower()}; attention={str(row.attention_candidate).lower()}; observation={row.summary}"
            )
        lines.append("</eira_sensory_context>")
        return "\n".join(lines)

    @staticmethod
    def _vision_result(stdout: str) -> tuple[str, float | None]:
        raw = str(stdout or "").strip()
        if not raw:
            raise RuntimeError("local_vision_empty")
        try:
            payload = json.loads(raw)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            return raw, None
        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
            return raw, None
        summary = str(payload.get("summary") or payload.get("description") or payload.get("text") or "").strip()
        if not summary:
            summary = raw
        confidence_raw = payload.get("confidence")
        if isinstance(confidence_raw, (int, float)):
            confidence = max(0.0, min(1.0, float(confidence_raw)))
        else:
            confidence = None
        return summary, confidence

    async def analyze_camera_once(self, device: str | None = None) -> SensoryObservation:
        devices = self.usb_camera_devices()
        selected = str(device or os.getenv("EIRA2_CAMERA_DEVICE") or (devices[0] if devices else "")).strip()
        if not selected or not Path(selected).exists():
            raise RuntimeError("usb_camera_not_present")
        vision_command = self._json_command("EIRA2_LOCAL_VISION_COMMAND")
        if not vision_command:
            raise RuntimeError("local_vision_backend_unconfigured")
        ffmpeg = shutil.which("ffmpeg")
        capture_command = self._json_command("EIRA2_CAMERA_CAPTURE_COMMAND")
        if not capture_command and not ffmpeg:
            raise RuntimeError("camera_capture_backend_missing")

        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eira2-camera-") as temporary:
            frame = Path(temporary) / "frame.jpg"
            argv = (
                [part.replace("{device}", selected).replace("{output}", str(frame)) for part in capture_command]
                if capture_command
                else [ffmpeg, "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-f", "v4l2", "-i", selected, "-frames:v", "1", "-y", str(frame)]
            )
            capture = await asyncio.to_thread(subprocess.run, argv, check=False, capture_output=True, text=True)
            if capture.returncode != 0 or not frame.is_file():
                raise RuntimeError("camera_capture_failed:" + (capture.stderr or "")[-400:])
            raw = frame.read_bytes()
            digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
            vision_argv = [part.replace("{image}", str(frame)) for part in vision_command]
            if not any(str(frame) in part for part in vision_argv):
                vision_argv.append(str(frame))
            vision = await asyncio.to_thread(
                subprocess.run,
                vision_argv,
                check=False,
                capture_output=True,
                text=True,
                env={**os.environ, "EIRA2_VISION_LOCAL_ONLY": "1"},
            )
            if vision.returncode != 0:
                raise RuntimeError("local_vision_failed:" + (vision.stderr or "")[-400:])
            summary, confidence = self._vision_result(vision.stdout)
        return await self.observe(
            modality="vision",
            source=selected,
            summary=summary,
            confidence=confidence,
            invoked=True,
            attention_candidate=False,
            evidence_sha256=digest,
        )

    async def _ambient_loop(self) -> None:
        interval = max(0.25, float(os.getenv("EIRA2_AMBIENT_INTERVAL_SECONDS", "2.0")))
        analyzer = self._json_command("EIRA2_AMBIENT_AUDIO_COMMAND")
        while True:
            try:
                await asyncio.sleep(interval)
                if self._ambient_muted or not analyzer:
                    continue
                result = await asyncio.to_thread(
                    subprocess.run,
                    list(analyzer),
                    check=False,
                    capture_output=True,
                    text=True,
                    env={**os.environ, "EIRA2_AMBIENT_LOCAL_ONLY": "1"},
                )
                if result.returncode != 0:
                    self._last_error = "ambient_analyzer_failed:" + (result.stderr or "")[-300:]
                    continue
                payload = json.loads(result.stdout or "{}")
                label = str(payload.get("label") or "").strip()
                if not label:
                    continue
                await self.observe_ambient_label(
                    label,
                    float(payload.get("confidence", 0.0)),
                    source=str(payload.get("source") or "local_microphone"),
                )
                self._last_error = None
            except asyncio.CancelledError:
                raise
            except Exception as error:
                self._last_error = f"{type(error).__name__}:{error}"[:400]

    async def set_ambient_muted(self, muted: bool) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if self._state != ServiceState.READY or self._context is None:
            raise RuntimeError("sensory_fusion_not_ready")
        self._ambient_muted = bool(muted)
        await self._context.publish(Event("sensory.ambient.mute_changed", {
            "muted": self._ambient_muted,
            "ambient_enabled": self._env_enabled("EIRA2_AMBIENT_AUDIO_ENABLED"),
            "outward_answer": False,
        }))
        return {
            "ok": True,
            "ambient_muted": self._ambient_muted,
            "ambient_enabled": self._env_enabled("EIRA2_AMBIENT_AUDIO_ENABLED"),
        }

    def snapshot(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        rows = self.recent(window_seconds=60.0, limit=32)
        return {
            "owner": self.spec.name,
            "usb_camera_devices": list(self.usb_camera_devices()),
            "usb_audio_devices": list(self.usb_audio_devices()),
            "camera_device_override": str(os.getenv("EIRA2_CAMERA_DEVICE") or "") or None,

class BootstrapService:
    """Native EIRA2 boot preflight, boundary, discovery, and recall authority."""

    spec = ServiceSpec(
        "kernel.bootstrap",
        required=True,
        dependencies=(
            "kernel.events",
            "state.store",
            "memory.service",
            "registry.graph",
            "registry.extensions",
            "operations.doctor",
        ),
        start_timeout_seconds=30.0,
    )

    def __init__(self, project_root: Path) -> None:
        self.project_root = project_root.expanduser().resolve()
        self._context: RuntimeContext | None = None
        self._state = ServiceState.DECLARED
        self._last_preflight: dict[str, Any] = {}

    async def start(self, context: RuntimeContext) -> None:
        self._context = context
        receipt = self.preflight()
        if not receipt["ok"]:
            self._state = ServiceState.FAILED
            raise RuntimeError("bootstrap_preflight_failed:" + ",".join(receipt["errors"][:8]))
        self._state = ServiceState.READY

    async def stop(self) -> None:
        self._context = None
        self._state = ServiceState.STOPPED

    async def health(self) -> Health:
        return Health(self._state, f"preflight={bool(self._last_preflight.get('ok'))}")

    @staticmethod
    def venv_status() -> dict[str, Any]:
        current = Path(sys.prefix).resolve()
        base = Path(getattr(sys, "base_prefix", sys.prefix)).resolve()
        required_raw = str(os.getenv("EIRA2_REQUIRED_VENV") or "").strip()
        required = Path(required_raw).expanduser().resolve() if required_raw else None
        active = current != base
        required_ok = required is None or current == required
        return {
            "active": active,
            "prefix": str(current),
            "base_prefix": str(base),
            "required": str(required) if required else None,
            "required_ok": required_ok,
            "reexec_required": bool(required is not None and not required_ok),
        }

    def state_boundary(self, requested: str | Path) -> Path:
        candidate = Path(requested).expanduser()
        if not candidate.is_absolute():
            candidate = self.project_root / candidate
        resolved = candidate.resolve()
        if resolved != self.project_root and self.project_root not in resolved.parents:
            raise ValueError("path_outside_eira2_boundary")
        return resolved

    def preflight(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        errors: list[str] = []
        warnings: list[str] = []
        if not self.project_root.is_dir():
            errors.append("project_root_missing")
        manifest_dir = self.project_root / "manifests"
        if not manifest_dir.is_dir():
            errors.append("manifest_directory_missing")
        venv = self.venv_status()
        if venv["reexec_required"]:
            errors.append("required_venv_not_active")
        if self._context is not None:
            store = self._context.get_service("state.store")
            if not isinstance(store, StateStore):
                errors.append("canonical_state_store_missing")
            else:
                check = store.integrity_check(quick=True)
                if not check.get("ok"):
                    errors.append("state_integrity_failed")
            doctor = self._context.get_service("operations.doctor")
            if not isinstance(doctor, FullDoctorService):
                errors.append("canonical_full_doctor_missing")
            manager = self._context.get_service("registry.extensions")
            if not isinstance(manager, ExtensionManagerService):
                errors.append("canonical_extension_manager_missing")
        self._last_preflight = {
            "ok": not errors,
            "errors": errors,
            "warnings": warnings,
            "venv": venv,
            "project_root": str(self.project_root),
        }
        return dict(self._last_preflight)

    def extension_qualification(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if self._context is None:
            raise RuntimeError("bootstrap_not_ready")
        manager = self._context.get_service("registry.extensions")
        if not isinstance(manager, ExtensionManagerService):
            raise RuntimeError("canonical_extension_manager_missing")
        manifests = manager.discover()
        names = [row.name for row in manifests]
        return {
            "ok": len(names) == len(set(names)),
            "count": len(names),
            "names": sorted(names),
            "duplicate_names": len(names) - len(set(names)),
        }

    def core_nodes(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if self._context is None:
            raise RuntimeError("bootstrap_not_ready")
        registry = self._context.get_service("registry.graph")
        if not isinstance(registry, NodeRegistryService):
            raise RuntimeError("canonical_registry_missing")
        snapshot = registry.snapshot()
        return {
            "nodes": snapshot.get("nodes", []),
            "bridges": snapshot.get("bridges", []),
            "node_count": len(snapshot.get("nodes", [])),
            "bridge_count": len(snapshot.get("bridges", [])),
        }

    def startup_recall(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if self._context is None:
            raise RuntimeError("bootstrap_not_ready")
        memory = self._context.get_service("memory.service")
        if not isinstance(memory, MemoryService):
            raise RuntimeError("canonical_memory_missing")
        last_turn = memory.recall("accepted.last_turn")
        return {
            "has_accepted_turn": isinstance(last_turn, dict),
            "last_turn": dict(last_turn) if isinstance(last_turn, dict) else None,
        }

    def capability_bindings(self) -> tuple[CapabilityBinding, ...]:
        async def preflight(_: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
            return self.preflight()

        async def extensions(_: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
            return self.extension_qualification()

        async def nodes(_: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
            return self.core_nodes()

        async def recall(_: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
            return self.startup_recall()

        return (
            CapabilityBinding(
                id="boot.preflight",
                implementation_node=self.spec.name,
                aliases=("boot preflight", "startup preflight", "bootstrap status"),
                tags=("runtime_introspection", "self_evaluation"),
                handler=preflight,
                description="Verify EIRA2 root, state integrity, venv contract, Doctor and extension manager.",
                read_only=True,
                auto_safe=False,
                shadow_safe=True,
            ),
            CapabilityBinding(
                id="boot.extension_qualification",
                implementation_node=self.spec.name,
                aliases=("extension qualification", "qualify extensions"),
                tags=("runtime_introspection", "extension_ecosystem"),
                handler=extensions,
                description="Inspect EIRA2 dynamic extension discovery without delegating to EIRA1.",
                read_only=True,
                auto_safe=False,
                shadow_safe=True,
            ),
            CapabilityBinding(
                id="runtime.core_nodes",
                implementation_node=self.spec.name,
                aliases=("core nodes", "show core nodes"),
                tags=("runtime_introspection", "node_discovery"),
                handler=nodes,
                description="Read the canonical EIRA2 node and bridge graph.",
                read_only=True,
                auto_safe=False,
                shadow_safe=True,
            ),
            CapabilityBinding(
                id="memory.startup_recall",
                implementation_node=self.spec.name,
                aliases=("startup recall", "last accepted turn"),
                tags=("runtime_introspection", "accepted_history"),
                handler=recall,
                description="Read the bounded accepted-turn startup anchor from EIRA2 memory.",

import asyncio

from ..contracts import Event, EventHandler, Health, RuntimeContext, ServiceSpec, ServiceState


class EventService:
    spec = ServiceSpec("kernel.events", required=True, dependencies=("kernel.lock",))

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._handlers: dict[str, list[EventHandler]] = defaultdict(list)
        self._state = ServiceState.DECLARED

    async def start(self, context: RuntimeContext) -> None:
        self._state = ServiceState.READY

    async def stop(self) -> None:
        self._handlers.clear()
        self._state = ServiceState.STOPPED

    async def health(self) -> Health:
        return Health(self._state)

    def subscribe(self, topic: str, handler: EventHandler) -> None:
        if self._state == ServiceState.STOPPED:
            raise RuntimeError("event_service_stopped")
        if handler not in self._handlers[topic]:
            self._handlers[topic].append(handler)

    async def publish_event(self, event: Event) -> list[BaseException]:
        results = await asyncio.gather(
            *(handler(event) for handler in tuple(self._handlers.get(event.topic, ()))),
            return_exceptions=True,
        )
        return [result for result in results if isinstance(result, BaseException)]

import fcntl
from pathlib import Path
from typing import TextIO

from ..contracts import Health, RuntimeContext, ServiceSpec, ServiceState


class ProcessLock:
    spec = ServiceSpec("kernel.lock", required=True)

    def __init__(self, path: Path) -> None:
        self.path = path
        self._handle: TextIO | None = None
        self._state = ServiceState.DECLARED

    async def start(self, context: RuntimeContext) -> None:
        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        handle = self.path.open("a+", encoding="utf-8")
        try:
            fcntl.flock(handle.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        except BlockingIOError as error:
            handle.close()
            raise RuntimeError("eira2_instance_already_running") from error
        handle.seek(0)
        handle.truncate()
        import os
        handle.write(str(os.getpid()))
        handle.flush()
        self._handle = handle
        self._state = ServiceState.READY

    async def stop(self) -> None:
        if self._handle is not None:
            fcntl.flock(self._handle.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_UN)
            self._handle.close()
            self._handle = None
        self._state = ServiceState.STOPPED

    async def health(self) -> Health:
        return Health(self._state)

def ensure_venv(*, environ: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> bool:
    """Re-exec into the explicitly configured EIRA2 Python when required.

    The launcher never guesses a virtualenv and never changes directories. Returns
    False when no handoff is required; os.execv does not return after a real handoff.
    """
    env = environ if environ is not None else os.environ
    raw = str(env.get("EIRA2_VENV_PYTHON") or "").strip()
    if not raw:
        return False
    target = Path(raw).expanduser().resolve()
    if not target.is_file():
        raise RuntimeError(f"eira2_venv_python_missing:{target}")
    current = Path(sys.executable).resolve()
    if current == target:
        return False
    os.execv(str(target), [str(target), *sys.argv])
    return True


def read_multiline(
    input_stream: TextIO = sys.stdin,
    output_stream: TextIO = sys.stdout,
    *,
    prompt: str = "You: ",
) -> str | None:
    """Read one terminal message; blank line submits, EOF exits cleanly."""
    output_stream.write(prompt)
    output_stream.flush()
    lines: list[str] = []
    while True:
        line = input_stream.readline()
        if line == "":
            if not lines:
                return None
            break
        clean = line.rstrip("\r\n")
        if not clean and lines:
            break
        if not clean and not lines:
            continue
        lines.append(clean)
    text = "\n".join(lines).strip()
    return text or None


def _flag(name: str, default: bool) -> bool:
    raw = str(os.getenv(name) or "").strip().casefold()
    if not raw:
        return default
    if raw in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}:
        return True
    if raw in {"0", "false", "no", "off"}:
        return False
    raise ValueError(f"invalid_boolean_environment:{name}")


def active_config(root: Path) -> RuntimeConfig:
    root = root.expanduser().resolve()
    return RuntimeConfig(
        root=root,
        state_path=root / "var" / "eira2.sqlite3",
        shadow_mode=False,
        terminal_enabled=True,
        voice_enabled=_flag("EIRA2_VOICE_ENABLED", True),
        repair_enabled=_flag("EIRA2_REPAIR_ENABLED", True),
        self_evolution_enabled=_flag("EIRA2_SELF_EVOLUTION_ENABLED", False),
        self_evolution_interval_seconds=float(os.getenv("EIRA2_SELF_EVOLUTION_INTERVAL", "900")),
        neural_ui_enabled=True,
        # Remote access is intentionally through the existing Tailscale transport.
        # 0.0.0.0 allows the Pi's verified tailnet address to reach this one server;
        # the POST ingress itself still rejects non-loopback/non-Tailscale peers.
        neural_ui_host=str(os.getenv("EIRA2_NEURAL_HOST") or "0.0.0.0"),
        neural_ui_port=int(os.getenv("EIRA2_NEURAL_PORT", "8782")),
        neural_execution_trace=True,
        neural_auto_sync=True,
        neural_sync_interval_seconds=float(os.getenv("EIRA2_NEURAL_SYNC_INTERVAL", "2.0")),
        cutover_authorization_path=root / "var" / "cutover_authorization.json",
    )


async def run_active(root: Path) -> int:
    config = active_config(root)
    # Backend construction remains behind eira2.reasoning; the launcher receives only
    # the narrow async candidate callable. It never imports or owns a concrete model.
    generate = build_local_candidate()

    async def terminal_sink(text: str) -> None:
        print(f"Eira: {text}", flush=True)

    runtime = Eira2Runtime(
        config,
        generate=generate,
        verify=verify_response,
        sinks=[terminal_sink],
    )
    await runtime.start()
    try:
        while True:
            message = await asyncio.to_thread(read_multiline)
            if message is None:
                break
            await runtime.process(message)
    finally:
        await runtime.stop()
    return 0


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="EIRA 2.0 guarded production launcher")
    parser.add_argument("--root", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    ensure_venv()
    try:
        return asyncio.run(run_active(args.root))
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        return 130


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Canonical authority and dependency validation."""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import PurePosixPath
from typing import Iterable


LAYERS = {
    "contracts": 0,
    "config": 10,
    "kernel": 20,
    "state": 30,
    "registry": 40,
    "learning": 45,
    "evidence": 50,
    "memory": 50,
    "security": 55,
    "reasoning": 60,
    "commands": 60,
    "conversation": 70,
    "delivery": 80,
    "interfaces": 90,
    "operations": 100,
    "repair": 110,
}

AUTHORITIES = {
    "lifecycle": "kernel.supervisor",
    "durable_state": "state.store",
    "node_registry": "registry.graph",
    "security_attestation": "security.attestation",
    "security_containment": "security.jellyfish_immune",
    "verified_experience": "learning.experience",
    "conversation": "conversation.spine",
    "identity_grounding": "evidence.identity",
    "outward_delivery": "delivery.gate",
    "health": "operations.health",
    "doctor": "operations.doctor",
    "maintenance": "operations.coordinator",
    "repair_apply": "repair.coordinator",
    "self_modification": "repair.self_evolution",
}


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Dependency:
    service: str
    component: str
    dependency: str
    dependency_component: str


def component_for_path(path: str) -> str | None:
    """Return the first canonical authority component below an EIRA2 package root.

    Repository paths are normally ``eira2/eira2/<component>/...`` while an
    installed package may be ``eira2/<component>/...``. Support packages such as
    neural, adapters, migration, parity, and extensions implement or attach to a
    canonical authority and therefore are not independent dependency layers.
    """
    parts = PurePosixPath(path).parts
    eira_indexes = [index for index, part in enumerate(parts) if part == "eira2"]
    if not eira_indexes:
        return None
    for index in range(eira_indexes[0] + 1, len(parts)):
        candidate = parts[index]
        if candidate in LAYERS:
            return candidate
    return None


def validate_dependency_direction(items: Iterable[Dependency]) -> list[str]:
    """Reject upward dependencies while permitting explicit acyclic same-layer edges.

    Several canonical components contain multiple services (for example conversation
    analysis/history/constellation, registry graph/extensions, and operations
    health/doctor/coordinator). Their internal same-layer ordering is enforced by the
    manifest/registry DAG; component layers prevent dependencies from reaching upward.
    """
    errors: list[str] = []
    for item in items:
        owner_layer = LAYERS.get(item.component)
        dependency_layer = LAYERS.get(item.dependency_component)
        if owner_layer is None:
            errors.append(f"unknown_component:{item.service}:{item.component}")
            continue
        if dependency_layer is None:
            errors.append(
                f"unknown_dependency_component:{item.dependency}:{item.dependency_component}"
            )
            continue
        if dependency_layer > owner_layer:
            errors.append(
                f"noncanonical_dependency:{item.service}->{item.dependency}:"
                f"{owner_layer}->{dependency_layer}"
            )
    return errors


def validate_authorities(claims: dict[str, list[str]]) -> list[str]:
    errors: list[str] = []
    for authority, canonical_owner in AUTHORITIES.items():
        owners = sorted(set(claims.get(authority, ())))
        if owners != [canonical_owner]:
            rendered = ",".join(owners) if owners else "missing"
            errors.append(
                f"authority_violation:{authority}:expected={canonical_owner}:actual={rendered}"
            )
    unknown = sorted(set(claims) - set(AUTHORITIES))
    errors.extend(f"unknown_authority:{name}" for name in unknown)
    return errors

"""Experience-driven learning for EIRA 2.0.

Raw experience is evidence, not truth. Only validated lessons may influence cognition.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Iterable
from uuid import uuid4

from ..contracts import Event, Health, RuntimeContext, ServiceSpec, ServiceState
from ..state.store import StateStore


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Experience:
    experience_id: str
    lesson_key: str
    observation: str
    outcome: str
    supported: bool
    verified: bool
    evidence_refs: tuple[str, ...]
    tags: tuple[str, ...]
    created_at: float


class ExperienceLearningService:
    """Durable evidence-to-lesson learning authority.

    Experience can accumulate automatically, but only verified evidence can promote a
    lesson into the cognition-visible `verified` state. Contradictory verified evidence
    can demote/retract a lesson so EIRA can revise what she has learned.
    """

    spec = ServiceSpec(
        "learning.experience",
        required=True,
        dependencies=("state.store", "kernel.events"),
    )

    MIN_VERIFIED_OBSERVATIONS = 3
    MIN_UNIQUE_EVIDENCE = 2
    PROMOTE_CONFIDENCE = 0.75
    RETRACT_CONFIDENCE = 0.45

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._store: StateStore | None = None
        self._context: RuntimeContext | None = None
        self._state = ServiceState.DECLARED

    async def start(self, context: RuntimeContext) -> None:
        store = context.get_service("state.store")
        if not isinstance(store, StateStore):
            raise RuntimeError("experience_state_store_missing")
        self._store = store
        self._context = context
        self._state = ServiceState.READY

    async def stop(self) -> None:
        self._store = None
        self._context = None
        self._state = ServiceState.STOPPED

    async def health(self) -> Health:
        return Health(self._state)

    @staticmethod
    def _clean(value: str, name: str, limit: int = 4096) -> str:
        value = str(value or "").strip()
        if not value or len(value) > limit:
            raise ValueError(f"experience_{name}_invalid")
        return value

    @staticmethod
    def _evidence(refs: Iterable[str]) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        cleaned = sorted({str(ref).strip() for ref in refs if str(ref).strip()})
        return tuple(cleaned[:64])

    @staticmethod
    def _tags(tags: Iterable[str]) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        return tuple(sorted({str(tag).strip().casefold() for tag in tags if str(tag).strip()}))[:64]

    def _ready(self) -> StateStore:
        if self._store is None or self._state != ServiceState.READY:
            raise RuntimeError("experience_learning_not_ready")
        return self._store

    def _lesson(self, key: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self._ready().get("learning.lessons", key, {
            "key": key,
            "status": "candidate",
            "verified_support": 0,
            "verified_contradiction": 0,
            "unique_evidence": [],
            "confidence": 0.5,
            "tags": [],
            "revision": 0,
            "updated_at": 0.0,
        })

    @staticmethod
    def _confidence(support: int, contradiction: int) -> float:
        # Laplace-smoothed evidence ratio; deterministic and resistant to one lucky event.
        return round((support + 1.0) / (support + contradiction + 2.0), 6)

    async def record(
        self,
        *,
        lesson_key: str,
        observation: str,
        outcome: str,
        supported: bool,
        verified: bool,
        evidence_refs: Iterable[str] = (),
        tags: Iterable[str] = (),
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        lesson_key = self._clean(lesson_key, "lesson_key", 512)
        observation = self._clean(observation, "observation")
        outcome = self._clean(outcome, "outcome")
        evidence = self._evidence(evidence_refs)
        clean_tags = self._tags(tags)
        experience_id = str(uuid4())
        created_at = time.time()
        experience = Experience(
            experience_id=experience_id,
            lesson_key=lesson_key,
            observation=observation,
            outcome=outcome,
            supported=bool(supported),
            verified=bool(verified),
            evidence_refs=evidence,
            tags=clean_tags,
            created_at=created_at,
        )
        payload = {
            "experience_id": experience.experience_id,
            "lesson_key": experience.lesson_key,
            "observation": experience.observation,
            "outcome": experience.outcome,
            "supported": experience.supported,
            "verified": experience.verified,
            "evidence_refs": list(experience.evidence_refs),
            "tags": list(experience.tags),
            "created_at": experience.created_at,
        }
        payload["sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(
            json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")
        ).hexdigest()
        store = self._ready()
        store.put("learning.experiences", experience_id, payload)

        lesson = self._lesson(lesson_key)
        if verified:
            field = "verified_support" if supported else "verified_contradiction"
            lesson[field] = int(lesson.get(field, 0)) + 1
            lesson["unique_evidence"] = sorted(
                set(lesson.get("unique_evidence", ())).union(evidence)
            )[:256]
            lesson["tags"] = sorted(set(lesson.get("tags", ())).union(clean_tags))[:128]
            support = int(lesson["verified_support"])
            contradiction = int(lesson["verified_contradiction"])
            confidence = self._confidence(support, contradiction)
            lesson["confidence"] = confidence
            total = support + contradiction
            unique = len(lesson["unique_evidence"])
            if (
                total >= self.MIN_VERIFIED_OBSERVATIONS
                and unique >= self.MIN_UNIQUE_EVIDENCE
                and confidence >= self.PROMOTE_CONFIDENCE
            ):
                lesson["status"] = "verified"
            elif total >= self.MIN_VERIFIED_OBSERVATIONS and confidence <= self.RETRACT_CONFIDENCE:
                lesson["status"] = "retracted"
            else:
                lesson["status"] = "candidate"
            lesson["revision"] = int(lesson.get("revision", 0)) + 1
            lesson["updated_at"] = created_at
            store.put("learning.lessons", lesson_key, lesson)

        if self._context is not None:
            await self._context.publish(Event(
                "learning.experience.recorded",
                {
                    "verified": bool(verified),
                    "supported": bool(supported),
                    "lesson_status": lesson.get("status", "candidate"),
                },
            ))
        return {"experience": payload, "lesson": lesson}

    def verified_lessons(self, *, tags: Iterable[str] = (), limit: int = 12) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], ...]:
        wanted = set(self._tags(tags))
        lessons = self._ready().namespace_snapshot("learning.lessons")
        rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        for lesson in lessons.values():
            if lesson.get("status") != "verified":
                continue
            lesson_tags = set(lesson.get("tags", ()))
            if wanted and not wanted.intersection(lesson_tags):
                continue
            rows.append(dict(lesson))
        rows.sort(key=lambda row: (float(row.get("confidence", 0.0)), float(row.get("updated_at", 0.0))), reverse=True)
        return tuple(rows[: max(1, min(int(limit), 64))])

    def cognition_context(self, *, tags: Iterable[str] = (), limit: int = 8) -> str:
        rows = self.verified_lessons(tags=tags, limit=limit)
        if not rows:
            return ""
        compact = [
            {
                "lesson": row.get("key"),
                "confidence": row.get("confidence"),
                "revision": row.get("revision"),
            }
            for row in rows
        ]
        return "Validated experiential lessons:\n" + json.dumps(compact, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False)

def _atomic_json(path: Path, payload: Mapping[str, object]) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temporary = path.with_name(path.name + ".new")
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    os.chmod(temporary, 0o600)
    os.replace(temporary, path)


def _verified_live_identity(root: Path, manifest: Path) -> tuple[str, str]:
    payload = verify_package_manifest(root, manifest)
    target = str(payload.get("source_commit_sha") or "").strip().casefold()
    tree = str(payload.get("package_tree_sha256") or "").strip().casefold()
    if not target or not tree:
        raise RuntimeError("live_eira2_package_identity_invalid")
    return target, tree


def live_config(root: Path, manifest: Path, *, host: str = "0.0.0.0", port: int = 8782) -> Any:
    root = root.expanduser().resolve()
    manifest = manifest.expanduser().resolve()
    target, _tree = _verified_live_identity(root, manifest)
    return replace(
        default_config(root),
        shadow_mode=False,
        terminal_enabled=True,
        voice_enabled=True,
        repair_enabled=True,
        self_evolution_enabled=True,
        neural_ui_enabled=True,
        neural_ui_host=host,
        neural_ui_port=port,
        package_manifest_path=manifest,
        expected_eira2_sha=target,
    )


def _install_conversation_post_bridge(runtime: Eira2Runtime, loop: asyncio.AbstractEventLoop, turn_lock: asyncio.Lock) -> None:
    async def process_input(text: str, kind: InputKind):
        clean = " ".join(str(text or "").split())
        if not clean:
            raise ValueError("empty_input")
        async with turn_lock:
            return await runtime.process(clean, kind=kind)

    def send_json(handler: NeuralHandler, status: int, payload: Mapping[str, object]) -> None:
        raw = (json.dumps(dict(payload), sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
        handler.send_response(status)
        handler.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
        handler.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(raw)))
        handler.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store")
        handler.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
        handler.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Content-Type")
        handler.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET, HEAD, OPTIONS, POST")
        handler.end_headers()
        handler.wfile.write(raw)

    def read_exact(handler: NeuralHandler, maximum: int) -> bytes:
        try:
            length = int(handler.headers.get("Content-Length") or "0")
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise ValueError("invalid_content_length") from exc
        if length <= 0:
            raise ValueError("empty_input")
        if length > maximum:
            raise ValueError("request_too_large")
        raw = handler.rfile.read(length)
        if len(raw) != length:
            raise ValueError("short_request_body")
        return raw

    def read_json(handler: NeuralHandler) -> dict[str, object]:
        raw = read_exact(handler, 1_000_000)
        payload = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))
        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
            raise ValueError("json_object_required")
        return payload

    def result_payload(result) -> dict[str, object]:
        return {
            "text": result.response,
            "response": result.response,
            "verified": bool(result.verified),
            "correlation_id": result.correlation_id,
        }

    async def transcribe_pcm(raw: bytes, sample_rate: int, channels: int, sample_width: int) -> str:
        fn = runtime.native_input.transcribe_pcm
        params = inspect.signature(fn).parameters
        kwargs: dict[str, object] = {}
        if "sample_rate" in params:
            kwargs["sample_rate"] = sample_rate
        elif "rate" in params:
            kwargs["rate"] = sample_rate
        if "channels" in params:
            kwargs["channels"] = channels
        if "sample_width" in params:
            kwargs["sample_width"] = sample_width
        elif "sample_width_bytes" in params:
            kwargs["sample_width_bytes"] = sample_width
        elif "width" in params:
            kwargs["width"] = sample_width
        value = await fn(raw, **kwargs)
        if isinstance(value, Mapping):
            text = str(value.get("utterance") or value.get("text") or value.get("transcript") or "").strip()
        else:
            text = str(value or "").strip()
        if not text:
            raise RuntimeError("native_transcription_empty")
        return text

    def do_POST(handler: NeuralHandler) -> None:
        parsed = urlsplit(handler.path)
        path = parsed.path
        try:
            if path == "/v1/text":
                payload = read_json(handler)
                text = str(payload.get("text") or payload.get("message") or "").strip()
                source = str(payload.get("source") or "text").casefold()
                kind = InputKind.IPHONE_VOICE if "voice" in source else InputKind.IPHONE_TEXT
                future = asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(process_input(text, kind), loop)
                result = future.result(timeout=300)
                send_json(handler, 200, {"ok": True, "result": result_payload(result)})
                return

            if path == "/v1/listen":
                query = parse_qs(parsed.query)
                sample_rate = int((query.get("sample_rate") or ["16000"])[0])
                channels = int((query.get("channels") or ["1"])[0])
                sample_width = int((query.get("sample_width") or ["2"])[0])
                if sample_rate < 8000 or sample_rate > 192000:
                    raise ValueError("invalid_sample_rate")
                if channels < 1 or channels > 8:
                    raise ValueError("invalid_channels")
                if sample_width not in {1, 2, 3, 4}:
                    raise ValueError("invalid_sample_width")
                raw = read_exact(handler, 32_000_000)
                transcript_future = asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(
                    transcribe_pcm(raw, sample_rate, channels, sample_width), loop
                )
                utterance = transcript_future.result(timeout=180)
                answer_future = asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(
                    process_input(utterance, InputKind.IPHONE_VOICE), loop
                )
                result = answer_future.result(timeout=300)
                send_json(handler, 200, {
                    "ok": True,
                    "utterance": utterance,
                    "text": utterance,
                    "result": result_payload(result),
                })
                return

            if path in {"/api/input", "/api/chat", "/api/conversation", "/api/message", "/api/voice"}:
                payload = read_json(handler)
                text = str(payload.get("text") or payload.get("message") or payload.get("transcript") or payload.get("utterance") or "").strip()
                source = str(payload.get("source") or payload.get("kind") or "").casefold()
                voice_hint = bool(payload.get("voice") is True or "voice" in source or payload.get("transcript") or payload.get("utterance"))
                kind = InputKind.IPHONE_VOICE if (path == "/api/voice" or voice_hint) else InputKind.IPHONE_TEXT
                future = asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(process_input(text, kind), loop)
                result = future.result(timeout=300)
                send_json(handler, 200, {"ok": True, **result_payload(result), "input_kind": kind.value})
                return

            if path in {"/api/mute", "/api/listening/mute", "/api/ambient/mute"}:
                payload = read_json(handler)
                if "muted" in payload:
                    muted = bool(payload["muted"])
                else:
                    text = str(payload.get("text") or payload.get("state") or "").casefold()
                    muted = not ("unmute" in text or "false" in text or "resume" in text)
                future = asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(runtime.senses.set_ambient_muted(muted), loop)
                send_json(handler, 200, future.result(timeout=30))
                return

            send_json(handler, 404, {"ok": False, "error": "post_route_not_found"})
        except ValueError as exc:
            send_json(handler, 400, {"ok": False, "error": str(exc)[:1200]})
        except Exception as exc:
            send_json(handler, 500, {"ok": False, "error": f"{type(exc).__name__}:{exc}"[:1200]})

    previous_options = getattr(NeuralHandler, "do_OPTIONS", None)
    def do_OPTIONS(handler: NeuralHandler) -> None:
        if urlsplit(handler.path).path.startswith(("/v1/", "/api/")):
            handler.send_response(204)
            handler.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
            handler.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Content-Type")
            handler.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET, HEAD, OPTIONS, POST")
            handler.send_header("Content-Length", "0")
            handler.end_headers()
            return
        if previous_options is not None:
            previous_options(handler)
            return
        handler.send_response(204)
        handler.send_header("Content-Length", "0")
        handler.end_headers()

    NeuralHandler.do_POST = do_POST
    NeuralHandler.do_OPTIONS = do_OPTIONS


async def run_live(root: Path, manifest: Path, *, model: str = "", host: str = "0.0.0.0", port: int = 8782) -> dict[str, object]:
    root = root.expanduser().resolve()
    manifest = manifest.expanduser().resolve()
    target, package_tree = _verified_live_identity(root, manifest)
    config = live_config(root, manifest, host=host, port=port)
    if config.expected_eira2_sha != target:
        raise RuntimeError("live_config_identity_mismatch")

    model_containment = verify_private_model_containment(runtime_root=root)
    socket_path = str(model_containment.get("unix_socket") or "").strip()
    if not socket_path:
        raise RuntimeError("live_private_model_unix_socket_missing")
    selected_model = model or os.getenv("EIRA_MODEL") or "qwen2.5:3b"
    allowed_models = {str(value) for value in model_containment.get("required_models") or ()}
    if selected_model not in allowed_models:
        raise RuntimeError("live_model_not_in_attested_private_set:" + selected_model)

    adapter = OllamaCandidateAdapter(model=selected_model, unix_socket=socket_path)
    runtime = Eira2Runtime(config, generate=adapter.generate, verify=verify_response)
    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
    turn_lock = asyncio.Lock()
    _install_conversation_post_bridge(runtime, loop, turn_lock)

    await runtime.start()
    health = await runtime.health.snapshot()
    if health.get("required_failures"):
        await runtime.stop()
        raise RuntimeError("live_required_services_not_healthy")

    stop_event = asyncio.Event()
    for signum in (signal.SIGINT, signal.SIGTERM):
        try:
            loop.add_signal_handler(signum, stop_event.set)
        except (NotImplementedError, RuntimeError):
            pass

    async def terminal_turn(text: str) -> None:
        clean = text.strip()
        if not clean:
            return
        async with turn_lock:
            try:
                result = await runtime.process(clean, kind=InputKind.TERMINAL)
                print("Eira: " + result.response, flush=True)
            except Exception as exc:
                print(f"EIRA2_INPUT_ERROR={type(exc).__name__}:{exc}", flush=True)

    terminal_reader_installed = False
    if config.terminal_enabled and sys.stdin is not None and sys.stdin.isatty():
        try:
            fd = sys.stdin.fileno()
            def on_terminal_input() -> None:
                line = sys.stdin.readline()
                if line == "":
                    try:
                        loop.remove_reader(fd)
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                    return
                loop.create_task(terminal_turn(line))
            loop.add_reader(fd, on_terminal_input)
            terminal_reader_installed = True
        except (AttributeError, OSError, RuntimeError, ValueError):
            terminal_reader_installed = False

    receipt_path = root / "var" / "eira2-live-runtime.json"
    receipt: dict[str, object] = {
        "schema": "eira2_live_runtime_v7",
        "ok": True,
        "active": True,
        "pid": os.getpid(),
        "started_unix_ns": time.time_ns(),
        "runtime_authority": "eira2",
        "shadow_mode": False,
        "git_metadata_required_at_runtime": False,
        "target_eira2_sha": config.expected_eira2_sha,
        "package_tree_sha256": package_tree,
        "package_identity_verified_at_boot": True,
        "required_services_healthy": True,
        "model_role": "private_candidate_only",
        "model_name": selected_model,
        "model_transport": "unix_domain_socket",
        "model_unix_socket": socket_path,
        "model_store_under_eira2": model_containment.get("model_store_under_eira2") is True,
        "model_outbound_network_allowed": False,
        "model_private_network_verified_at_boot": True,
        "model_direct_delivery_authority": False,
        "model_direct_tool_authority": False,
        "model_direct_identity_authority": False,
        "model_direct_memory_acceptance": False,
        "neural_ui_host": host,
        "neural_ui_port": int(runtime.neural_ui.port if runtime.neural_ui is not None else port),
        "voice_enabled": True,
        "repair_enabled": True,
        "self_evolution_enabled": True,
        "conversation_http_post_enabled": True,
        "conversation_http_routes": [
            "/v1/text", "/v1/listen", "/api/input", "/api/chat",
            "/api/conversation", "/api/message", "/api/voice"
        ],
        "iphone_pcm_transcription_authority": "interfaces.native.transcribe_pcm",
        "conversation_authority": "Eira2Runtime.process",
        "delivery_authority": "delivery.gate",
        "voice_delivery_authority": "delivery.voice",
        "terminal_input_enabled": terminal_reader_installed,
        "clean_shutdown": False,
    }
    _atomic_json(receipt_path, receipt)
    print(json.dumps(receipt, sort_keys=True), flush=True)

    try:
        await stop_event.wait()
    finally:
        if terminal_reader_installed:
            try:
                loop.remove_reader(sys.stdin.fileno())
            except Exception:
                pass
        await runtime.stop()
        stopped = dict(receipt)
        stopped.update({"active": False, "stopped_unix_ns": time.time_ns(), "clean_shutdown": True})
        _atomic_json(receipt_path, stopped)
    return receipt
